text.title: 抵抗梦魇
text.objectives: 消灭12只梦魇怪物。
text.description: 我们遭到攻击了，$n！$B$B梦魇的怪物正从梦境之路不断涌出。$B$B消灭它们，不能让它们在这里徘徊，否则梦魇就会在这里扎根了！

english.title: Enduring the Nightmare
english.objectives: Kill 12 aberrations of Nightmare.
english.description: We are under attack here, $n!$B$BCreatures of the Nightmare are spilling into the Dreamway as we speak.$B$BDestroy them. They cannot be allowed to linger, or else the Nightmare will take root here, too!

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 小动物！
text.objectives: 利用米露恩的笛子召集15只迷你精灵龙。
text.description: 哦，$n。看到你我真是太高兴了！$B$B森林里的小动物们低声说梦境之路遇到麻烦了，所以我立刻跑来了！$B$B许多迷你小动物生活在翡翠梦境中，它们现在无家可归了！$B$B你愿意去把它们带回来吗？你可以用我的笛子号召它们跟着你。$B$B谢谢你，勇敢的德鲁伊！

english.title: Teensy Weensies!
english.objectives: Use Mylune's Flute to gather 15 Teensy Weensy Fae Dragons.
english.description: Oh $n, I'm so very very happy to see you!$B$BThe woodland critters whispered there was trouble in the Dreamway so I came immediately!$B$BThere are so very many teensy weensy little creatures that live here in the Emerald Dream, and they're out there, all lost and alone!$B$BWould you go out there and gather them up? You can use my flute to call them to you.$B$BThank you, brave druid!

text.title: 净化
text.objectives: 净化100个梦魇蛇藤。
text.description: 当梦魇传播时，它会吞噬所触及的所有生命力量。$B$B梦魇传播得越广，我们的魔法力量就越弱。$B$B然而在梦魇传播的早期阶段，在它的腐化还没有那么深时，我们仍然可以净化那些受感染的地区。$B$B我会赐予你艾露恩的祝福。通过引导她的力量，你将可以逆转梦魇的腐化。

english.title: Cleaning Up
english.objectives: Cleanse 100 Nightmare Creep.
english.description: When the Nightmare spreads, it consumes the life force of all that it touches.$B$BThe more it spreads, the weaker our magic becomes.$B$BIn its early stages, before the taint has taken hold, we can still cleanse the affected areas.$B$BI will bless you with Elune's grace. By channeling her power, you can reverse the Nightmare's spread.

text.title: 将逝之梦
text.objectives: 消灭枯心。
text.description: 在沼泽的中心，有一位古老的梦境之路守护者，枯心。$B$B他是最早对抗梦魇的保卫者之一，不过他已经被完全腐化。$B$B尽管我十分痛心，不过我们必须消灭他。

english.title: A Dying Dream
english.objectives: Kill Witherheart.
english.description: Deep in the heart of the swamp lies an ancient protector of the Dreamway, Witherheart.$B$BHe was among the first defenders to battle against the Nightmare, but he has fallen to total corruption.$B$BIt pains me to say it, but we must destroy him.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 与玛洛恩交流
text.objectives: 与诺达希尔的雷姆洛斯交谈。
text.description: 我们已经完成了这里的工作，成功保卫了梦境之路，$n。随着时间的推移，它终将恢复往日的生机。$B$B而我们现在还有更重要的事情。$B$B带着荒野神像继续前往诺达希尔。他们或许已经在那里聚集。我们过去再碰头。

english.title: Communing With Malorne
english.objectives: Speak to Remulos at Nordrassil.
english.description: Our work here is done, $n. We have successfully defended the Dreamway. It will be only a matter of time before it is restored to its former state.$B$BBut we have more important matters at hand.$B$BTake the Idol of the Wilds and go onward to Nordrassil. With any luck, they have already gathered. We will meet you there.

objectiveDetails.description: 与守护者雷姆洛斯交谈

text.title: 新的开始
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的梦境林地与大德鲁伊伦萨·巨蹄会面。
text.description: 如果连玛洛恩都有危险，那么情况就比我想象的还要糟糕。现在真的要靠我们了。$B$B时间有限，我们赶快到梦境林地会合。

english.title: A New Beginning
english.objectives: Meet Archdruid Rensar Greathoof at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
english.description: If Malorne is in danger, then things are even worse than I feared. It truly is up to us now.$B$BWe have very little time left. Let us reconvene in the Dreamgrove at once.

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 为传送门供能
text.objectives: 在“为传送门供能”任务中收集10块梦魇碎片。
text.description: 玛洛恩已经深陷梦魇，我们必须把他救出来。虽然这件事似乎希望渺茫，但是我们绝对不能坐以待毙。$B$B翡翠梦境之路里有一道被遗弃的传送门，因为它连接着艾林裂隙，所以在很久以前被德鲁伊关闭了。$B$B我们需要取得萨特军官身上的梦魇碎片，才能重新为传送门供能。$B$B派出我们的勇士去寻找并解决这些敌人。

english.title: Powering the Portal
english.objectives: Collect 10 Shards of Nightmare from "Powering the Portal" missions.
english.description: If Malorne is trapped in the Nightmare, we must try to save him. It may sound like a fool's errand, but we cannot sit by idly.$B$BThere is an abandoned portal within the Emerald Dreamway, one that we druids closed long ago because it leads to the Rift of Aln.$B$BTo infuse it with energy once again, we will need shards of Nightmare which can be found on satyr lieutenants.$B$BSend our champions to hunt and kill these enemies.

text.title: 梦境守护者
text.objectives: 选择一个盟友。
text.description: 这是我们组织前所未见的挑战。我们必须依靠彼此的力量才有成功的希望。$B$B但是能够帮你应对这场战斗的人手十分有限。$B$B布罗尔、赛兰德拉、岑塔布拉和米露恩主动提出和你一起进入下方的山谷，不过我只能安排一个人同去。$B$B你要选择谁协助你作战？

english.title: Defenders of the Dream
english.objectives: Choose an ally.
english.description: Never has our order faced such a difficult challenge. To succeed, we must rely on each other's strengths.$B$BHowever, we only have a few defenders to spare for the battle ahead.$B$BBroll, Sylendra, Zen'tabra, and Mylune have all volunteered to accompany you into the valley below, but I can only spare one.$B$BWhich one will you choose to aid you in battle?

enders.name: 大德鲁伊哈缪尔·符文图腾

text.title: 进入梦魇
text.objectives: 在翡翠梦境之路进入梦魇之门。
text.description: 通往梦魇的传送门已经准备好了，$n。雷姆洛斯和其他人已经先行一步。$B$B前方还不知道有怎样的怪物在等着你，$n。祝你好运。

english.title: Enter Nightmare
english.objectives: Go through the Nightmare Portal in the Emerald Dreamway.
english.description: The portal to the nightmare is ready, $n. Remulos and the others have already gone ahead.$B$BThere is no telling what horrors await on the other side, $n. Good luck.

text.title: 上古之战
text.objectives: 赢得上古之战。
text.description: 我们必须赢得上古之战才能解救玛洛恩。数千年前，这个世界最了不起的守护者们联合起来，才最终赢得了这场战役。如果我们想要再次取胜，我们就要和他们做同样的事情。$B$B踏上战场，击败军团，救援并复活同伴，以及拯救那些被卷入战火的无辜民众。我们杀死的每一个敌人，解救的每一个同伴，都将会帮助我们改变战局！

english.title: The War of the Ancients
english.objectives: Win the War of the Ancients.
english.description: To free Malorne, we must win the War of the Ancients. A millennia ago, this battle took the combined efforts of the greatest defenders of our world. To win now, we must do the same.$B$BGo upon the battlefield and defeat Legion foes, rescue and revive our allies, and free the innocent who have been caught in the battle. Every enemy defeated and every ally saved will help turn the tide in our favor!

text.title: 污染者阿克蒙德
text.objectives: 击败阿克蒙德。
text.description: 我们成功扭转了战局，$n！燃烧军团受到了重创。$B$B现在还剩一件事。阿克蒙德就是一万年前杀掉玛洛恩的恶魔，玛洛恩被困在与他的恶战之中。$B$B记住，$n，我们身处玛洛恩的梦魇里面。谁也不知道会发生什么，不过我们必须有所行动。$B$B愿艾露恩指引你，$n。

english.title: Archimonde, The Defiler
english.objectives: Defeat Archimonde.
english.description: We have turned the battle, $n! The Burning Legion is greatly weakened.$B$BOnly one task remains. Malorne is locked in battle with Archimonde, the demon that slew him ten thousand years ago.$B$BRemember, $n, we are trapped in Malorne's nightmare. There is no telling what will manifest here, but we MUST do something.$B$BMay Elune guide us, $n.

text.title: 半神的回归
text.objectives: 接受玛洛恩的祝福。
text.description: <玛洛恩的声音在你脑海中回荡。>$B$B你身为凡人，却拥有远古神灵般的勇气。$B$B你具备自然的精神——活力、狂热，以及凶狠。而且，我在你身上还看到了自然的信念——求生的欲望。$B$B我们这次的胜利将万世流芳，$n。$B$B通过这道传送门返回物质世界，等我们回到梦境林地之后再谈。

english.title: The Demi-God's Return
english.objectives: Receive Malorne's blessing.
english.description: <Malorne's voice echoes in your mind.>$B$BMortal you may be, but your valor is worthy of the ancient gods.$B$BNature's spirit lives in you - vibrant, wild, and ferocious. I witness in you the essence of nature's spark - the WILL to survive.$B$BOur triumph here will be spoken of for ages to come, $n.$B$BReturn to the waking world through this portal. We will speak again when we return to the Dreamgrove.

objectiveDetails.description: 返回梦境林地并接受玛洛恩的祝福

text.title: 皱巴巴的请求
text.objectives: 将2份丝纹夹板和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗受伤的冒险者。
text.description: 腿断了？是的。胳膊断了？是的。写字的手呢？没断！$b$b说真的，拜托来个人帮帮忙啊。我现在痛得要命，我觉得我都快晕……

english.title: Crumpled Request
english.objectives: Bring 2 Silkweave Splints and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Injured Adventurer when you arrive.
english.description: Legs broken? Check. Arm broken? Check. Writing hand broken? Nope!$b$bBut seriously, someone please send help. I'm in so much pain right now I think I'm about to pass o...

text.title: 暮光之主
text.objectives: 击败暮光夫人。
text.description: 还剩下一件事，先知$n。我们必须直面暮光之锤的首领，彻底粉碎他们的阴谋。$b$b除掉那个所谓的“宗主”以后，其余的异教徒就只能撤离深岩之洲。$b$b只有铲除暮光之锤并拯救深岩之洲，塞拉赞恩才会帮助我们对抗燃烧军团的恶魔。

english.title: The Twilight Master
english.objectives: Defeat the Mistress of Twilight.
english.description: There is only one more thing that remains, Farseer $n. We must confront the leader of the Twilight's Hammer and put an end to their sinister plot once and for all.$b$bWithout their so-called master, the remaining cultists will be forced to retreat from Deepholm.$b$bOnly when The Twilight's Hammer has been crushed and Deepholm has been saved, will we have the support of Therazane against the demons of the Burning Legion.

text.title: 暮光再现
text.objectives: 与深岩之洲的穆恩·大地之怒交谈。
text.description: 暮光之锤再度卷土重来，他们建立了一支军队想要推翻我的王国。呵，真是痴心妄想。不过我也不能对他们掉以轻心。$b$b在处理完深岩之洲的危机之前，我无法对凡人种族伸出援手。如果你真的想要把所有的元素领主都统合到你的旗下，你就需要证明你的能力。$b$b去吧，查清暮光之锤在酝酿什么计划，彻底扼杀他们的美梦。

english.title: The Return of Twilight
english.objectives: Speak with Muln Earthfury in Deepholm.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer has reemerged and they are building an army to overthrow my kingdom. A ludicrous fantasy on their part, but one that I cannot take lightly.$b$bI cannot offer the mortal races my aid until the threat to Deepholm has been dealt with. If you truly wish to unite the Elemental Lords to your cause, I would see you prove it.$b$bGo. Uncover the plot that the Twilight's Hammer is hatching and put an end to their scheme!

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：逐星者岗哨

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭吉尔尼斯旅的队长
消灭吉尔尼斯旅的狼人

text.title: 圣光回归
text.objectives: 和杰斯·织暗一起穿过传送门，取得图雷，纳鲁道标。
text.description: 太好了！$b$b通道里面有一道传送门，而且它和大多数军团装置一样是由灵魂来供能。$b$b我觉得那个审判官的灵魂应该十分强大，足以启动通往恶魔源头的传送门。$b$b我们进去一探究竟，如何？

english.title: Return of the Light
english.objectives: Accompany Jace Darkweaver through the portal and obtain T'uure, Beacon of the Naaru.
english.description: Excellent!$b$bThere is a gateway further down this pathway and like most Legion constructs it is powered by souls.$b$bI think the death of that Inquisitor should be just enough to activate it and open the way back to where it came from.$b$bLet's go see where the path takes us, shall we?

objectiveDetails.description: 穿过黑石岛上的传送门

text.title: 化妆舞会
text.objectives: 对安纳瑞斯·月郡使用镜像面具。
text.description: 多亏了我的父亲，我们家族在这个城市里颇有名望。我们可以透过我的人脉把市民们组织起来，准备好迎接塔莉萨的回归。$B$B你得在夜之子中间走动走动，不管他们是敌是友，你都要取得他们的信任。$B$B你必须伪装成另一个人。$B$B<莉莉丝递给你一个闪光的舞会面具。>$B$B让安纳瑞斯戴上它。

english.title: Masquerade
english.objectives: Use the Mask of Mirror Image on Anarys Lunastre.
english.description: Our family commands great respect in this city, thanks to my father. Through my network of contacts, we can organize the citizens to prepare Suramar for Thalyssra's return.$B$BYou must walk among the nightborne. You must earn the trust of our friends and foes alike.$B$BYou must become someone else.$B$B<Ly'leth hands you a shimmering party mask.>$B$BPut this on Anarys.

objectiveDetails.description: 对安纳瑞斯使用镜像面具

text.title: 新鲜出炉
text.objectives: 把刚做好的大容量药剂器皿交给达拉然的德崔斯。
text.description: 好了，这是你的新导管。千万别打碎了，我可不想再做一个。$b$b噢，跟你老板德崔斯带个话，他这次欠我一个天大的人情。

english.title: In With the New
english.objectives: Bring the newly forged High-Capacity Decoction Conduit to Deucus in Dalaran.
english.description: Well, here's your new conduit. Try not to break this one, I really don't feel like making another.$b$bOh, and tell your boss, Deucus, that he owes me big time for this.

text.title: 雪鬃撤离
text.objectives: 帮助莱德·天鬃、塔文·日行和老纳夫撤离。
text.description: 他们真是源源不断！$b$b我的斥候刚才报告说一些卓格巴尔溜到了我们侧面，正在对雪鬃村发动攻击。$b$b快去帮助村民撤离。我们会在这里坚守战线，尽量为你争取时间。
text.completion: And not a moment too soon. Our scouts report the Underking himself has come.

english.title: Evacuate Snowmane
english.objectives: Evacuate Red Skymane, Tarvim Daywalker, and Old Nefu.
english.description: They just keep coming!$b$bAnd now my scouts report some of the drogbar have managed to sneak around our flank and are attacking Snowmane Village.$b$bGo, help the evacuation. We will hold the line here and try to buy you some time.
english.completion: And not a moment too soon. Our scouts report the Underking himself has come.

text.title: 搜索档案
text.objectives: 点击恐痕作战计划，完成“搜索档案”任务。
text.description:
日积月累，黑暗收割档案从不同的来源收集到大量的魔法知识。

眼下我们要去营救其余的议会成员。我们有理由相信，我们可以从数不尽档案卷宗里找到一些有用的东西。

搜索工作或许会让人精疲力尽，但是如果要重建议会并对抗燃烧军团的话，这是必要的措施。

english.title: Searching the Archives
english.objectives: Interact with the Dreadscar Battle Plans and complete the mission "Searching the Archives".
english.description:
The Black Harvest archives contain an immeasurable amount of magical knowledge that has been collected from various sources over time. 

It's reasonable to think that somewhere among the countless scrolls that we'll find something to aid us in our mission to rescue the remaining council members. 

The search may be exhausting, but it is necessary if we plan to rebuild and face the Burning Legion.

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒：无主之魂
text.objectives: 进入黑鸦堡垒地下城，从融合之魂身上取得一个无主的灵魂。
text.description:
为了建立锚点，我们必须把辛菲儿的物品与一个无主之魂相连。

这个灵魂就像是一个信标，它将引导辛菲儿穿越扭曲虚空，返回恐痕裂隙。

我们可以用辛菲儿的法杖建立连结，不过灵魂就比较难找。

黑鸦堡垒里有一个融合之魂，它由一些迷失的灵魂组成。消灭这个怪物以后，我们应该就可以得到一个合适的灵魂。

english.title: Black Rook Hold: An Unclaimed Soul
english.objectives: Collect an Unclaimed Soul from The Amalgam of Souls in the Black Rook Hold dungeon.
english.description:
In order to create the anchor, we'll need to link something of Shinfel's to an unclaimed soul.

The soul will act like a beacon, guiding Shinfel through the Twisting Nether, and back to Dreadscar Rift.

Shinfel's staff should provide us with the link we need, but the soul will be a bit harder to find. 

Dwelling within Black Rook hold is an amalgam of souls, some lost and forgotten. Killing this monstrosity should provide us with the soul we need.

text.title: 强化灵魂
text.objectives: 通过完成职业大厅任务来收集强化灵魂碎片。
text.description:
这些灵魂碎片所能供应的力量还不足以制造锚点。

恐痕的部队在任务中击败敌人时，可以收集大量的灵魂碎片。只要弄到足够的碎片，我就能用来制造锚点。

english.title: Empowering the Soul
english.objectives: Collect Empowered Soul Shards by completing class hall missions.
english.description:
Creating the anchor will require more power than our soul shards will be able to provide.

Dreadscar's troops are capable of amassing a large amount of soul shards when they defeat enemies while on missions. Once we have enough, I can harvest the supply and use them to craft the anchor.

text.title: 实力派
text.objectives: 点击侦察地图，完成“实力派”任务。
text.description:
若想成功召唤双子，我们需要擅长召唤强力恶魔的术士。

要是召唤者的经验不够，我们恐怕会再失去一名议会成员。

破碎群岛上有不少上好的人选，他们都希望能在这个混乱的年代里一举成名。

希望我们能在他们当中找到值得引荐进议会的人。

english.title: One Who's Worthy
english.objectives: Interact with the Scouting Map and complete the missions, "One Who's Worthy".
english.description:
If we wish to successfully summon the sisters, we'll need the help of a warlock who is skilled in summoning greater demons.

We cannot afford to lose another council member due to inexperience. 

The Broken Isles are swarming with new blood, all hoping to make a name for themselves in this time of chaos. 

Hopefully among them we can find one worthy of this council.

text.title: 喂食血石
text.objectives: 在破碎群岛消灭恶魔并收集他们的血液。
text.description:
等艾瑞达双子被削弱以后，我们可以用血石来控制她们。不过，我们得先给它喂食。

血石在吸收恶魔的血液以后可以变得更加强大。幸运的是，这里有大量的恶魔可以供我们屠戮。

english.title: Let it Feed
english.objectives: Kill demons throughout the Broken Isles and collect their blood.
english.description:
We can use the Bloodstone to control the sisters once they are in a weakened state, but first, we'll need to feed it.

The stone grows in power when consuming the blood of demons. Luckily for us, there's no shortage of demons to kill.

text.title: 地底之王来了
text.objectives: 疏散河湾人民。
text.description: 我得把这些慢吞吞的家伙送到安全的地方去，不过我的速度实在太慢。拿上我的号角，吹响撤离的号令。$B$B我们必须赶在卓格巴尔抵达之前，让所有人离开这里。剩下的事就可以交给武士了。$b$b现在，把他们带到灵魂行者黑角那里。那个傻瓜可以看着他们，直到外面安全为止。
text.completion: The Underking is coming. Best keep that weapon of yours handy in case this does not go well.

english.title: The Underking Comes
english.objectives: Evacuate Riverbend.
english.description: Here, I'm too slow to get these laggards to safety. Take my horn and sound the evacuation.$b$bWe need to get the people out of here before the drogbar arrive. The warbraves can take it from there.$b$bFor now just send them over to Spiritwalker Ebonhorn. That fool can watch over them until it is safe.
english.completion: The Underking is coming. Best keep that weapon of yours handy in case this does not go well.

text.title: 追踪巨虫
text.objectives: 完成“追踪巨虫”任务。
text.description: 我们需要迦拉尔之角，才能迫使奥丁子嗣的大军加入我们的行列。号角被巨虫吞了，我们就算掘地三尺也要把它找出来，从它的肠子里找到号角！

english.title: On the Trail of the Great Worm
english.objectives: Complete the mission "On the Trail of the Great Worm."
english.description: We need the Gjallarhorn to compel the armies of Odyn's children to join our cause. If the great worm swallowed it, we shall dig through the very earth until we find it in its entrails!

text.title: 到山顶去！
text.objectives: 前往高岭峰。
text.description: 你的军队追踪这头野兽一路来到了至高岭的最高峰。$B$B它已无处可逃，但身边跟着保护它的卓格巴尔。你必须亲自出马击杀尤胡塔姆！

english.title: To the Summit!
english.objectives: Go to Highmountain Summit.
english.description: Your armies have tracked the beast to the highest peak in Highmountain.$B$BIt has nowhere left to run, but it is protected by foul drogbar. You must go there yourself and slay Jorhuttam!

objectiveDetails.description: 使渴求法力的雏龙复苏

text.title: 潮汐仪式
text.objectives: 在大漩涡进行潮汐仪式。
text.description: 很久以前，大地之环的首位先知看到了一个关于元素的幻像。$b$b她在幻像中预见了一位新的先知。这位先知将带领我们度过一个重大危机并使各元素实现联合。$b$b$n，我相信你就是预言中的先知，你注定成为我们的领袖。$b$b是时候迎接你的命运了！$b$b你准备好以后我们就进行潮汐仪式，召唤四大元素领主之一，耐普图隆。

english.title: The Ritual of Tides
english.objectives: Perform the Ritual of Tides in the Maelstrom.
english.description: Long ago, the first Farseer of the Earthen Ring was given a vision of the elements.$b$bIn the vision she foresaw the arrival of a new Farseer, one who would lead us through a time of terrible crisis and unite the elements.$b$b$n, I believe that you are the Farseer of this prophecy, called to lead before you were ever born.$b$bThe time has come to fulfill your destiny!$b$bWhen you are ready, we will perform the Ritual of Tides and call upon Neptulon, the first of the four great Elemental Lords.

text.title: 白银之手
text.objectives: 前往提瑞斯法林地的提尔之陨，取回白银之手。
text.description:
有太多的人知道这个位置了，这座坟墓不应该再重见天日。首先，我们必须得到这把战锤。

泰罗索斯派出了一支部队来帮助我们获得战锤，我的一些部下也会在那里与我们汇合。不过，我觉得即使如此，我们的力量也还是不够。你能帮忙真是太好了。

你先从这个传送门去达拉然巨坑，然后飞到提瑞斯法林地和我们汇合吧。我已经在你的地图上把位置标出来了。

english.title: The Silver Hand
english.objectives: Go to Tyr's Fall in Tirisfal Glades and recover the Silver Hand.
english.description:
Too many know of its location, the tomb must be closed forever. First, we must reclaim the hammer.

Tyrosus has lent us a force to aid in the recovery of the hammer, and some of my order will meet us there as well, but I fear even that may not be enough. I'm glad we'll have you with us.

Take the portal to Dalaran Crater, then fly to Tirisfal Glades and meet us. I've marked the location on your map.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵
玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 前往提瑞斯法林地里的标记地点
（可选）使用传送门前往达拉然巨坑

text.title: 黑暗耳语
text.objectives: 使用卡里杜斯的传送门进入邪魂堡垒，并取得堕落者之颅。
text.description: 邪魂堡垒离这不远，不过那里守卫森严。想要闯进去很不容易，卡里杜斯可以帮你秘密潜入！$b$b我们有一个用来聚敛财宝的传送门，你可以通过它进去寻找头颅！

english.title: Dark Whispers
english.objectives: Use Calydus's portal to enter into Felsoul Hold and recover the Skull of the Man'ari.
english.description: Felsoul Hold is not far away, but it is well defended. Very tough to get in the normal way, but Calydus can help you sneak in!$b$bThere is a portal that my kind use to haul in treasures, with it you can get in and find the skull!

objectiveDetails.description: 进入卡里杜斯的恶魔之门

text.title: 大魔法师欧妮娅拉
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图完成任务“欧妮娅拉需要帮助”。
text.description:
我身旁的这个就是侦察地图。通过这个，你就能指派我们的盟友来执行破碎群岛各地重要任务。

第一个任务十分关键。大法师欧妮娅拉，一位知名的召唤师，她在赶来守护者之厅的路上被袭击了。

派出大法师卡雷去帮助他。他格外适合这个任务。

english.title: Archmage Omniara
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Omniara Needs Help"
english.description:
Beside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles.

The first task is critical. Archmage Omniara, a renowned summoner, was on her way to the Hall of Guardians when she was attacked.

Send Archmage Kalecgos to help her. He will be uniquely suited to this task.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“欧妮娅拉需要帮助”任务

text.title: 组建部队
text.objectives: 和大法师欧妮娅拉对话并招募她的水元素。
text.description:
大法师欧妮娅拉是一名极为强大的奥术师，她的能力对我们的组织来说十分重要。$B$B她可以同时召唤多个水元素进行作战！幸好，她同意将她的知识分享给我们。

现在去和她对话，并招募她的元素吧。

english.title: Building Our Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Omniara and recruit some of her Water Elementals
english.description:
Archmage Omniara is a very powerful arcanist and her skills will be quite an asset to our order.$B$BShe is capable of summoning multiple Water Elementals at the same time! Fortunately, she has agreed to share her knowledge with us.

Speak to her now, and recruit her elementals.

text.title: 仪式材料
text.objectives: 在达拉然寻找墓地尘、一罐过热油膏、陈年雪梅白兰地以及鹿血样本。
text.description: 堕落者之颅，不错的选择！它具有强大的力量，而且被比它更加强大的恐惧魔王所使用！$b$b不过它有一个缺点——这颗头骨具有自己的意识！如果我们可以与头骨进行交流，或许我们就能劝说他归服于你！$b$b在我们进行仪式与其沟通之前，我们首先需要从浮空城那里拿到一些材料。新埋墓地的尘土，黑色油脂，还有一份强力的酒精催化剂。$b$b哦，还有血液！我想有一种野兽的血液很适合作为我们的材料。

english.title: Ritual Reagents
english.objectives: Search within Dalaran for Grave Dust, a Can of Overheated Oil, an Aged Snowplum Brandy, and a Stag Blood Sample.
english.description: The Skull of the Man'ari, oh good choice! It's very powerful and it's held by an even more powerful Dreadlord!$b$bThere is a weakness, the skull has a will of its own! If we can commune with the skull we might be able to convince it to serve you instead!$b$bWe will need reagents from the floating city before we can perform the ritual to commune with it. Dust from a fresh grave, dark oil, and a powerful alcohol catalyst.$b$bOh, and blood! I sense a beast whose blood should be perfect.

text.title: 星光吊坠
text.objectives: 从深海女王莎拉萨身上取回星光吊坠，她经常沿着瓦尔莎拉的海岸来回巡视。
text.description: 为了完成我的工作，我需要一件叫做“星光吊坠”的魔法物品。$B$B它是梦境林地的大德鲁伊们代代相传的物品，每一任的守护者都会将它交给自己的继任者。但有一天，一个纳迦海妖利用阴谋诡计夺走了它！$B$B这个吊坠中储存着巨大的奥术能量……而我可以利用它来治愈这片林地。$B$B请将吊坠夺回来，我会非常感激你的！

english.title: The Pendant of Starlight
english.objectives: Retrieve the Pendant of Starlight from Abyssal Queen Sha'rathra, who patrols along the coast of Val'sharah.
english.description: To finish my work here, I will need a magical item called the Pendant of Starlight.$B$BFor centuries, the Archdruids of the Dreamgrove passed the pendant down from one guardian to the next. But one day, a naga siren used deception to take it!$B$BThis pendant stores a great amount of arcane power... power I can use to heal the grove.$B$BGet it back, and I will be very grateful!

text.title: 不速之客
text.objectives: 听不速之客说话。
text.description: 打起精神，$n。我正在侦测房间里形成的一股奇怪的魔力。有什么东西正在试图进入。

english.title: Unexpected Visitors
english.objectives: Listen to your unexpected visitors.
english.description: Brace yourself, $n. I am detecting a strange magic forming in the chamber. Something is projecting itself in.

text.title: 水到渠成
text.objectives: 招募食魂者阿莱利和杰斯·织暗成为你的勇士。
text.description:
我猜你已经知道我想跟你说什么……我们早该让阿莱利和杰斯成为你的勇士。

他们在策划和实施入侵尼斯卡拉的过程中发挥了巨大的作用。他们当之无愧，而且你很难再找到这么优秀的勇士。

english.title: Last, But Not Least
english.objectives: Recruit Allari the Souleater and Jace Darkweaver as your champions.
english.description:
I think you already know what I am going to tell you... It is well past time to make Allari and Jace your champions.

The two of them were instrumental in the planning and preparation for the invasion of Niskara. They have earned it and you would be hard pressed to find better champions anywhere.

text.title: 当日即达
text.objectives: 回神射手营地找伊墨瑞尔·影卫。
text.description: 我为这些武器施加的附魔可以破解地狱犬的魔法免疫特性。而且只要击中它们，金属就能刺穿外皮的鳞片，好让你的盟友对恶魔造成进一步的伤害。$B$B虽然附魔效果不会逐渐消失，不过你还是应该立刻把武器送到需要的人手里。如果拖得越久，武器的力量就会引来越多的恶魔。

english.title: Same Day Delivery
english.objectives: Return to Emmarel Shadewarden at Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: I've enchanted these weapons to counter the natural resistances that felhounds have to magic. In addition to that, the metal should splinter their scales on impact, allowing your allies to do increased damage to the demons.$B$BWhile I don't expect the enchantment to decay over time, you should do your best to deliver these weapons to those who will use them immediately. The longer they remain here, the more demons their power will attract.

text.title: 不断壮大
text.objectives: 与征募官辛普森谈一谈。
text.description: 征募官辛普森是一位杰出的追捕大师，他的才能让我们的勇士如虎添翼。$B$B他对动物很有一套，能够轻松召唤它们助阵。事实上，他已经开始用自己追捕并驯服的动物充实兽栏。$B$B现在，去跟他谈一谈。

english.title: Recruiting More Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Recruiter Sampson.
english.description: Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Sampson, an extraordinary tracker.$B$BHe has a way with animals, calling them to his side with the utmost ease. In fact, he's already beginning to fill the stables with animals that he has tracked and tamed.$B$BSpeak to him now.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募半兽人迦罗娜和梵妮莎·范克里夫成为你的第一批勇士。
text.description:
无冕者行事于幕后，在世界各地执行任务。总之，就是以最为优雅的方式在正确的时间作出正确的决定。

我们一致认为，你应该招募一些影行者，并派遣他们去执行我们最为重要的任务。你需要一些值得信赖的人，至少是能够确保完成任务的人。

依我的建议，你看迦罗娜和梵妮莎怎么样？不管怎么样，考虑到最近发生的事情，这将会非常有趣。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Garona Halforcen and Vanessa VanCleef as your first champions.
english.description:
The Uncrowned work behind the scenes, pulling strings here, snipping others there. It's a matter of making the right choices at the right time in the most elegant manner possible.

We have all decided that you need to recruit some Shadows to send out on our most important missions. People that you can trust, or at least that you can trust to get the job done.

Might I suggest that you start with Garona and Vanessa? It should prove interesting if nothing else considering recent events.

text.title: 恶上加恶
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“恶上加恶”任务。
text.description:
有传闻说你想要招募一些，怎么说呢，比较彪悍的人？

我认识一个这样的女人！不，我不是说我自己……虽然，我也可以表现出凶悍的一面，但还是比不过洛妮卡·静刃。

没错，就是那个洛妮卡，在沙塔斯城里开设“盗贼学校”的家伙。

我们把梵妮莎派到外域去吧，让她找洛妮卡“聊聊”。或者，你懂的，给洛妮卡一个响亮的头衔，再帮她把盗贼学校搬到更好的地方。

english.title: A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "A More Wretched Hive of Scum and Villainy".
english.description:
Word on the street is that you're lookin' to recruit some more, shall we say, unsavory types?

I know just the woman! No, not me... though, I could prolly do it. But not as well as Lonika Stillblade.

Yeah, that Lonika. The one who founded the 'School of Roguery' in Shattrath City.

So, let's send Vanessa there out to Outland and have her make Lonika an offer she can't refuse. Or, you know, give her a legit job and a nicer location for her rogue academy.

text.title: 召唤师摩恩
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“摩尔需要帮助”。
text.description: 我们的组织已经招募到了一些勇士，现在可以利用侦察地图来完成破碎群岛各地的重要任务。$B$B我们的第一个任务十分关键。召唤师摩恩是一位著名的元素生物大师。他在前往艾泽拉斯之心的途中遭到了袭击。$B$B我建议派出风暴召唤者米尔拉去救援他。她极其适合执行此次任务。

english.title: Summoner Morn
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Morn Needs Help".
english.description: Now that we have recruited champions of our order, we can use the Scouting Map to complete vital assignments across the Broken Isles.$B$BThe first assignment is critical. Summoner Morn, a renowned master of the elementals, was on his way to the Heart of Azeroth when he was attacked.$B$BI suggest we send Stormcaller Mylra to help him. She will be uniquely suited to this task.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“摩恩需要帮助”任务

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与召唤师摩恩谈一谈，并召唤一个小型元素。
text.description: 召唤师摩恩是一位强大的萨满，他的天赋让我们的勇士如虎添翼。$B$B他与大地有着紧密的联系，对我们的组织十分重要。他已经开始训练小型元素为我们作战。$B$B现在，去跟他谈谈并训练一个小型元素。

english.title: Recruiting The Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Summoner Morn and summon a Lesser Elemental.
english.description: Our champions acquired the talents of Summoner Morn, a powerful shaman.$B$BHe is known for his strong affinity with earth, and is a valuable addition to our Order. He is already beginning to requisition Lesser Elementals to our cause.$B$BSpeak to him now and train a Lesser Elemental.

text.title: 第一次接触
text.objectives: 在大步道与凡瑟尔谈一谈。
text.description: 是时候试试你的新伪装了。$B$B你首先要接触的是平民区的商人，凡瑟尔。他今天在大步道拜访一个供货商。$B$B叫凡瑟尔来找我，我要跟他谈谈暮色百合豆荚运输的事情。他会明白的。$B$B除此之外，我们还需要一些准备时间。你应该回去找塔莉萨。$B$B<莉莉丝递给你一个塞着木塞的瓶子，里面装着微微发光的液体。>$B$B把这个给她，替我问声好。我们很快会联系你的。

english.title: First Contact
english.objectives: Speak with Vanthir in The Grand Promenade.
english.description: Time to put your new disguise to the test.$B$BYour first contact is Vanthir, a merchant from the common district. He is in the Grand Promenade today visiting one of his suppliers.$B$BTell Vanthir to pay me a visit regarding a shipment of dusk lily bulbs. He will understand.$B$BBeyond that, we will need time to prepare. You should return to Thalyssra.$B$B<Ly'leth hands you a corked bottle of faintly glowing fluid.>$B$BGive her this, with my regards. We will call upon you soon.

text.title: 不应分享的知识
text.objectives: 收集5本苍穹邪能宝典。
text.description: 我发现很多苍穹会的书籍中都铭刻了邪能魔法。这真是一种亵渎。我们必须尽可能多地没收它们。

english.title: Some Knowledge Shouldn't Be Shared
english.objectives: Collect 5 Empyrean Fel Tomes.
english.description: I noticed that quite a few of the Empyrean Society's books are inscribed with fel magic. That's blasphemous. We must confiscate as many as we can.

text.title: 创造者的车间
text.objectives: 协助米米尔隆。
text.description: 我的远程监视转播器从那座墓穴收集到大量的数据。$B$B如果可以把信息下载到我的中央处理系统里，我应该就能找到泰坦之击……还有那个拿走它的混蛋维库人。$B$B既然你人都来了，应该不会介意帮个忙吧？因为信息量过于庞大，处理的时候难免会让一些安全机制过载。我知道你很能干！

english.title: The Creator's Workshop
english.objectives: Assist Mimiron.
english.description: My remote observation relay captured an astonishing amount of data from that tomb.$B$BIf we can download its memory to my core processing systems, I should be able to locate Titanstrike... and that unsavory vrykul who took it.$B$BSince you're here, would you mind helping out? Processing that much information might overload a few failsafe mechanisms here and there, and I know you're the capable sort!

objectiveDetails.description: Defeat or Capture a Juvenile Scuttleback
Defeat or Capture an Olivetail Hare

text.title: 有什么企图？
text.objectives: 询问5名苍穹会成员，并调查他们的营地。
text.description:
我们对苍穹会在这里的活动知之甚少，但现在你伪装成了一个新兵，你就能问些问题，然后四处查找一下大法师瓦格斯检测到的古怪魔法。

之后我们在山上的圆形建筑里会合。

english.title: What Is Going On Here?
english.objectives: Question 5 Empyrean Society members and investigate their grounds.
english.description:
We don't know much about the Empyrean Society's activities here, but now that you appear to be a new recruit you should be able to ask some questions and take a look around for the strange magic Archmage Vargoth detected. 

Let's meet up at the rotunda on the hill.

text.title: 窥探黑暗
text.objectives: 进行仪式，与堕落者之颅交流并说服它告诉你它的位置。
text.description:
朋友，现在可以开始仪式了！

记住，朋友，必须让头颅心甘情愿地投靠你。如果我们强迫它屈服的话，它的力量就会弱很多。

english.title: Looking into the Darkness
english.objectives: Perform the ritual to commune with the Skull of the Man'ari and convince it to tell you its location.
english.description:
Friend now is ready to perform the ritual!

Remember, friend, the skull must be convinced that it is in its best interest to be in your possession. If we must force the skull into your servitude, it would be far weaker.

objectiveDetails.description: 找到堕落者之颅的位置
解救被禁锢的堕夜精灵

text.title: 织梦者
text.objectives: 完成瓦尔莎拉的任意4个世界任务。
text.description: 帮助瓦尔莎拉的德鲁伊完成4个世界任务。
text.completed: 回瓦尔莎拉找西尔维娅·鹿角。

english.title: The Dreamweavers
english.objectives: Complete any 4 world quests in Val'sharah.
english.description: Assist the Druids of Val'sharah by completing 4 world quests.
english.completed: Return to Sylvia Hartshorn in Val'Sharah.

objectiveDetails.description: 在瓦尔莎拉完成4个世界任务

text.title: 最后出口
text.objectives: 使用开启符文打开苍穹会建筑的大门。
text.description:
我们已经削减了苍穹会成员的数量。而且他们这阵子是没办法再招兵买马了。

还剩一个地方没有调查，我觉得我们找到的符文就是开门的关键。去看看里面到底有什么。

english.title: Final Exit
english.objectives: Use the Rune of Opening to unlock the Empyrean Society building door.
english.description:
We've certainly reduced the Empyrean Society's numbers. I don't think they'll be luring any more members to their cause for a while. 

There's only one place we haven't investigated, and I suspect that rune we found is attuned to the door. Let's see what's inside the building.

objectiveDetails.description: 喂养贪吃的风暴之翼雏龙

text.title: 力量增长
text.objectives: 在守护者圣殿中与梅瑞尔·邪风会面。
text.description: 你变得更加强大了，而提瑞斯秘法会需要你的帮助，$n。等你的这段冒险结束之后，就来守护者圣殿找我吧。

english.title: Growing Power
english.objectives: Meet Meryl Felstorm in the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description: The Tirisgarde has need of your help now that you have grown in strength, $n. Meet me in the Hall of the Guardian when you are done with your adventures.

objectiveDetails.description: 施放法术“传送：守护者圣殿”
消灭被遗忘者亡灵骑兵

text.title: 任务：元素外交
text.objectives: 成功完成“元素外交”任务。
text.description: 潮汐之王已经与大地之环结盟，不过我们还需要联合其余的几位元素领主。$b$b至于下一步行动，我已经制定了一个出使天空之墙的外交任务。$b$b此次任务的目的在于探明天空之墙在风元素领主奥拉基尔战败以后的状况，并找到任何愿意帮助我们的元素。$b$b现在就等你的指示了。

english.title: Mission: Elemental Diplomacy
english.objectives: Successfully complete the "Elemental Diplomacy" mission.
english.description: The Lord of Tides has united with the Earthen Ring, but the matter of uniting the remaining Elemental Lords still remains.$b$bFor the next step of our campaign, I have organized a diplomatic mission to Skywall.$b$bThe goal of the mission is to ascertain the current political situation in Skywall, following the defeat of Al'Akir the Windlord, and to identify any elementals who would aid our cause.$b$bThe mission is currently waiting your assignment.

text.title: 猎人永不孤单
text.objectives: 在风暴神殿寻找托里姆并取得泰坦之击。
text.description: 普斯塔佳肯定正在赶往风暴神殿，那是我将雷霆之火灌入泰坦之击的地方。$B$B据我猜测，她是想逆转进程并把雷霆之火灌入自己体内，从而获得天神的力量！$B$B希望托里姆没有离开，又去折腾他那些狼。如果普斯塔佳还有本地维库人的支持，事情可就麻烦了。

english.title: Never Hunt Alone
english.objectives: Seek out Thorim at the Temple of Storms and recover Titanstrike.
english.description: Prustaga is almost certainly on her way to the Temple of Storms, which is where I imbued Titanstrike with the Thunderspark.$B$BIf my deductions are correct, she'll attempt to reverse the process and infuse the spark into herself, thus attaining the godlike power she craves!$B$BHopefully Thorim isn't off cavorting with his hounds again. If Prustaga has the local vrykul on her side, things may get... complicated.

text.title: 力量增长
text.objectives: 与迷踪岛的金刚不坏彭戍对话。
text.description: 金刚不坏彭戍希望见你。$B$B我们的破碎群岛防御战正在进行，迷踪岛那里需要你的指挥。

english.title: Growing Power
english.objectives: Speak to Iron-Body Ponshu at the Wandering Isle.
english.description: Iron-Body Ponshu has requested your presence.$B$BOur campaign to defend the Broken Isles is getting under way, and we need you back at the Wandering Isle.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募陈·风暴烈酒和丽丽·风暴烈酒，然后与许大师谈一谈。
text.description: 晴日峰还没有从攻击中复原。$B$B我们应该招揽最厉害的武僧与我们并肩作战，帮忙重建我们的组织。$B$B我知道陈·风暴烈酒和丽丽·风暴烈酒这两位勇士一定愿意加入我们。找他们聊聊，将他们招入麾下，然后去找许大师谈谈。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Enlist Chen Stormstout and Li Li Stormstout, then speak to Master Hsu.
english.description: We are still recovering from the attack at the Peak of Serenity.$B$BTo help us rebuild the order, we should enlist the greatest champions of our class to fight by our side.$B$BI know that the two Stormstouts, Chen and Li Li, would eagerly pledge to join the cause. Speak to them and recruit them as champions, then speak to Master Hsu.

text.title: 努波顿在等待
text.objectives: 在艾泽拉斯之心与努波顿谈一谈。
text.description: 努波顿和大地之环的其他勇士已经在下方聚集。他们在等你，先知。$b$b他们即将进行一个重要仪式，并且请求你到场。管理方面的问题你不用担心，我会处理好这里的事务。$b$b努波顿正在等你。愿元素与你同在，先知。

english.title: Nobundo Awaits
english.objectives: Speak with Nobundo in the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: Nobundo and the other champions of the Earthen Ring have gathered down below. They are awaiting your arrival, Farseer.$b$bA great ritual is about to take place and they have requested your presence. Do not worry about your administrative duties for now, I'll take care of things here.$b$bNobundo is waiting for you now. May the elements be with you, Farseer.

objectiveDetails.description: Capture or Defeat a Spring Strider
Capture or Defeat a Shimmering Aquafly
Capture or Defeat a Vale Flitter

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 与贾九鹤对话。
text.description: 谢谢你，残寺派正在逐渐重整旗鼓。$B$B不过，我们还有许多事情要做。作为我们的领袖，你将决定我们的未来。$B$B请和贾九鹤谈一谈吧。她会为你指点迷津。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Number Nine Jia.
english.description: Thanks to you, the Order of the Broken Temple is gradually re-assembling.$B$BHowever, there is much more work to do. As our leader, you can determine the trajectory of our order's future.$B$BSpeak to Number Nine Jia. She will show you the ropes.

text.title: 迦拉尔之角
text.objectives: 找到瑟维甘·风篷。
text.description: 你一次次地证明了自己的能力，$n。毫无疑问，你是领导奥丁的军队，迎接最后战役的最佳人选。$B$B你必须先取得迦拉尔之角，才能警告我们的盟友，最后的时刻已经来临。$B$B瑟维甘·风篷是最后一位号角守护者。$B$B到风暴峡湾的陨落诸王之地找到他的灵魂，看看你会有什么发现。

english.title: The Gjallarhorn
english.objectives: Find Svergan Stormcloak.
english.description: You have proven yourself most thoroughly time and again, $n. There can be no doubt that you are the one to lead Odyn's armies into the final battle.$B$BYou must first obtain the Gjallarhorn so that you may signal to our allies that the end times are upon us.$B$BKing Svergan Stormcloak was the last known living guardian of the horn.$B$BSeek his spirit in the Field of Fallen Kings in Stormheim and see what you can learn.

text.title: 失落的荣誉
text.objectives: 瑟维甘·风篷要你在符文林地取得失落君王之冠、蔽风之印，以及龙骑士的勋章。
text.description: 守护迦拉尔之角是我的职责，$r。为此，我会倾尽全力，不过我现在需要你的帮助。$B$B当年，我的家族遭到秘法师的诋毁，这片墓地也被洗劫一空。$B$B我们的传家宝落到了邪恶神王的仆从手里，让我无法安息。$B$B如果把它们带回我的手中，我就协助你寻找迦拉尔之角！

english.title: Stolen Honor
english.objectives: Svergan Stormcloak wants you to obtain the Crown of the Forgotten King, the Stormcloak Signet and the Drakerider's Medallion in the Runewood.
english.description: Safeguarding the Gjallarhorn was my duty, $r. I will do what is right, but first I must ask for your aid.$B$BMy family was disavowed by the mystics of our time and this grave was ransacked.$B$BI cannot find peace while my family heirlooms are in the hands of the servants of the false God-King.$B$BReturn them to me and I will aid you in finding the Gjallarhorn!

text.title: 勇士：风暴召唤者米尔拉
任务：调查深岩之洲
text.objectives: 成功完成“调查深岩之洲”任务。
text.description: 如果大地之环要联合四大元素领主共同对抗燃烧军团，我们就必须说服石母塞拉赞恩加入。$b$b到现在为止，塞拉赞恩一直没有出席过我们与元素的谈判。$b$b据说，深岩之洲内部出现了一个新的威胁。如果这些传言是真的，那么她就需要我们的帮助。$b$b为了探明那里的情况，我制定了一个出使深岩之洲的外交任务。就等你安排了。

english.title: Mission: Investigating Deepholm
english.objectives: Successfully complete the "Investigating Deepholm" mission.
english.description: In order for the Earthen Ring to bring the four Elemental Lords together in an alliance against the Burning Legion, we will need to convince Therazane the Stonemother to join forces with us.$b$bTherazane has been absent from our negotiations with the elements thus far.$b$bThere have been whispers of a new threat arising from within Deepholm. If these rumors are true, she may have need of our aid.$b$bI have prepared a diplomatic mission to Deepholm to ascertain the situation. It is awaiting your assignment.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“调查深岩之洲”任务

text.title: 寒冰复仇
text.objectives: 在高岭峰消灭残酷的多古布、乌古尔·斩颅和8个霜崖卓格巴尔。
text.description: 我的村子遭到了一个卓格巴尔部族的屠戮，这个部族信仰的正是你所寻找的那头野兽。没有人幸免于难。$B$B如果你愿意为我的族人复仇，我就会帮你找到尤胡塔姆。

english.title: Revenge, Served Cold
english.objectives: Slay Dogrub the Cruel, Urgrul Skullcleaver and 8 Frostcrag Drogbar in Highmountain Summit.
english.description: My village was razed by a drogbar tribe who worships the very beast you seek. No one was spared.$B$BHelp me avenge my people and I will aid you in your quest to find Jorhuttam.

text.title: 尤胡塔姆
text.objectives: 在尤胡塔姆的进食点附近使用霜崖战鼓，并击杀尤胡塔姆，取得迦拉尔之角。
text.description: 既然你兑现了承诺，我也会遵守诺言。$B$B这些霜崖战鼓就交给你。敲响战鼓就可以召唤尤胡塔姆来进食。$B$B找到巨虫的进食点，用战鼓把它引出来。

english.title: Jorhuttam
english.objectives: Use the Frostcrag Drums near Jorhuttam's Feeding Mound and slay Jorhuttam to obtain the Gjallarhorn.
english.description: You upheld your end of your promise. I will do the same.$B$BTake these drogbar drums. Then bang on them to call upon Jorhuttam to feast.$B$BFind the Great Worm's feeding mound and use the drums to lure her out.

text.title: 打击升级
text.objectives: 消灭10名苍穹会成员。
text.description:
苍穹会比看起来还要危险。竟然有法师在研究邪能魔法，简直无法想象，那可是术士和燃烧军团的强项！

看来你的朋友拉文德维尔赶不上了，我们只能自己解决问题。我们应该铲除邪教，让他们再也无法祸害其他人。

english.title: The Next Level Has Arrived
english.objectives: Kill 10 Empyrean Society members.
english.description:
The Empyrean Society is certainly much more dangerous than they appear. It's unimaginable that any mage would study fel magic -- that's for warlocks and the Legion!

Since our friend, Ravandwyr, appears to be delayed, it looks like we'll have to deal with this ourselves. We should remove this sect so they can't corrupt anyone else.

text.title: 重返火焰之地
text.objectives: 完成“重返火焰之地”任务。
text.description: 该是重返火焰之地的时候了。不用我说你也应该知道这有多危险，先知。$b$b虽然拉格纳罗斯已经战败，但是火焰之地的元素仍在肆意横行。我们的出现一定会被视为一种侵略。$b$b我制定了一个火焰之地的侦察任务。我们应该派出最优秀的勇士与那里的元素进行接触。$b$b如果任务取得成功，我们或许可以收集到必要的情报，帮助我们与火焰之地结盟。

english.title: Return to the Firelands
english.objectives: Complete the "Return to the Firelands" missions.
english.description: The time has come to return to the Firelands. I need not tell you how dangerous this will be, Farseer.$b$bRagnaros may be defeated, but the elementals of the Firelands destroy with reckless abandon. Our presence there will surely be seen as an act of aggression.$b$bI have prepared a scouting mission to the Firelands. We should send only our very best champions to make contact with the elements there.$b$bIf the mission is successful, we may find the information we need to bring the Firelands into our fold.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“重返火焰之地”任务

text.title: 知识卷轴
text.objectives: 完成任务“知识卷轴”。
text.description: 我们的部队已经就位！是时候让他们接受战场的检验了，而且我有个任务正好适合他们。$B$B贾九鹤是位广受尊敬的学者。她拥有的知识能够帮助我们的组织成长。然而，她的许多非常重要的卷轴在遭到袭击的时候被留在了晴日峰。$B$B立刻派出我们的勇士去回收这些文档！

english.title: Scrolls of Knowledge
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "Scrolls of Knowledge."
english.description: Our troops are ready! It's time to test them out in the field, and I have the perfect assignment.$B$BNumber Nine Jia is a well-respected scholar. She has knowledge that can help us improve the order, however, many  of her important scrolls were left behind during the attack on the Peak of Serenity.$B$BSend our champions to retrieve these documents at once!

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：高戈奈斯潮汐之石
text.objectives: 使用达拉然的中央传送器，把高戈奈斯潮汐之石放到守护者大厅的画像室里。
text.description: <你已经击败艾萨拉之怒并取得潮汐之石，是时候把它放到达拉然地下守护者大厅的画像室里了。>

english.title: Eye of Azshara: The Tidestone of Golganneth
english.objectives: Use the central teleporter in Dalaran and then place the Tidestone of Golganneth in the Portrait Room of the Chamber of the Guardian.
english.description: <Now that you have defeated Queen Azshara's Wrath and have the Tidestone in hand, it is time to place it in the Portrait Room of the Chamber of the Guardian in lower Dalaran.>

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达拉然的中央传送器

text.title: 强夺手镯
text.objectives: 收集$1oa个盐目手镯。
text.description: 既然你这么关注鱼人……$b$b许多鱼人会佩戴珠宝来吸引配偶。我敢打赌，他们的珠宝会让我们派上用场。$b$b帮我收集一些他们的珠宝。越是湿漉漉的就越好！

english.title: Knocked for a Loop
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Salteye Bangles.
english.description: While you're focused on murlocs...$b$bMany murlocs are known to wear jewelry to attract a mate. I'm willing to bet that we can use some of the same jewels they use.$b$bCollect some of their jewelry and bring it back to me. The wetter, the better!

text.title: 烧焦的信件
text.objectives: 将3份银色药膏和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗邪灼斥候。
text.description: 希望能有合适的人看到这封信。以我这倒霉劲，说不定信就被什么怪物给吃掉了。$b$b如果你看到我的留言，请带一些东西来治疗我的烧伤。真的很痛。很痛。

english.title: Singed Letter
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silvery Salves and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Felburned Scout when you arrive.
english.description: I pray this letter makes it into the right hands. Knowing my luck, it'll probably wind up in the stomach of some creature.$b$bIf you're reading this, then please bring something to treat my burns. They really hurt. A lot.

objectiveDetails.description: 治疗被邪火烧伤的斥候

text.title: 沉船水手
text.objectives: 为$1oa名女王的复仇号水手终结痛苦。
text.description:
<玛拉纳的海地精和龙虾人从附近的沉船处抓走了被遗忘者水手。>

<水手们似乎受到了毒害，或许他们的境况比这更糟。你应该终结他们的痛苦。>
text.completion: <In the end, it was all for the best.>

english.title: Shipwrecked Sailors
english.objectives: Put $1oa Queen's Reprisal Sailors out of their misery.
english.description:
<The gilblin and makrura of Mak'rana have captured the forsaken sailors from the nearby shipwreck.>

<It looks like the sailors are being poisoned and worse. Best to put them out of their misery.>
english.completion: <In the end, it was all for the best.>

objectiveDetails.description: 消灭女王的复仇号水手

text.title: 苍穹会报告
text.objectives: 返回守护者圣殿。
text.description:
大法师瓦格斯竟然跟这种邪教组织有关系，真是难以置信！他最好为来这里的原因给个合理的解释……

不管怎么说，我们最好能回到守护者圣殿，把我们发现的事情告诉梅瑞尔。

english.title: Empyrean Society Report
english.objectives: Return to the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description:
I find it hard to believe that Archmage Vargoth would be involved with such a malevolent group! There must be a good explanation for why he's been here... 

Regardless, we had best return to the Hall of the Guardian and inform Meryl about what we've uncovered here.

objectiveDetails.description: 施放法术“传送：守护者圣殿”

text.title: 侦察深红林地
text.objectives: 在晨曦裂口寻找莉莉娅·晨风。
text.description: 如果你要去东边的话，我想请你帮个忙。$b$b我们拔营的同时，有一部分车队留下来绕城巡视。莉莉娅·晨风出去太久了。$b$b如果你能去看看她的情况，我将感激不尽。她之前说要去侦察晨曦裂口的废墟。
text.end: 在晨曦裂口寻找莉莉娅·晨风。

english.title: Scouting the Crimson Thicket
english.objectives: Find Lilryia Dawnwind in Dawncleft.
english.description: If you are heading east, there is something I would ask of you.$b$bWhile we struck camp some of our caravan left to scout around the city. Lilryia Dawnwind has been gone too long.$b$bI would be most grateful if you would go check on her safety. She said she was going to scout out the ruins of Dawncleft.

text.title: 月影里的秘密
text.objectives: 探索月影圣殿。
text.description:
我不知道泰林发现了什么，但我知道这件事发生的地点。

月影圣殿，就在这里的西边。在法尔多拉神殿更远一些的地方。

不管是什么力量改变了泰林的奥术精华……不管是什么力量让凯尔丹纳斯创造出了能够安抚枯法者的咒语……它的本源就在那里。

如果有人亲自去那里一看，也会得到和我相同的见解。

english.title: Cloaked in Moonshade
english.objectives: Explore Moonshade Sanctum.
english.description:
I do not know what Theryn found, but I know where he found it. 

Moonshade Sanctum, to the west. Beyond the Temple of Fal'adora. 

Whatever power altered Theryn's arcane essence... Whatever power allowed Kel'danath to create a spell to soothe the withered... Its source rests there. 

I know this as surely as if I had been there myself.

text.title: 解除封印
text.objectives: 解除潮汐封印、大地封印和天空封印。
text.description:
<在你注视着这件圣物的同时，塔莉萨的声音在你的脑海中回响起来。>

你找到它了！但它被牢固地封印了起来。

我们得想办法解除这些封印。

english.title: Breaking the Seal
english.objectives: Break the Seal of the Tides, Seal of the Earth and Seal of the Sky.
english.description:
<As you behold the relic, Thalyssra's voice echoes in your mind.>

You found it! But it is sealed away tight.

Search the room for a way to break those seals.

text.title: 月影秘地
text.objectives: 击杀一只法多雷撒网者、一只法多雷唤巢者和一只法多雷寡妇蛛。
text.description: <鼓捣圣物发出的动静引来了法兰纳尔地下的可怕生物。>

english.title: Moonshade Holdout
english.objectives: Slay a Fal'dorei Webslinger, a Fal'dorei Broodcaller, and a Fal'dorei Widowmaker.
english.description: <Tampering with the relic has drawn the attention of some hideous creatures from beneath Falanaar.>

text.title: 深入裂缝
text.objectives: 跟随山谷行者法罗丁进入法兰纳尔隧道。
text.description: 我保护那颗种子已经一万年了。你却让它落入了法多雷之手。$B$B我真该让你死在那里。$B$B但我给你一个将功补过的机会。帮我把种子夺回来。

english.title: Into the Crevasse
english.objectives: Follow Valewalker Farodin into the Falanaar Tunnels.
english.description: I have protected that seed for ten thousand years. You let it fall into the hands of the fal'dorei.$B$BI should have let you die.$B$BRepay your debt. Help me get the seed back.

text.title: 隐藏的城市
text.objectives: 在法兰纳尔隧道中追踪欧拉希斯，并将她击败。
text.description: 欧拉希斯低估了种子。种子在吸取她的力量，令她行动迟缓。$B$B我们必须追上她，并将种子带到安全的地方！

english.title: The Hidden City
english.objectives: Follow Orathiss through Falanaar Tunnels and slay her.
english.description: Orathiss has underestimated the seed. It is sapping her power - slowing her down.$B$BWe must catch her and get the seed to safety!

text.title: 沙尔艾兰
text.objectives: 跟随塔莉萨探索沙尔艾兰。
text.description:
前面的房间或许是个绝佳的躲藏地点，那里的守卫都被解决掉了。

跟我来。

english.title: Shal'Aran
english.objectives: Follow Thalyssra while she explores Shal'Aran.
english.description:
The chamber beyond may be the perfect hiding place, now that its guardian has been dealt with.

Come with me.

text.title: 山谷行者的重担
text.objectives: 在法尔多拉神殿里激活法尔多拉道标。
text.description:
种子即将觉醒。没有力量，它很快就会枯死。

我们得带着种子离开这里，并把它种在安全的地方。

我力量不够强，承受不了这个重担。不过你……浑身充盈着力量。我能感觉到。

请拿上种子。

english.title: The Valewalker's Burden
english.objectives: Activate the Fal'adora Beacon in Temple of Fal'adora.
english.description:
The seed is awakening. Without power it will quickly wither and die.

We must carry the seed out of here and plant it somewhere safe.

I am not strong enough to bear this burden. But you... you are brimming with power. I can sense it. 

Please take the seed.

text.title: 神秘的圣骑士
text.objectives: 在达拉然与塔瓦德谈一谈。
text.description: 看来我们遇上了一个难得的机会。$b$b有一小队圣骑士声称自己知道提尔之墓的位置！他们还说自己是提尔战锤的守护者，不过那把古老的武器最近陷入了纷争。$b$b我要你去跟他们的首领塔瓦德谈谈，了解神器的更多事情。
text.completion: My order guards a powerful secret. We are the keepers of the final resting place of the mighty Tyr!$b$bRecent intrusions have proven his tomb's location to be a secret no longer. We must protect the sacred relic stored there... the Silver Hand!

english.title: The Mysterious Paladin
english.objectives: Speak with Travard in Dalaran.
english.description: It appears we have been afforded a unique opportunity.$b$bA small order of paladins has come forward claiming to know the location of Tyr's tomb. They say they are the protectors of his warhammer, but that the ancient weapon is now imperiled.$b$bI'd like you to speak with Travard, their leader, to find out more about this artifact.
english.completion: My order guards a powerful secret. We are the keepers of the final resting place of the mighty Tyr!$b$bRecent intrusions have proven his tomb's location to be a secret no longer. We must protect the sacred relic stored there... the Silver Hand!

text.title: 高岭诸族
text.objectives: 完成至高岭的任意4个世界任务。
text.description: 帮助至高岭的牛头人完成4个世界任务。
text.completed: 回至高岭的雷霆图腾找兰莎·灰羽。

english.title: Highmountain Tribes
english.objectives: Complete any 4 world quests in Highmountain.
english.description: Assist the Tauren of Highmountain by completing 4 world quests.
english.completed: Return to Ransa Greyfeather at Thunder Totem in Highmountain.

objectiveDetails.description: 在至高岭完成4个世界任务

text.title: 瓦拉加尔
text.objectives: 完成风暴峡湾的任意4个世界任务。
text.description: 帮助风暴峡湾的维库人完成4个世界任务。
text.completed: 回风暴峡湾找瓦德玛尔·逐风。

english.title: The Valarjar
english.objectives: Complete any 4 world quests in Stormheim.
english.description: Assist the Vry'kul of Stormheim by completing 4 world quests.
english.completed: Return to Valdemar Stormseeker in Stormheim.

objectiveDetails.description: 在风暴峡湾完成4个世界任务

text.title: 失踪恶魔
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳寻找达格洛普。
text.description: 我好像把我的小鬼达格洛普弄丢了。$b$b如果你看到他，就叫他来找我。$b$b通常来说，我重新召唤一下就可以，不过我怕这个瞎子马瑞斯会来个先斩后奏。$b$b他看不见，很麻烦。
text.completion: Yeah yeah, the new master sent you. I get it. I have to deal with my former master first.
text.completed: 在奥利维安影障与达格洛普谈一谈。

english.title: Missing Demon
english.objectives: Find Daglop in Azsuna.
english.description: I seem to have misplaced my imp, Daglop.$b$bIf you see him, tell him to check in.$b$bNormally I would just resummon him but I'm worried blind Marius here will kill him first and ask questions later.$b$bNo vision, that one.
english.completion: Yeah yeah, the new master sent you. I get it. I have to deal with my former master first.
english.completed: Speak with Daglop in the Olivian Veil.

text.title: Halls of Valor: The Bear King

english.title: Halls of Valor: The Bear King

text.title: Halls of Valor: A Worthy Challenge

english.title: Halls of Valor: A Worthy Challenge

text.title: Halls of Valor: A Gift for Vethir

english.title: Halls of Valor: A Gift for Vethir
Halls of Valor: Deeds of the Past

text.title: 女王的复仇号的命运
text.objectives: 前往达拉然，把船长日志交给风行者圣殿的顾问斯蒂沃特。
text.description: <这种消息应该汇报上去。或许在达拉然的风行者圣殿会有人知道该怎么处理。>

english.title: Fate of the Queen's Reprisal
english.objectives: Take the Captain's Log to Advisor Stillwater at the Windrunner's Sanctuary on Dalaran.
english.description: <This is the kind of intelligence that should be shared. Perhaps someone at the Windrunner's Sanctuary on Dalaran will know what to do with it.>

text.title: 烧焦的纸条
text.objectives: 将3份银色药膏和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗邪灼斥候。
text.description: 如果你能看到这张纸条，拜托你帮帮忙。我在和军团作战时被严重烧伤。$b$b我就在倾颓王宫附近，大概位置已经画出来了。$b$b请抓紧时间，务必带上医疗补给。

english.title: Singed Note
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silvery Salves and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Felburned Scout when you arrive.
english.description: Please, if you're reading this then there still may be time. I was badly burned fighting the Legion.$b$bI've included a rough sketch of where I am relative to the Crumbled Palace.$b$bPlease hurry, and bring supplies.

objectiveDetails.description: 治疗被邪火烧伤的斥候

text.title: 高烧患者的祈求
text.objectives: 将3个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗发烧的探险者。
text.description: 我快支撑不下去了。而且，这里实在太热，我已经开始出现幻觉。$b$b如果有人看到这封信，请一定来帮帮我。圣光在上，别忘了带上医疗补给。$b$b我好像看到死亡之翼来了……$b$b<文字的最后一笔一直划到了纸条底端。>

english.title: Fevered Plea
english.objectives: Bring 3 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Fevered Explorer when you arrive.
english.description: I can't take this exhaustion any longer. And the heat of this place is making me see things.$b$bPlease, if someone finds this message, look for me. And bring medicine for Light's sake.$b$bI think I see Deathwing coming...$b$b<The ink on the last letter falls down to the bottom of the note.>

text.title: 染血的便条
text.objectives: 将3份丝纹绷带和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗重伤的士兵。
text.description: 不知道我还能把伤口压多久。$b$b如果你看到这张便条，请务必为我带来绷带。我需要很多很多的绷带。

english.title: Bloody Note
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silkweave Bandages and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Gravely Wounded Soldier when you arrive.
english.description: I'm not sure how much longer I can keep pressure on this wound.$b$bIf you find this note, please bring bandages. Lots and lots of bandages.

text.title: 遇难水手
text.objectives: 解救$1oa名女王的复仇号水手。
text.description:
<玛拉纳的海地精和龙虾人从附近的沉船处抓走了被遗忘者水手。>

<水手们似乎受到了毒害，或许他们的境况比这更糟。你应该终结他们的痛苦。>

english.title: Shipwrecked Sailors
english.objectives: Rescue $1oa Queen's Reprisal Sailors.
english.description:
<The gilblin and makrura of Mak'rana have captured the forsaken sailors from the nearby shipwreck.>

<The sailors are being treated very poorly. It looks like a rescue operation is in order.>

objectiveDetails.description: 解救女王的复仇号水手

text.title: 奄奄一息
text.objectives: 取得$1oa块开裂的魔网水晶，并用它们使法力枯竭的雏龙复苏。
text.description: 我的时间有限。此时此刻，我的部队正在抵抗枯法者的突袭。$b$b这四头雏龙已经奄奄一息。塞纳苟斯或许再也无法培养更多后代，所以它们对我们军团至关重要。$b$b用一些开裂的魔网水晶应该可以让它们恢复意识。
text.completion: Of course they would attack now.$b$bThose withered devils couldn't have chosen a more effective time to strike. My brood already suffers.

english.title: Their Dying Breaths
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Cracked Ley Crystals, then use them to resuscitate the Mana-Drained Whelplings.
english.description: I have precious little time. As we speak, my troops are defending against an onslaught of withered elves.$b$bThese four whelplings are near death. Their lives are of the utmost importance to our flight, as they may be some of the last whelplings Senegos can rear.$b$bSome cracked ley crystals should bring them back to their senses.
english.completion: Of course they would attack now.$b$bThose withered devils couldn't have chosen a more effective time to strike. My brood already suffers.

objectiveDetails.description: 使法力枯竭的雏龙复苏

text.title: Won't Anyone Think of the Whelps?

english.title: Won't Anyone Think of the Whelps?

objectiveDetails.description: Eredar at Soul Engine: Apocalypse slain
在法罗纳尔上层攻击燃烧军团

text.title: 高烧患者的纸条
text.objectives: 将3个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗发烧的探险者。
text.description: 我以前不知道鹰身人的吻还会要人命。那个该死的毒妇把我耍得好惨。$b$b我知道我不该吻下去也不该说出来，不过如果不快点治好的话，我可能会丢掉小命。$b$b如果有人找到这封信，请务必带上医疗补给来救我。

english.title: Fevered Note
english.objectives: Bring 3 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Fevered Explorer when you arrive.
english.description: I didn't realize that a harpy's kiss was actually poisonous. Damn vixen tricked me.$b$bI know I'm not supposed to kiss and tell, but if I don't get well soon, I fear this may be my end.$b$bIf someone finds this letter, please bring medical supplies and treat my sickness.

text.title: 染血的祈求
text.objectives: 将3份丝纹绷带和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗重伤的士兵。
text.description: 希望我能活下去，告诉别人我被一头熊暴打的故事。$b$b但是，如果这封信没有被帮得上忙的人拿到的话，我可能就命不久矣。$b$b我非常需要绷带。请一定给我带些过来。

english.title: Bloody Plea
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silkweave Bandages and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Gravely Wounded Soldier when you arrive.
english.description: I hope I survive this long enough to tell the tale of when I was mauled by a bear.$b$bBut unless this letter finds its way into the proper hands, I may not have long to live.$b$bI'm in desperate need of bandages. Please bring any you can spare.

text.title: 染血的请求
text.objectives: 将3份丝纹绷带和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗重伤的士兵。
text.description: 我可以告诉你，我就是“讨厌萨特的人”。当我试图营救沉眠者地穴中的同伴时，那些被诅咒的野兽可是让我吃了好一番苦头。$b$b致发现此封信件的人，请前往地穴。你会在那里找到我，但愿我到时候还活着。$b$b——讨厌萨特的人

english.title: Bloody Request
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silkweave Bandages and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Gravely Wounded Soldier when you arrive.
english.description: What can I tell ya, I'm satyr hater. Those cursed beasts slashed me up pretty good when I was trying to rescue my comrades in the Sleeper's Barrow. $b$bTo whomever finds this letter, make your way over to the barrow. You'll find me in there, hopefully still alive.$b$b-Satyr Hater

text.title: 高烧患者的信
text.objectives: 将3个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗发烧的探险者。
text.description: 我被困在这座该死的山里，不但冷得要死，更惨的是我多半得了流感。$b$b这天寒地冻的，发点小烧反倒舒服，不过烧要是不退的话我可能会没命。$b$b看到纸条的人，请赶快带些医疗补给过来。

english.title: Fevered Letter
english.objectives: Bring 3 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Fevered Explorer when you arrive.
english.description: I'm stuck up on this wretched mountain, freezing to death and to boot I most definitely have the flu.$b$bIt's nice to be in such a cold climate with a fever, but if it doesn't break I'm afraid I may be done for.$b$bTo whomever is reading this, please bring medical supplies.

text.title: 皱巴巴的信
text.objectives: 将2份丝纹夹板和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗受伤的冒险者。
text.description: 需要医疗护理。手臂骨折，腿好像也断了。该死的卓格巴尔！$B$B你可以在至高岭的某个山脚下找到我。相信这已经缩小范围了。

english.title: Crumpled Letter
english.objectives: Bring 2 Silkweave Splints and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Injured Adventurer when you arrive.
english.description: Need medical attention. Arm broken. Probably leg too. Light-forsaken drogbar!$b$bYou'll find me at the base of a large mountain in Highmountain. I'm sure that narrows it down.

text.title: 皱巴巴的纸条
text.objectives: 将10份丝纹夹板和5个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗受伤的冒险者。
text.description: 我也不是很清楚为什么我们被鹰身人摔下山以后竟然还能活下来。$b$b不过我们的情况很糟糕。拜托了，如果有人可以看到这张纸条，请来帮帮我们。

english.title: Crumpled Note
english.objectives: Bring 10 Silkweave Splints and 5 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Injured Adventurers when you arrive.
english.description: I'm not sure how, but we managed to survive being dropped off the mountain by harpies.$b$bWe're in bad shape though. Please, if someone finds this note, bring help.

text.title: 烧焦的祈求
text.objectives: 将9份银色药膏和3个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗邪魂堡垒逃亡者。
text.description: 我们在最后一刻逃了出来，但他们还是放出了暴雨般的恶魔烈火。$b$b我想他们是想用大火来吞噬我们，但我们还是活了下来。$b$b如果你找到了这封信，就请将医疗补给品带给我们，帮助我们缓解灼伤的痛苦。这样的话，也许我们就能多活一些日子。

english.title: Singed Plea
english.objectives: Bring 9 Silvery Salves and 3 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Felsoul Hold Escapees when you arrive.
english.description: We just barely managed to escape, but not before they rained hell upon us with their demon fire.$b$bI suppose they assumed we'd be consumed by their fire, but we survived.$b$bIf you find this note, bring medical supplies to soothe our burns. Maybe then we can survive a bit longer.

objectiveDetails.description: 治疗被邪火烧伤的逃亡者

text.title: 高烧患者的祈祷
text.objectives: 将15个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗发烧的瓦尔莎拉难民。
text.description: 亲爱的诸神啊，虽然我记不住你们的名字了，但还请回应我的祈求，给予仁慈的帮助。$b$b我们的队伍遭到了萨特的袭击，现在身患热病，急需帮助。$b$b我相信这封信一定能帮助我招来神明……

english.title: Fevered Prayer
english.objectives: Bring 15 Field Packs to the location marked on your map. Treat the Fevered Val'sharah Refugees when you arrive.
english.description: Dear gods whose names I really can't recall, please answer my prayer and send help.$b$bOur party was attacked by satyrs and now we're feverishly sick and could use some aid immediately.$b$bI believe writing this note is the correct way of summoning a god...

text.title: 染血的信
text.objectives: 将3份丝纹绷带和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗重伤的肯瑞托卫士。
text.description: 我知道猫会上树，所以我很确定这头夜刃豹只是在等我失血而亡。$b$b我把这封信放到旁边的一只猫头鹰身上，我管它叫“小鹰”。希望它可以找到人来帮帮我。

english.title: Bloody Letter
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silkweave Bandages and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Gravely Wounded Kirin Tor Guardian when you arrive.
english.description: I know cats can climb trees, so I'm pretty convinced that this nightsaber is just waiting for me to bleed out.$b$bI'm attaching this note to a nearby owl I've nicknamed "Hooty". Hopefully he finds someone to help me.

objectiveDetails.description: 稳定重伤守护者的伤势

text.title: 染血的祈祷
text.objectives: 将3份丝纹绷带和1个野外急救包带到地图上标记的地点。到达之后，治疗重伤的月落防御者。
text.description: 这是我的遗嘱。孩子、房子和我累积的雄厚资产都留给我的丈夫……等等，不对。孩子、房子和我的财产都留给我的妹妹。$b$b把我永远的爱留给我的丈夫。没错，他一定喜欢被浓浓的爱所包围。$b$b另外，如果有人可以在我失血而亡之前找到我，请务必记得带上医疗补给，非常感谢。

english.title: Bloody Prayer
english.objectives: Bring 3 Silkweave Bandages and 1 Field Pack to the location marked on your map. Treat the Gravely Wounded Moonfall Defender when you arrive.
english.description: This is my last will and testament. To my husband, I leave the kids, the house, and the enormous wealth I've accumulated... wait, no. To my sister, I leave the kids, the house and my estate.$b$bTo my husband, I leave my eternal love. Yes, he'll enjoy having that more.$b$bAlso, if someone finds this and can come find me before I bleed out, I'd appreciate some medical attention.

objectiveDetails.description: 稳定重伤防御者的伤势

text.title: 聚焦能量
text.objectives: 收集3份萨格拉斯之血。
text.description: 除了梦魇碎片之外，我们还需要萨格拉斯之血才能重新启动通往艾林裂隙的传送门。$B$B你可以在破碎群岛各地找到这种稀有的材料。据说使者们正在寻找经验丰富的冒险者，他们或许会提供萨格拉斯之血作为奖励。

english.title: Focusing the Energies
english.objectives: Collect 3 Blood of Sargeras.
english.description: In addition to shards of nightmare, we need Blood of Sargeras to reactivate the portal to the Rift of Aln.$B$BThis rare reagent can be obtained from around the Broken Isles. Rumor has it that emissaries are in search of hardened adventurers, and may offer these in reward.

text.title: 越强大越堕落
text.objectives: 帮助凯托斯执行仪式。
text.description: 我受够这些小打小闹了，助手。我们要一步到位。$b$b魔典就是关键！释放我们族人潜能的关键。$b$b别担心，年轻人。我的力量足够完成手上的任务。让我们利用邪能魔法，改变未来。$b$b跟着我，见证夏多雷的救赎吧！

english.title: The Bigger They Are, The Harder They Fel
english.objectives: Assist Kyrtos with his ritual.
english.description: I have had it with these small fry, assistant. Time to go straight to the top.$b$bThe tome is the key! The key to unlocking the potential within our people.$b$bDo not worry, young one. I have enough power to complete the task at hand. Let us harness fel magic and change the future.$b$bFollow me and witness the redemption of the shal'dorei!

text.title: 阿克萨拉克斯
text.objectives: 消灭阿克萨拉克斯。
text.description: 我们必须消灭隘口里的一个恶魔。$b$b阿克萨拉克斯是一个既狡诈又邪恶的生物。如果放任不管，他将通过隘口发起精心策划的攻击，对我们赶尽杀绝。$b$b我绝不会大意轻敌，等你做好攻击他的准备以后，我会与你并肩作战。
text.completion: With Arkethrax and his minions dealt with it should help prevent them from flanking Illidari Stand. Well done.

english.title: Arkethrax
english.objectives: Slay Arkethrax.
english.description: Within the Ingress is a demon who must die.$b$bArkethrax is a creature of cunning evil. If left unchecked he will be able to use the Ingress as a staging point for targeted assaults that will decimate our forces.$b$bI, for one, have no intention of underestimating this opponent and shall join you on the battlefield when you are ready to fight him.
english.completion: With Arkethrax and his minions dealt with it should help prevent them from flanking Illidari Stand. Well done.

text.title: 人多势弱
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口消灭恶魔。
text.description: 大量恶魔正在邪焰隘口聚集。$b$b我们必须赶在他们集结完毕，对伊利达雷哨所的侧翼发动攻击之前消灭这些入侵者。$b$b你愿意加入战斗吗？
text.completion: That should stall these demons for a time. We may need to return in the future to ensure they have not regrouped.

english.title: Quantity Over Quality
english.objectives: Slay demons in the Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: The demons of Felblaze Ingress are amassing at an exponential rate.$b$bWe must cull these invaders before they have enough demons to flank our forces at Illidari Stand.$b$bWill you join us in battle?
english.completion: That should stall these demons for a time. We may need to return in the future to ensure they have not regrouped.

text.title: 错得离谱
text.objectives: 放置4个被破坏的传送门稳定器。
text.description: 这些恶魔传送门简直糟糕透顶。毫无技术可言，毫无可取之处。$B$b看着都难受。我可是好几十年都没这么难受过了。$b$b我“修好”了燃烧军团的一些宝贝传送门稳定器。$b$B我要你拿着它们去“调整”隘口的主要传送门，然后见证“喜人”的成果。
text.completion: If you think the explosion was big on our side of the portal, you should see what the other side looks like. Ha!

english.title: They're Doing it Wrong
english.objectives: Place 4 Sabotaged Portal Crystals.
english.description: These demon portals are terrible and sloppy. No skill or finesse in it.$B$bThis physically hurts me and I haven't felt real pain in decades.$b$bI "fixed" some of the Legion's precious Portal Stabilizer crystals.$b$BI want you to take them and "modify" their main portal in the Ingress and watch the "hilarity" ensue.
english.completion: If you think the explosion was big on our side of the portal, you should see what the other side looks like. Ha!

objectiveDetails.description: 放置被破坏的传送门稳定器

text.title: 魔杖练习
text.objectives: 练习用魔杖击中$1oa个魔杖目标。
text.description: 我们先从魔杖开始。你带着自己的魔杖吗？很好。$b$b我在大厅里设置了一些目标。使用你的魔杖，击中尽可能多的目标。$b$b不要站得太近，那算是作弊！
text.completion: And... it looks like we're out of time for today's wand practice. Go on, then. Off to your next class!

english.title: Wanding 101
english.objectives: Practice using your wand on $1oa Wand Targets.
english.description: We'll start with some wand work. You have your wand with you? Good.$b$bI've set up a number of targets around the hall. Use your wand to hit as many as you can.$b$bAnd no point-blank shots! That's cheating.
english.completion: And... it looks like we're out of time for today's wand practice. Go on, then. Off to your next class!

text.title: 学术厅：战斗研究
text.objectives: 取得塞索尼需要的书籍，并帮助他应对挑战。
text.description: 什么情况？一个拼命想取悦院长的糊涂虫新生，没事在大厅里闲逛？$b$b很好！我的研究正好缺人手。$b$b我正在撰写一篇战斗论文。帮我从那边的架子上拿些书来。
text.completion: My hand is beginning to tire from taking so many notes. I think it's time we took a break.

english.title: Study Hall: Combat Research
english.objectives: Obtain the books that Sythorne requests, then help him defeat the challenges within.
english.description: What's this? A new, confused student, desperately trying to win the favor of the headmistress, wandering the halls without anything to do?$b$bPerfect! I need help with my research.$b$bI'm writing a paper on combat. Grab me some books from the shelf over there.
english.completion: My hand is beginning to tire from taking so many notes. I think it's time we took a break.

objectiveDetails.description: 把书放到塞索尼的讲台上
把书放到塞索尼的讲台上
把书放到塞索尼的讲台上

text.title: 邪焰隘口
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口与特德·舒马克会面
text.description: 我的职责是确保伊利达雷哨所后方的安全。我雇了这个术士……模样的东西，来帮忙。$b$b不过，接下来的一个任务光靠我们两个还不够。$b$b东边的邪焰隘口处有许多恶魔。他们已经开始打开传送门，召来数不清的援兵。$b$b我们到邪焰隘口碰头，一起压制这场邪恶暴动。
text.completion: Keep your voice down unless you feel like being felbat food.
text.completed: 在邪焰隘口与特德·舒马克会面

english.title: Felblaze Ingress
english.objectives: Meet Tehd Shoemaker at Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: It is my mission to cover the rear guard of Illidari Stand. I have employed this warlock... thing, to assist me.$b$bHowever, the two of us are insufficient for a task that needs doing.$b$bTo the east is a mass of demons at Felblaze Ingress. These creatures have begun to open portals to summon in countless reinforcements.$b$bMeet us at Felblaze Ingress and together we can crush this fel insurgency.
english.completion: Keep your voice down unless you feel like being felbat food.
english.completed: Meet Tehd Shoemaker at Felblaze Ingress.

text.title: 借眼一看
text.objectives: 使用特德提供的基尔罗格之眼调查邪焰隘口。
text.description: 真是又瞎又天真。$b$b我旁边这位盲眼天才想跳过准备阶段，直接冲到邪焰隘口去。$b$b呸！我觉得还是先探探情况再说。$b$b过来，我会给你一个额外的眼睛。至于它的出处嘛，还是不提的好。$b$B到邪焰隘口进行调查，当心别被戳到眼睛。
text.completion: Why? Why would demons, of all things, be this bad at summoning their own kind?

english.title: Eye See You
english.objectives: Use Tehd's Eye of Kilrogg to investigate Felblaze Ingress.
english.description: There is being blind, and then there is being stupid.$b$bThis eyeless wonder next to me wants to barrel into Felblaze Ingress without preparation.$b$bBah! I say we scout it first.$b$bHere, I will provide you with an extra eye I picked up from a place better left unmentioned.$b$BEnter Felblaze Ingress, investigate the area, and try not to get poked in the eye.
english.completion: Why? Why would demons, of all things, be this bad at summoning their own kind?

text.title: 加弗德的踪迹
text.objectives: 前往诺森德，在龙骨荒野寻找加弗德和提尔之火。
text.description: 我们必须抢在那些恶魔之前夺回白银之手。我们需要一种叫做“提尔之火”的圣物，才能将它从禁锢之中解放出来。我有一个，我的兄弟加弗德也有一个。$b$b他前往诺森德，希望从提尔的故乡那里获得援助，但他再也没有回来过。$b$b我请求你，找到他，还有他的提尔之火。

english.title: The Brother's Trail
english.objectives: Go to Dragonblight in Northrend and find Galford and his Spark of Tyr.
english.description: We must reclaim the Silver Hand before those with evil intent can seize it. To free it from its wards, we need relics called the Sparks of Tyr. I have one, as does my brother, Galford.$b$bHe journeyed to Northrend to seek aid from the Tyr's homeland, but has not returned.$b$bI must ask you to find him, and his Spark.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）搭乘兰妮苟萨前往达拉然
找到加弗德的下落线索
（可选）使用传送门前往龙眠神殿

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募风暴召唤者米尔拉和海达克西斯公爵。
text.description: 大地之环的成员凭借着自己的力量与无私的贡献建立了这个组织。$B$B如果我们要抵抗燃烧军团，保卫这个世界，就必须让组织发展壮大，并招募有经验的勇士加入我们。$B$B先去跟风暴召唤者米尔拉和海达克西斯公爵谈谈。或许他们愿意与我们并肩作战。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Stormcaller Mylra and Duke Hydraxis.
english.description: The Earthen Ring is built upon the strength and dedication of its members.$B$BIf we are to help defend this world against the Burning Legion, we will need to grow our order, and recruit skilled champions to our side.$B$BBegin by speaking to Stormcaller Mylra and Duke Hydraxis. Perhaps they would be willing to fight for us.

objectiveDetails.description: 招募风暴召唤者米尔拉

text.title: 斥候报告
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“斥候报告”任务。
text.description: 之前，组织一直在观望等待，无所作为。有了你的领导，我们可以全力以赴，实现初衷。$B$B看看我们，$n。艾泽拉斯比以往更需要我们。激发我们成立这个组织的那些敌人又给世界带来了威胁。$B$B你应该派人去收集斥候的情报。这样，我们就可以把精力集中在最紧要的事务之上。

english.title: Scouting Reports
english.objectives: Interact with the Scouting Map and complete "Scouting Reports".
english.description: In the recent past, our order has spent a lot of time watching and waiting. With you at the helm, we'll be able to focus on our original calling.$B$BTake a look around us, $n. Azeroth needs us now more than ever. The same enemy that led to our formation is threatening us once again.$B$BYou should send someone to gather reports from our scouts. From there, we'll be able to focus our efforts where they are needed most.

text.title: 搭把手
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉找到胡德森·克劳福德。
text.description: 斥候报告说他们看到瓦尔莎拉的一个村庄正在受到亡灵猎犬的攻击。$B$B这是隐秘通途实现承诺的机会，我们要帮助无辜的人们。$B$B你应该到鲑鱼溪去看看能帮上什么忙。

english.title: Lending a Hand
english.objectives: Find Hudson Crawford in Val'sharah.
english.description: Our scouts reported seeing a village in Val'sharah being attacked by undead hounds.$B$BThis is the perfect opportunity for the Unseen Path to make good on our promise to help those in need.$B$BYou should head out to Bradensbrook and see what you can do to help.

text.title: 亡灵之灾
text.objectives: 在鲑鱼溪消灭复生猎犬。
text.description: 村里到处都是死而复生的野兽！$B$B这些怪物不断发起攻击，昼夜不休！$B$B我们正在竭尽全力阻止它们，可是情况越来越糟，村民们已经撑不下去了。他们的体力已经透支，逐渐失去了战斗的意志。$B$B如果你可以减轻他们的重担，我们将感激不尽。

english.title: Rising Troubles
english.objectives: Kill Risen Hounds in and around Bradensbrook.
english.description: Our village is swarming with beasts risen from the dead!$B$BThe abominations never rest! They attack night and day.$B$BWe're doing our best to keep them at bay, but it's getting to be more than the townsfolk can handle. They're tired and losing their will to fight.$B$BAnything you can do to lessen the burden would be greatly appreciated.

text.title: 捕杀刺客
text.objectives: 在卡莱尔小屋设置陷阱，抓捕并击杀托利亚斯队长。
text.description:
尽管我们的农地和家园已经破败不堪，黑鸦入侵者的骚扰依然没有停止。

我们曾以为他们把我们赶走以后就会收手，不过这些没有思想的幽灵会遵循他们首领的任何命令。

我们想靠自己的力量除掉他，不过他实在太过狡猾。我们需要有人设下陷阱，才有机会抓到他，这是我们唯一的办法。如果你愿意帮忙，我会为你提供需要的东西。

english.title: Assassin Entrapment
english.objectives: Set a trap at Carlisle Cottage to catch and kill Captain Tevaris.
english.description:
Black Rook invaders are still targeting our farms and homes, even though there's not much left to pillage.

We had hoped that once they cleared us out that the attacks would stop, but it seems those mindless ghouls will follow any orders given by their commander.

We'd take him out ourselves, but he's a sneaky fella. The only way we're going to catch him, is if someone lays a trap. I can provide the supplies if you're willing to help.

text.title: 紧急召唤
text.objectives: 在神射手营地与伊墨瑞尔·影卫谈一谈。
text.description:
雄鹰给你带来了一个消息：
$B|cFF660000             致：$n|r$b$b斥候从艾泽拉斯各地发来报告。看来情况已经恶化了许多。$b$b尽快返回神射手营地。$B$B|cFF660000             |r——伊墨瑞尔·影卫

english.title: Urgent Summons
english.objectives: Speak to Emmarel Shadewarden at Trueshot Lodge.
english.description:
The eagle appears to have a message for you:
$B|cFF660000             To: $n|r$b$bOur scouts have returned with reports from all over Azeroth. It seems that things are much worse than they initially seemed.$b$bReturn to Trueshot Lodge as soon as you can.$B$B|cFF660000             |r-Emmarel Shadewarden

text.title: 召回希莱尔
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾找到兽王希莱尔。
text.description: 有太多人需要帮助，或许我们应该召回一些在外执勤的斥候。$B$B其中有个叫做希莱尔的猎人，虽然她在很久以前就为了加入我们组织而离开了自己的氏族，不过她仍然觉得自己必须守护族人。$B$B她为保护那些厌弃自己的族人而付出心血，虽说这种精神值得敬佩，不过组织也需要她的力量。$B$B到风暴峡湾寻找希莱尔，让她知道是时候回家了。

english.title: Calling Hilaire Home
english.objectives: Find Beastmaster Hilaire in Stormheim.
english.description: With so many in need of our help, it may be time to call in some of our scouts in the field.$B$BOne such scout is a huntress by the name of Hilaire. Although she abandoned her clan long ago to join our order, she still feels a need to watch over them.$B$BHer dedication to protect those who would shun her is admirable, but we need her here.$B$BSeek Hilaire out in Stormheim, and let her know it's time to come home.

text.title: 招募雷克萨
text.objectives: 在至高岭找到雷克萨。
text.description: 想要发挥最强大的力量，我们就得把最优秀的猎人团结起来。$B$B有你来领导我们的组织，已经开了一个好头，不过如果要大展身手，还需要更多高手的力量。$B$B雷克萨是名震一时的杰出猎人，不过他一直没有意愿帮助隐秘通途。$B$B他的营地就在北边不远的地方，他和米莎一起在那里生活。或许你可以说服他加入我们的行列。

english.title: Recruiting Rexxar
english.objectives: Find Rexxar in Highmountain.
english.description: To do the most good, we need the best hunters at our side.$B$BHaving you leading the order is a great start, but we'll need others who share your skill and expertise if we plan on making an impact.$B$BRexxar has a reputation of being one of the greatest hunters of his time, yet he's never been eager to aid the Unseen Path.$B$BHe has a camp just north of here, where he and Misha live off the land. Maybe you can convince him to join our ranks.

text.title: 野兽袭击
text.objectives: 找到发动袭击的真凶，并把它的脑袋交给抓住考拉的法师。
text.description:
没找回考拉的话，我绝不会离开我的岗哨。

有一伙法师把她当成野兽关了起来，还威胁说要干掉她。

他们说考拉害死了他们的一个同伴，但是我不会相信这种事。考拉是一个忠实又听话的伙伴，没有我的命令她绝对不会出手。

我追踪着一个恶魔来到了这里，他才就是这次事件的真凶。不过在与我大战一场之后，他就逃之夭夭了。我的伤势让我没能追上他，但我敢肯定，那头野兽在身后留下了一道血迹。

english.title: Bite of the Beast
english.objectives: Find the beast responsible for the attacks and bring its head to the mages holding Cora captive.
english.description:
I will not leave my post without Cora.

A group of mages have her caged up like a beast, threatening to put her down.

They claim she's responsible for the death of one of their own, but I refuse to believe that. Cora is a loyal and obedient companion; she would never attack without my command.

I tracked the demon that was truly responsible to this location, but it put up quite a fight before getting away. My injuries prevented me from giving chase, but I am sure that beast has left a bloody trail.

objectiveDetails.description: 把佐尔格的脑袋交给大法师兰顿

text.title: 活过一夜
text.objectives: 按雷克萨的方式在末路崖活过一个晚上。
text.description: 是时候考验你的能力了。$B$B你的组织似乎采取观望多过采取行动。$B$B请证明我错了，让我看到我或许和隐秘通途有一定的共通之处。$B$B如果你能在野外活过一个晚上，那么我就会考虑加入你的组织。

english.title: Survive the Night
english.objectives: Survive a night within Cliff's Edge according to Rexxar's rules.
english.description: Now it's time to put your skills to the test.$B$BYour order seems to be a lot of watching and waiting without a lot of action.$B$BProve me wrong. Show me that I might have something in common with the Unseen Path.$B$BIf you survive a night in the wild, then I will consider joining your order.

text.title: 归乡
text.objectives: 回神射手营地找伊墨瑞尔·影卫。
text.description: 考拉缓过来了，她现在可以随我前往神射手营地。$B$B你可以去告诉伊墨瑞尔，说我们正在回家的路上。

english.title: Homecoming
english.objectives: Return to Emmarel Shadewarden at Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: Cora has calmed enough to make the journey back to Trueshot Lodge.$B$BYou can let Emmarel know that we are on our way home.

text.title: 隐秘保护
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，派遣部队执行“隐秘保护”系列任务。
text.description: 我们不会让达拉然陷落。$B$B如果军团想要攻打达拉然，隐秘通途就会前去阻止他们。$B$B最新的侦察报告指出，许多地区都需要我们支援，甚至有些人民自己都没有意识到危机。$B$B我建议你一有机会就派出猎人清除这些威胁。

english.title: Unseen Protection
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map to send your champions and troops on "Unseen Protection" missions.
english.description: We will not let the city of Dalaran fall.$B$BIf the Legion is planning an attack, the Unseen Path will be there to stop it.$B$BOur scouts' most recent reports list a few other areas that sound like they could really use our help, whether they realize it or not.$B$BAs soon as you're able, send your hunters to take care of the threats.

text.title: 信号问题
text.objectives: 在南边的瞭望塔顶端与伊墨瑞尔见面。
text.description: 很久以前，我们将特殊的信号弹交给了一些首领，他们只能在紧要关头使用。$B$B看到信号时，隐秘通途的领袖需要前往南边的哨塔，与任何点燃信号弹的人见面。$B$B我不知道我们会在塔楼上见到谁，不过我们必须迅速行动。

english.title: Signaling Trouble
english.objectives: Meet Emmarel at the top of the southern watch tower.
english.description: Long ago, we gave select leaders special flares that were only to be used in times of great need.$B$BUpon seeing the flare, the leader of the Unseen Path is supposed to head to the southern watchtower to meet with whomever lit it.$B$BI don't know who we'll face once we reach the tower, but we must move quickly.

text.title: 做事情！
text.description: Mrglrg！Mrlglr mrgllrg。$b$b<菲恩卖力地比划>$b$bMrlgrlg glrglmglr mrlglrg。Rglrgmrg mrglr glr。Glr！Gmrlgrmlg mrglmrgm……$b$b<菲恩满怀期待地看着你。>

english.title: Do The Thing!
english.description: Mrglrg! Mrlglr mrgllrg.$b$b<Phin gesticulates wildly>$b$bMrlgrlg glrglmglr mrlglrg. Rglrgmrg mrglr glr. Glr! Gmrlgrmlg mrglmrgm...$b$b<Phin looks at you expectantly.>

text.title: 男爵与猎手
text.objectives: 在风暴峡湾找到猎手布雷克。
text.description: 我们收到了卡德加的消息，他与派出去调查军团营地的法师失去了联系。他需要我们帮忙找到那些法师。$B$B如果要找到法师，我们就需要一条可以追踪气味的猎犬。$B$B我只知道一条有这种能力的猎犬，不过它已经退役很久了。我们必须去找找他的主人猎手布雷克，看看老狗男爵还能不能继续工作。

english.title: Baron and the Huntsman
english.objectives: Find Huntsman Blake in Stormheim.
english.description: We've received word from Khadgar that he's lost contact with the mages he sent to investigate the Legion's camps.
