He's requested our assistance in tracking them down.$B$BIf we have any hope of locating those mages, we'll need to find ourselves a reliable hound capable of following a scent.$B$BThere is only one such hound that I know of, and he's long since retired. It's worth it to check in with his master, Hunstman Blake, and see if old Baron still has it in him.

text.title: 唤醒活力
text.objectives: 让男爵在这片区域挖出远古尸骸，帮助它恢复活力。
text.description: 恐怕男爵已经老了。它的鼻子已经不像以前那么灵敏。别人都叫我给它安乐死，但我真的不忍心失去这个忠实的伙伴。$B$B不过，男爵在工作中总会呈现出最佳状态。如果你把它带出去遛遛，活动活动筋骨，或许可以让它恢复活力。

english.title: Awakening the Senses
english.objectives: Help Baron awaken his senses by digging up Ancient Bones within the area.
english.description: I'm afraid old Baron here is past his prime. His nose can't catch a scent the way it used to. Others told me to put him down, but I can't bear the thought of losing my loyal friend.$B$BBaron was always at his best when working, though. Maybe if you let him wander through these fields and dig up some old bones, it'll be enough to awaken his senses.

text.title: 准备就绪
text.objectives: 回神射手营地找伊墨瑞尔·影卫。
text.description: 如果男爵可以工作，那我也没有问题。$B$B等我收拾好营地，再给它喂饱肚子，我们就会立刻前往猎人营地。它经过这一番活动以后，肯定胃口大开。

english.title: Ready to Work
english.objectives: Return to Emmarel Shadewarden in Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: If Baron's ready to work, I am too.$B$BWe'll make our way to the hunter's lodge as soon as I pack up camp and get this dog fed. I'm sure with all that digging, he'll have a hearty appetite.

text.title: 失踪的法师
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛与大法师卡德加见面。
text.description: 大法师已经前往苏拉玛，那里是失踪法师最后出现的地方。$B$B男爵也去了，它看起来非常渴望继续工作。$B$B到进城的路上跟他们碰头。运气好的话，男爵应该可以追踪到魔法气息，赶在局面不可挽回之前找到失踪的法师。

english.title: Missing Mages
english.objectives: Meet Archmage Khadgar in Suramar.
english.description: The Archmage has already made his way to Suramar, where the missing mages were last seen.$B$BBaron ran off, too. It seems that hound is eager to work again.$B$BMeet them both near the road that leads into the city. With any luck, Baron will be about to pick up on their magical scent and find the missing mages before it's too late.

text.title: 魔法气息
text.objectives: 跟着男爵追踪法师。
text.description: 这里是肯瑞托成员最后出现的地方，除了一块破烂的布料以外没有留下其他的线索。这应该是从我们的战袍上撕下来的。$B$B虽然布料很小，但是上面应该带有浓烈的魔法气息。只希望男爵可以闻得出来，并且通过它来追查法师的下落。

english.title: The Scent of Magic
english.objectives: Follow Baron as he tracks the scent of the mages.
english.description: This is the last known location of the missing Kirin Tor. There isn't much evidence, other than a torn piece of cloth, which looks to be from one of our tabards.$B$BThe scrap may be small, but it should be heavy with the essence of magic. We can only hope that Baron can catch the scent and track down the mages.

text.title: 请求增援
text.objectives: 点击侦察地图，完成“请求增援”任务。
text.description: 有许多强大的阵营曾对隐秘通途宣誓效忠。是时候召集他们帮我们对付哈卡和恶魔猎犬了。$B$B派你的勇士去寻找阵营领袖，并让他们知道我们需要帮助。

english.title: Requesting Reinforcements
english.objectives: Interact with the Scouting Map and complete the mission "Requesting Reinforcements".
english.description: Many powerful factions have pledged their loyalty to the Unseen Path. It's time that we call on them to help us defeat Hakkar and his demon hounds.$B$BSend your champions into the field to track down these leaders and let them know we require their help.

text.title: 至高岭猎人
text.objectives: 在至高岭找到赫米特·奈辛瓦里。
text.description: 斥候刚刚传来消息，他们找到了一些可以为我们所用的猎人。$B$B似乎著名的赫米特·奈辛瓦里已经在离我们营地不远的地方扎营。$B$B虽然他不太像是我们通常会招募的那种猎人，不过他在猎杀大型猎物方面的丰富经验对我们大有助益。$B$B去他的营地看看他愿不愿意为我们出力。

english.title: Highmountain Hunters
english.objectives: Find Hemet Nesingwary in Highmountain.
english.description: I've just received word from our scouts that they've identified some potential recruits.$B$BIt seems as though the famed Hemet Nesingwary has set up camp not too far from our lodge.$B$BWhile he isn't traditionally the type of hunter we'd invite into our ranks, his experience hunting large game could come in handy.$B$BHead on over to his retreat and see if he's willing to aid our cause.

text.title: 协助大法师
text.objectives: 回神射手营地找伊墨瑞尔·影卫。
text.description: 哈卡有一支地狱犬大军，它们以魔法为食。只要他在艾泽拉斯一天，法师们就有危险。$B$B他和他的猎犬对大部分法术免疫，所以我只能请你消灭他们。$B$B你已经证明了自己的能力，你是否愿意帮忙除掉这个恶魔？

english.title: Assisting the Archmage
english.objectives: Return to Emmarel Shadewarden at Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: Hakkar maintains an army of felhounds that feed off of magic. As long as he remains within Azeroth, no mage will be safe.$B$BHe and his hounds are immune to most spells, so I must ask for assistance in killing them.$B$BYou have proven yourself more than capable, but are you willing to help take down this demon?

text.title: 汇报情况
text.objectives: 跟大法师卡德加、哈杜伦·明翼、温蕾萨·风行者，以及珊蒂斯·羽月谈一谈。
text.description: 一些强大的军事阵营的领袖也已经到场，他们已经准备好提供帮助。$B$B他们希望直接和你商讨，并告诉你他们可以提供怎样的帮助。$B$B运气好的话，我们就能找到合适的人手和方法，除掉哈卡。

english.title: Informing Our Allies
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar, Halduron Brightwing, Vereesa Windrunner, and Shandris Feathermoon.
english.description: Leaders from some of the greatest military factions are here, ready and willing to help.$B$BThey're currently waiting to speak with you directly, hoping to provide insight on how they can help.$B$BWith any luck, we can pull our resources and find a way to take Hakkar down.

text.title: 诱捕野兽
text.objectives: 在邪兽巢穴里使用魔虫诱饵诱捕一头地狱犬幼崽。
text.description: 在法罗纳尔中心的巢穴里，到处都有地狱犬在游荡。如果哈卡在饲养那些野兽，他一定会挑选那个地方。$B$B我制作的诱饵味道很浓，只要一拿出来，你就会吸引附近的猎犬。你最好在离巢穴非常近的时候再用。$B$B一旦恶魔上钩，等到它变得虚弱以后会更容易抓捕。$B$B祝你好运，$n。希望你可以平安回来。

english.title: To Tame the Beast
english.objectives: Use the Leyworm Bait while in Felbeast Dens to lure and trap a felhound fledgling.
english.description: Deep in the heart of Faronaar are dens that are overrun with felhounds. If Hakkar is breeding those beasts, that is the place he would do it.$B$BThe bait I've crafted is potent. Once you apply it, you'll draw the attention of nearby hounds, so only use it when you're close to the dens.$B$BOnce the demon has taken the bait, get it into a weakened state to make trapping easier.$B$BGood luck, $n. I hope you return in one piece.

objectiveDetails.description: 削弱并诱捕一头地狱犬幼崽
在邪兽巢穴里使用魔虫诱饵

text.title: 先天优势
text.objectives: 回神射手营地找伊墨瑞尔·影卫。
text.description: 这种恶魔天生对魔法免疫，不过它也被培养得可以抵抗物理攻击。它全身覆盖着我从未见过的鳞片，层层叠叠，非常厚实。我怀疑大多数金属都无法刺穿它那甲胄般的外皮。$B$B除非你的整个军队都配备了你那种武器，不然我建议使用某种可以攻击它们弱点的东西来对付这些恶魔。

english.title: The Nature of the Beast
english.objectives: Return to Emmarel Shadewarden at Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: By nature, this demon is immune to magic, but it has also been bred to be resistant to physical attacks. It's covered in scales unlike anything I've ever seen; layered and thick. I doubt that most metals will be able to pierce the demon's armor-like hide.$B$BUnless your entire army has weapons like yours, I suggest fighting those beasts with something that will exploit their weakness.

text.title: 附魔材料
text.objectives: 收集需要的附魔材料。
text.description: 哨兵知道一位可以信任的天才附魔师，她专门研究那些会影响恶魔的附魔。$B$B她可以无偿为哨兵服务，不过她需要一些特殊的材料进行附魔。

english.title: Required Reagents
english.objectives: Collect the required crafting reagents.
english.description: The Sentinels know of a trusted and talented enchanter who specializes in enchantments that affect demons.$B$BShe provides her services for free to the Sentinels, but she does require specific reagents to perform her enchantments.

text.title: 要事会谈
text.objectives: 与达拉然的六人议会对话。
text.description:
大法师瓦格斯跟苍穹会有牵连，这实在令人担心。但是他曾多次向肯瑞托证明自己的忠诚，我们现在还不能给他定罪。

不过，我有义务把我的疑虑告诉议会的其他人。你最好前往达拉然并到紫罗兰城堡和他们会面。我会留在这里看着我们的老朋友。

english.title: The Council is in Session
english.objectives: Speak to the Council of Six in Dalaran.
english.description:
Archmage Vargoth's involvement with the Empyrean Society is troubling. However, as he has proven his loyalty to the Kirin Tor many times, we must give him the benefit of the doubt for now. 

Still, I am obligated to share our concerns with the rest of the Council. You had best travel to Dalaran and meet with them in the Violet Citadel. I will remain here to care for our old friend.

text.title: 意外到访
text.objectives: 与拉文德维尔见面。
text.description:
拉文德维尔，这位长期跟随大法师瓦格斯的学徒，已经带着一封他导师的紧急信件来到了守护者圣殿。

他正在楼上等你。你最好尽快去找他，$n！

english.title: An Unexpected Visitor
english.objectives: Meet up with Ravandwyr.
english.description:
Archmage Vargoth's long-time apprentice, Ravandwyr, has arrived here in the Hall of the Guardian with an urgent message from his mentor.

He will be waiting for you upstairs. You had best find him quickly, $n!

text.title: 法罗迪斯宫廷
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳完成任意4个世界任务
text.description: 完成阿苏纳的4个世界任务，援助法罗迪斯宫廷。
text.completed: 回阿苏纳找维里迪斯·法隆。

english.title: Court of Farondis
english.objectives: Complete any 4 world quests in Azsuna.
english.description: Assist the Court of Farondis in Azsuna by completing 4 world quests.
english.completed: Return to Veridis Fallon in Azsuna.

objectiveDetails.description: 在阿苏纳完成4个世界任务

text.title: 堕夜精灵
text.objectives: 在苏拉玛完成任意4个世界任务
text.description: 帮助苏拉玛的堕夜精灵完成4个世界任务。
text.completed: 回苏拉玛找首席奥术师塔莉萨。

english.title: The Nightfallen
english.objectives: Complete any 4 world quests in Suramar.
english.description: Assist the Nightfallen of Suramar by completing 4 world quests.
english.completed: Return to First Arcanist Thalyssra in Suramar.

objectiveDetails.description: 在苏拉玛完成4个世界任务

text.title: 守望者
text.objectives: 完成4个守望者世界任务。
text.description: 帮助守望者完成4个世界任务。
text.completed: 回守望岛找麦琳·刀翼。

english.title: The Wardens
english.objectives: Complete 4 Wardens world quests.
english.description: Assist the Wardens by completing 4 world quests.
english.completed: Return to Marin Bladewing at the Isle of the Watchers.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成4个守望者世界任务

text.title: 大法师瓦格斯的居所
text.objectives: 调查大法师瓦格斯的住处。
text.description:
大法师瓦格斯已经消失了一段时间。你可以到他在城堡塔楼的住处看看，$n。卡雷会为你带路。

但愿这位备受尊敬的同僚只是行为有点古怪，而非勾结邪教。

english.title: Archmage Vargoth's Retreat
english.objectives: Investigate Archmage Vargoth's quarters.
english.description:
Archmage Vargoth has been absent for a while. You may have a look around his living quarters here in the citadel tower, $n. Kalec will escort you there.

I will hold out hope that our esteemed colleague is merely up to his usual eccentricities.

objectiveDetails.description: 进入大法师瓦格斯的居所

text.title: 追寻他的足迹
text.objectives: 派出你的勇士调查大法师瓦格斯的旅程。
text.description:
大法师瓦格斯似乎卷入了一些危险的事情之中，对于有他这样能力和阅历的大法师而言，这倒也不算多稀奇！

他前往的可能是魔法回廊地窟，但我们需要调查所有线索来搞清楚他到底在做些什么。

english.title: Following In His Footsteps
english.objectives: Ask your champions to investigate Archmage Vargoth's travels.
english.description:
Archmage Vargoth seems to be mixed up in something dangerous, not that that's unusual for an archmage of his caliber and experience!

The Arcway Vaults may be where he's headed, but we should investigate all leads in order to get a better idea of what he's up to.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“大法师瓦格斯的旅行”任务

text.title: 深入深谷
text.objectives: 使用奥伦的锚点下降到深谷中，并取回他失落的物品。
text.description:
现在有了需要的肠子，我就能用它们来制作一种特殊的绳子。

它能让你从桥上下降到下方的山谷里。深石部族从我这儿偷走了不少东西，然后把它们都丢进了那座山谷里。请把它们找回来。

english.title: Going Down, Going Up
english.objectives: Use Oren's Rappel Point to descend into the depths and recover his lost possessions.
english.description:
Now that we have the necessary worm guts, I was able to fashion them into a special sort of rope.

It will allow you to descend from the bridge into the chasm below and recover some of my possessions that were stolen and thrown in by the Deeprock.

text.title: 阿莎曼祭坛
text.objectives: 与黛妮丝·凝星谈一谈，并前往阿莎曼之墓寻找德兰多斯·闪月。
text.description: 一万年前，强大的半神阿莎曼在与燃烧军团的战斗中陨落。为了纪念她的牺牲，一群虔诚的灰烬德鲁伊将阿莎曼的牙齿打造成一把强大的匕首。$b$b带上我的戒指，呈给他们的领袖德兰多斯·闪月。这样他就会知道你得到了我的祝福。$b$b我们的飞行管理员凝星可以直接带你前往祭坛。

english.title: The Shrine of Ashamane
english.objectives: Speak to Danise Stargazer and travel to Ashamane's Fall in search of Delandros Shimmermoon.
english.description: The mighty Ancient, Ashamane, fell in battle against the Burning Legion ten thousand years ago. To honor her sacrifice, a group of devoted druids called the Ashen forged Ashamane's fangs into powerful daggers.$b$bTake my signet and present it to their leader, Delandros Shimmermoon. He will know that you have my blessing.$b$bOur flight master, Danise Stargazer, can see you to the shrine.

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘角鹰兽前往阿莎曼之墓

text.title: 黑檀之寒的回忆
text.objectives: 在达拉然城里寻找一个提瑞斯法议会的影像。与他交谈获得他的智慧。
text.description: 你拿到了黑檀之寒？阿洛迪原来的法杖？我的天呐……<咳嗽>在第一位守护者的时代，提瑞斯法议会的全体成员将他们的力量赋予了这位年轻的法师，希望他能战胜燃烧军团。<喘息>如今，他们都不在了……不过你的法杖不会忘记。$b$b在下面的达拉然街道寻找曾经的议会成员的痕迹。关于他们的回忆会帮你变得更加强大，就像他们曾经帮助阿洛迪一样。

english.title: Memories of Ebonchill
english.objectives: Find a Reflection of the Council of Tirisfal in Dalaran City. Speak with one to receive his or her wisdom.
english.description: Is that Ebonchill you've got there? Alodi's old staff? My my my... <Cough>$b$bIn the days of the first guardian, all the members of the Council of Tirisfal granted their powers to the young mage in the hopes that he could overcome the Legion. <Wheeze> None of them are alive today... but that staff of yours remembers.$b$bSearch the streets of Dalaran below for reflections of the former council members. Their memories may empower you as they once did Alodi. Seek them out and speak with one!

objectiveDetails.description: 与提瑞斯法议会成员的影像交谈

text.title: 阿莎曼之牙
text.objectives: 骑上乌牙，搜寻阿莎曼之牙。
text.description: 我必须承认，维斯托克是对的。祭坛在燃烧军团的攻击之下不堪一击。他已经带着利牙逃走了。$b$b我们必须找到他，好让你拿到利牙。虽然我应该和你一起行动，不过我必须在这里留守，以防祭坛再次受到攻击。$b$b这是我的伙伴乌牙，它的嗅觉极其灵敏。不管维斯托克躲在哪里，乌牙都能带你找到他。记得带上这个贝壳，我们可以通过它保持联络。$b$b愿艾露恩指引你。

english.title: The Fangs of Ashamane
english.objectives: Mount upon Ebonfang and search for the Fangs of Ashamane.
english.description: I have to admit, Verstok was right. The shrine was too easy of a target for the Burning Legion to attack. Still, he's gone and the Fangs are with him.$b$bWe're going to have to track him down for you to recover the Fangs. I should come with you but I have to stay with my people should we be attacked again.$b$bHere, my companion Ebonfang has a sense of smell like no other. He will be able to guide you to wherever Verstok is hiding. Also take this shell, through it we can communicate.$b$bMay Elune guide you.

text.title: 翡翠梦魇：翡翠梦魇
text.objectives: 进入任意难度翡翠梦魇团队副本，击败领主萨维斯。
text.description: 梦魇之王萨维斯还没有被消灭。塞纳留斯仍然身处艾林裂隙之中，危在旦夕。$B$B召集你最强大的盟友，$n。如果要直面梦魇，我们应该有所准备。$B$B你准备好以后就进入翡翠梦境，战胜你遇到的一切恐惧。

english.title: The Emerald Nightmare: The Emerald Nightmare
english.objectives: Enter the Emerald Nightmare raid on any difficulty and defeat Lord Xavius.
english.description: The Lord of Nightmare, Xavius, is still out there. Cenarius is still in grave danger, deep within the Rift of Aln.$B$BSummon your greatest allies, $n. If we are to stare into the face of the Nightmare, we had best be ready.$B$BOnce you are ready, enter the Emerald Nightmare and defeat all the horrors you find there.

text.title: 远古魔法
text.objectives: 点击侦察地图，完成“远古魔法”任务。
text.description:
破碎群岛是古代暗夜精灵知识的核心，那些被遗忘的地穴和暗箱里一定藏着无数的魔法神器。我们必须找到它们，以免它们落入歹人之手！

或许，你应该派一位勇士前去搜寻。

english.title: Ancient Magic
english.objectives: Interact with your Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Ancient Magic."
english.description:
Since the Broken Isles is the epicenter of ancient night elven learning, there must be countless magical artifacts secreted away in forgotten vaults and reliquaries. We must secure them so they do not fall into the wrong hands!

Perhaps you should send a champion in search of them.

text.title: 隐秘行动
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳和拉文德维尔会面。
text.description:
你的勇士发现阿苏纳的苍穹会秘密营地里散发着一股强大的魔力。

大法师瓦格斯要我派梅瑞尔去协助调查。不过你也看到了，梅瑞尔病得不轻，现在没办法过去。你愿意帮他跑这一趟吗？

你需要证明自己的实力才能进入那里。我们可以在阿苏纳的积怨战争营地找到合适的东西。

english.title: A Covert Operation
english.objectives: Meet Ravandwyr in Azsuna.
english.description:
Your champion discovered some sort of powerful magic emanating from the secretive Empyrean Society enclave in Azsuna. 

Archmage Vargoth asked me to request Meryl's aid in investigating it, but as you can see, Meryl is clearly too ill to travel at the moment. Would you be willing to go in his place?

You will need to prove yourself in order to gain entrance. We should be able to find something sufficient in the Hatecoil Warcamp in Azsuna.

text.title: 准备入教
text.objectives: 取得奥术智慧之珠和5张纳萨拉斯卷轴，然后在苍穹会营地北边和拉文德维尔会面。
text.description:
苍穹会是一个危险的教会。他们主张研究各种魔法，不管其来源为何，但事实上他们大多专注于禁忌法术。如果你献上一个魔法神器，他们应该会欢迎你进入营地。

积怨纳迦找到了几样东西，很合苍穹会的胃口——一颗奥术智慧之珠，以及埋藏在纳萨拉斯学院地底深处的一些卷轴。你必须说服他们把东西交给你。

我会在苍穹会营地北边的小路上等你。

english.title: Prepare To Be Assimilated
english.objectives: Obtain the Pearl of Arcane Wisdom and 5 Nar'thalas Scrolls and meet up with Ravandwyr north of the Empyrean Enclave.
english.description:
The Empyrean Society is a dangerous cult. They claim to study all magic regardless of its source, but in reality they focus mostly on the forbidden. They will welcome you to their enclave if you bring them a magical artifact.

The Hatecoil naga have found the perfect gifts - a Pearl of Arcane Wisdom and scrolls from the depths beneath the Nar'thalas Academy. You will have to convince them to part with a few.

I will meet you on the road just north of the Empyrean Enclave.

text.title: 援助盟友
text.objectives: 把补给交给麦丽娅·灰羽。
text.description:
我们的天角盟友需要帮助。

与入侵鹰身人的战斗变成了消耗战，他们快要弹尽粮绝了。

如果我们可以提供任何补给，都可以帮助他们早日把那些女巫赶出自己的家园。

english.title: Aiding Our Allies
english.objectives: Deliver supplies to Meliah Grayfeather.
english.description:
Our Skyhorn allies could use some assistance. 

Their ongoing war with the invading harpies has left them low on supplies. 

Anything we can give them will surely help with their efforts to rid those witches from their village.

text.title: 重生之种
text.objectives: 德兰多斯·闪月要你搜索薄雾谷的森林，找到三颗泰安度之种。
text.description: 阿莎曼之牙的处境相当危险，$n。一万年以来，一直有强大的魔法结界保护它们，所以没有人能够窃取。但是随着时间的流逝，结界逐渐变得脆弱，并且已经濒临消失。我最信任的三位灰烬德鲁伊手上有泰安度之种，可以让我们进行仪式，重建结界。但现在森林里到处都是游荡的恶魔，我担心他们已经遭遇了不测。$b$b不管怎样，我们绝不能让阿莎曼之牙落入燃烧军团手里！我们必须在结界失效之前找到泰安度之种！

english.title: Seeds of Renewal
english.objectives: Delandros Shimmermoon wants you to search the forests of Mistvale and obtain three Tel'andu Seeds.
english.description: The Fangs of Ashamane are in danger, $n. For ten thousand years a powerful magic ward has protected them from any would-be thieves, but the ward has weakened over time and is in danger of failing. My three most trusted Ashen have the Tel'andu seeds we need to perform the ritual of renewal,  but the woods are now crawling with demons and I fear they have fallen.$b$bNo matter what, we cannot allow the Legion to obtain the Fangs! Go and find the Tel'andu seeds, we must hurry before the ward can be broken!

text.title: 援助灰烬德鲁伊
text.objectives: 击败$1oa个艾瑞达鞭魂者，救出他们手里的俘虏。
text.description: 你抬头就能看到给我们带来不幸的源头。那艘飞船出现以后，我们就受到了源源不断的攻击。许多灰烬德鲁伊遭到了俘虏，我现在也能听到他们备受折磨的哀嚎。$b$b拜托你到那里去尽可能救出我的同胞。落在燃烧军团手里，等待着他们的是惨绝人寰的命运。他们不该遭受这样的下场。

english.title: Aid for the Ashen
english.objectives: Defeat $1oa Eredar Soul Lashers and free their captives.
english.description: Turn your eyes above and you will see the cause of our misfortune. Ever since that ship appeared the attacks have been relentless. Many of the Ashen have been captured and even now I can hear their screams of torture.$b$bPlease, go out there and rescue as many of my followers as you can. They do not deserve the fate that awaits them if left in the Legion's grip.

text.title: 祭坛的危机
text.objectives: 协助德兰多斯清除残余的攻击者。
text.description: 你帮了我们大忙，勇士。现在，你该说明一下你此行的目的了。$b$b<你告诉德兰多斯，大德鲁伊巨蹄派你来寻找阿莎曼之牙。>$b$b嗯……如果你在之前跟我提起这件事情，我早就让你走人了。阿莎曼之牙是我们最珍贵的宝物，不过，你今天为灰烬德鲁伊做出了巨大的贡献，而我一向言出必行。$b$b好吧，我们先把剩下的恶魔都清理掉，然后你就可以拿到你的武器。

english.title: The Shrine in Peril
english.objectives: Assist Delandros by removing the last of the attackers.
english.description: You've helped us greatly, champion. Now, it is time that you tell me what brings you here.$b$b<You mention to Delandros that Archdruid Greathoof sent you to seek the Fangs of Ashamane.>$b$bHrm... if you had told me this at the outset, I would have told you to take a walk. The Fangs are our greatest treasure, but you've done a great deed for the Ashen today and I am an elf of my word.$b$bVery well, let's clear out the rest of these demons and you shall have your weapons.

text.title: 黑羽的困境
text.objectives: 跟随惊恐的鸦熊去找黑羽酋长。
text.description:
<鸦熊胡乱地比划着，朝路的方向指了指。

看来他想要你跟着他。>

english.title: Plight of the Blackfeather
english.objectives: Follow the frightened ravenbear to the Blackfeather chieftain.
english.description:
<The ravenbear frantically gestures and points down the path. 

It seems he wants you to follow him.>

text.title: 尼索格的祭品
text.objectives: 在裂风丘陵收集8根完整的雄鹿鹿角和16根完整的雄鹰尾羽。
text.description:
看来鸦熊们正在收集仪式所需的材料，但由于风暴幼龙的阻挠，他们无法完成工作。

看样子他们正从附近的巨鹿和雄鹰身上收集完好的鹿角和细长的尾羽。

收集他们还缺少的那部分材料应该费不了多少时间。

english.title: Nithogg's Tribute
english.objectives: Collect 8 Intact Greatstag Antlers and 16 Pristine Eagle Tailfeathers in the Stormtorn Foothills.
english.description:
It looks like the ravenbears have started gathering materials for some sort of tribute, but the storm drakes are keeping them from finishing what they started.  

From the looks of it, they're gathering fully intact stag horns and long tail feathers from the greatstags and eagles nearby. 

It shouldn't take too long to gather the rest of what they need.

text.title: 烧焦的羽毛
text.objectives: 在裂风丘陵击杀8个狂暴的猎风者。
text.description:
呱呱！呱呱！

<酋长拍打着翅膀，指着风暴之龙攻击他的鸦熊族人的地方。

显然，他希望你救救他的族人。>

english.title: Singed Feathers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Rampaging Squallhunters in the Stormtorn Foothills.
english.description:
Ca-caw! Caw caw!

<The chieftain flaps his wings and points outside where the storm dragons attack the ravenbears of his tribe. 

It's plain to see that he's seeking your help to save his flock.>

text.title: 与鸦熊共舞
text.objectives: 帮助黑羽鸦熊进行仪式。
text.description:
<酋长让鸦熊们把祭品聚在一处，朝外面的仪式圆环打了个手势。>

呱！呱呱呱！

<看来他想要你跟着他。>

english.title: Dances With Ravenbears
english.objectives: Help the Blackfeather ravenbears perform their tribute ritual.
english.description:
<The chieftain beckons for the ravenbears to gather the tribute and gestures toward the ritual circle outside.>

Caw! Caw ca-caw!

<It looks like he wants you to follow.>

text.title: 四骑士归来
text.objectives: 在杜隆塔尔与萨萨里安谈一谈。
text.description: 死亡领主，巫妖王已经发声，而黑锋骑士也将听从你的命令。$b$b天启四骑士和普通的死亡骑士并不相同，他们从巫妖王赐给克尔苏加德的那份纯净的邪恶能量中诞生。$b$b这份复活死者的邪恶能量现在已经传到了你的身上，死亡领主。我相信，你将带着坚定的信念使用这份力量。$b$b天启四骑士将成为我们对抗燃烧军团的强大战力……而纳兹戈林正适合作为我们的第一个复活对象。

english.title: Return of the Four Horsemen
english.objectives: Speak with Thassarian in Durotar.
english.description: The voice of the Lich King has spoken, Deathlord, and the Knights of the Ebon Blade will obey your command.$b$bThe Four Horsemen were no ordinary death knights, they were born of pure, unholy power gifted from the Lich King to Kel'thuzad.$b$bThis unholy power to raise the dead has now been passed to you, Deathlord. I am sure you will wield it with great conviction.$b$bThe Four Horsemen will be powerful allies against the Burning Legion... and Nazgrim is a worthy choice as the firstborn.

text.title: 卡雷的计划
text.objectives: 在魔法回廊地窟附近的山脊上找到卡雷苟斯。
text.description:
因为周围有大量燃烧军团在活动，你的勇士无法太过深入魔法回廊地窟。希望你能更走运点，可以发现大法师瓦格斯在里面的踪迹。

卡雷苟斯会在俯瞰邪魂堡垒的山脊上等你。

english.title: Kalec's Plan
english.objectives: Meet Kalecgos on the ridge near the Arcway Vaults.
english.description:
Your champion was unable to penetrate very far inside the Arcway Vaults due to the heavy legion presence around it.  Hopefully you will have better luck following Archmage Vargoth inside.

Kalecgos will be waiting for you on the ridge overlooking Felsoul Hold.

text.title: 寻找黑檀之寒
text.objectives: 在守护者圣殿调查被遗忘的书堆，寻找与黑檀之寒的最后一位主人艾里克斯有关的线索。
text.description: 黑檀之寒的制造者阿洛迪及其历来的持有者都很强大。阿洛迪将它托付自己最得意的门生，然后如此传承下去，直到……传到艾里克斯手上，应该就是他。$b$b艾里克斯在第一次大战时消失了。我不清楚他发生了什么事，不过答案可能就在这座图书馆里。$b$b在这里好好找找，任何线索都可能引领我们找到黑檀之寒。

english.title: Finding Ebonchill
english.objectives: Investigate the forgotten stacks in the Hall of the Guardian for clues to Ebonchill's last known master, Arrexis.
english.description: Ebonchill bears a lineage of powerful wielders dating back to its maker, Alodi. He passed it on to his favorite apprentice and so on until... the archmage Arrexis, I believe.$b$bArrexis disappeared sometime around the First War. I know nothing of his fate, but the answer may well be somewhere in this library.$b$bStart by looking around here. Whatever you find should lead us to Ebonchill.

text.title: 卡兹格罗斯之锤
text.objectives: 使用达拉然的中央传送器，把卡兹格罗斯之锤放到艾格文画廊里。
text.description: <你已经击败地底之王达古尔并取得卡兹格罗斯之锤，是时候把它放到达拉然地下的艾格文画廊里了。>

english.title: The Hammer of Khaz'goroth
english.objectives: Use the central teleporter in Dalaran and then place the Hammer of Khaz'goroth in Aegwynn's Gallery.
english.description: <Now that you have defeated Dargrul the Underking and have the Hammer of Khaz'goroth in hand, it is time to place it in Aegwynn's Gallery in the lower chambers of Dalaran.>

objectiveDetails.description: 使用达拉然的中央传送器

text.title: 阿洛迪的宝石
text.objectives: 进入阿洛迪在达拉然银行的私人金库，取出法力宝石。
text.description: 艾里克斯有一整队的学徒和下属来帮他进行仪式，而你现在可没有这些资源。$b$b从前因为魔法知识比较不足，施法需要消耗大量的法力，我们会把法力储存在宝石里以供施展复杂的法术。$b$b幸好我的金库里还留着一些强大的法力宝石和一些有用的东西。你只需要进入达拉然银行，把东西取出来就行。

english.title: Alodi's Gems
english.objectives: Gain access to Alodi's personal bank vault in Dalaran and retrieve the Mana Gems.
english.description: Arrexis had a cadre of apprentices and subordinates to help him with the ritual, something you are currently lacking.$b$bIn older times, when magic was less understood and spells required vast amounts of mana to cast, we stored mana in gems for use in complex spells.$b$bLucky for us, I still have a few powerful Mana Gems in my vault, along with some other useful items. You merely need to go to the Bank of Dalaran and gain access.

objectiveDetails.description: 进入阿洛迪的私人金库

text.title: 逆风营地
text.objectives: 在卡拉赞附近的艾里克斯营地里收集仪式的信息。
text.description:
你找到的线索与卡拉赞附近的一处实验场地有关。希望那个仪式还会剩下一些我们用得上的材料。

你必须找到那个场地，并带回任何可以帮助我们重现仪式的东西。我也会在这里继续寻找线索。

english.title: The Deadwind Site
english.objectives: Find and retrieve information on the ritual from Arrexis's campsite near Karazhan.
english.description:
Your research spoke of an experimental site out near Karazhan. I hope there are still materials on this ritual that will aid us there.

You will need to find the site and bring back anything that will help us recreate the ritual. I will dig deeper here as well.

objectiveDetails.description: 收集关于仪式的任何资料
飞往卡拉赞附近的肯瑞托废弃营地
（可选）使用传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 衰老的戴奥
text.objectives: 飞往诅咒之地的腐烂之痕，从衰老的戴奥那里获取信息。
text.description: 资料里提到一个叫戴奥的人，说他擅长恶魔仪式。该不会是指衰老的戴奥吧！$b$b他以前竟然是肯瑞托的人，我原来只知道他是一个教年轻人学习地狱火魔法的年迈术士。难怪他会改行。$b$b他肯定知道这个仪式的关键信息。虽然他已经退休了，不过他应该还在诅咒之地的腐烂之痕。你应该去找他。

english.title: Daio the Decrepit
english.objectives: Fly to the Tainted Scar in the Blasted Lands and get information from Daio the Decrepit.
english.description: That text lists someone named Daio as being instrumental to the demonic ritual. They can't possibly mean Daio the Decrepit!$b$bI never knew he was Kirin Tor. I only know him as an elderly warlock who trains young recruits in the infernal arts. This would certainly explain his change of occupation.$b$bHe most likely holds key information for this to work. Though retired, I believe he is still out in the Tainted Scar in the Blasted Lands. You should seek him out.

objectiveDetails.description: 飞往腐烂之痕并找到戴奥
（可选）使用传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 法师追击
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔重现艾里克斯的仪式并击败巴拉杜尔。
text.description: 先不管能不能做到完美，我们已经有足够的资源可以重现仪式。必须在一个非常显眼的地方进行仪式，才能让我们的目标尽快收到消息。$b$b我收到报告，燃烧军团在阿苏纳的法罗纳尔地区投入了大量兵力。要引蛇出洞的话，那里就是最理想的地点。$b$b不过，我们可能会死得很难看。
text.completed: 回守护者圣殿找梅瑞尔。

english.title: The Mage Hunter
english.objectives: Recreate Arrexis' ritual in Faronaar and defeat Balaadur.
english.description: And with that, we have what we need to recreate the ritual... however flawed it may be. It must be conducted somewhere highly visible so that word reaches our target swiftly.$b$bI've heard reports that the Legion is heavily invested in the Faronaar region of Azsuna. An excellent place to begin a ritual they won't want us to complete.$b$bThe chances of us dying horribly are exceptionally high.
english.completed: Return to Meryl in the Hall of the Guardians.

objectiveDetails.description: 从达拉然搭乘角鹰兽前往法罗纳尔

text.title: 全押红色
text.objectives: 在黄金海湾从钢鳞身上收集钢鳞的鳍。
text.description:
好，还有最后一头野兽要你去料理。这头野兽有点与众不同，但绝对值得一战。我这次押了一大笔钱！

有一头大鲨鱼沿着东边海岸游荡，当地人叫他钢鳞。他们说这条鱼的皮刀枪不入。

但你会用实际行动证明他们错了，对吧？把他的鳍带来，那些牛头人就得输给我一大笔钱。

english.title: Put It All on Red
english.objectives: Collect Steelscale's Fin from Steelscale in Citrine Bay.
english.description:
All right, I've got one last beasty to send you after. He's a bit far out, but trust me, it'll be worth it. This one I put a huge wager on!

Along the eastern coast swims a great shark the locals call Steelscale. They say his hide is near impenetrable.

But you're gonna prove them wrong, aren't ya chum? Bring me his fin, and those tauren will have to fork over a princely sum.

text.title: 勇士复生
text.objectives: 将纳兹戈林复生为死亡骑士。
text.description: 纳兹戈林将军是世界上最优秀的勇士之一，而且他的忠诚无与伦比……即便他是个兽人。$b$b他理应得到安息，但是这个世界急需拯救。安息的时刻结束了……$b$b来吧，死亡领主……让我们迎接纳兹戈林加入诅咒大军的行列。

english.title: The Firstborn Rises
english.objectives: Raise Nazgrim as a Death Knight.
english.description: General Nazgrim was one of the finest warriors our world has known, and his loyalty was unsurpassed... even for an orc.$b$bHe deserves the peace of death, but this world cries out to be saved. The time for rest is over...$b$bCome, Deathlord... let us welcome Nazgrim into the arms of the damned.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 走失的小孩
text.objectives: 护送康妮返回残月酒馆，让她与母亲维伦妮团聚。
text.description:
我现在准备好回家了，但外面还是有很多可怕的人……

你会陪着我吗？保护我不被他们抓走？

我不想再回到笼子里了……

english.title: Little One Lost
english.objectives: Escort Korine back to her mother Verene at the Waning Crescent.
english.description:
I'm ready to go home now, but there are still scary men outside...

Will you stay with me? Make sure they don't take me away?

I don't want to go back in the cage...

text.title: 外面的朋友
text.objectives: 启动传送板，把凡瑟尔的礼物交给塔莉萨。
text.description:
你在这里帮了我们很多忙，但是时候让你回去塔莉萨身边了。

附近有个传送板，近年来一直无人使用。你试试能否重新定向，用它回到塔莉萨身边。

哦，你出发之前：

<凡瑟尔交给你一瓶包装好的魔力酒。>

请把这个交给她，感谢她送你来帮忙。请告诉她，你帮助我们补满了魔力酒的存货，还令一位母亲得以和她的孩子团聚。

我们的感激之情难以言表。让我们暂且告别吧。

english.title: Friends On the Outside
english.objectives: Activate the teleporter pad and bring Vanthir's gift to Thalyssra.
english.description:
You have done well for us here, but it is time for you to return to Thalyssra.

There is a teleporter pad nearby that has gone unused in recent years. See if you can reroute it and return to her that way.

Oh, and before you go:

<Vanthir hands you a wrapped bottle of Arcwine.>

Take this to her, with my thanks for sending you. Let her know that your efforts helped replenish our Arcwine supplies and reunited a mother and child.

We are grateful beyond measure. Farewell for now.

objectiveDetails.description: 把凡瑟尔的礼物交给塔莉萨

text.title: 塔莉萨的住所
text.objectives: 搜索塔莉萨的住所，收集3个增幅器碎片。将它们组合成一个奥术增幅器。
text.description:
你在城里忙活的时候，我的枯法者研究遇到了瓶颈。

我觉得自己就快突破这个障碍了，但没有某些高级的工具的话，我恐怕无法成功。

我在自己的财物里藏了一件叫做奥术增幅器的东西。它的功能就和名称一样。

魔导师很可能下令拆毁了我的住所。如果增幅器还在，肯定已经变成碎片。

如果可以的话，请你将它修复完整。

english.title: Thalyssra's Abode
english.objectives: Search Thalyssra's estate and collect 3 Amplifier Fragments. Combine them into an Arcane Amplifier.
english.description:
While you were busy in the city I reached a roadblock in my withered research. 

I feel I am close to overcoming this barrier, but I'm afraid I cannot do so without some more advanced tools.

I hid among my possessions an item called an Arcane Amplifier. It does precisely what its name entails.

It is more than likely that the Magistrix ordered my estate dismantled. If the Amplifier remains, it will be in fragments.

Recover the whole, if you can.

text.title: 塔莉萨的抽屉
text.objectives: 搜索塔莉萨的住所，收集她的物品。
text.description: 塔莉萨的住所被洗劫一空，但依旧留有很多对塔莉萨来说很重要的东西。收集这些东西，还给塔莉萨。

english.title: Thalyssra's Drawers
english.objectives: Search Thalyssra's estate and collect her belongings.
english.description: Thalyssra's ransacked estate still contains a number of items important to Thalyssra. Collect them and return them to her.

text.title: 魔法回廊：打开魔法回廊
text.objectives: 在魔法回廊消灭顾问凡多斯。
text.description:
苏拉玛的地底深处有许多错综复杂的通道，被称为魔法回廊。自从一场灾难导致那里的法力收集器中断运行以后，通道就被废弃了。

我不知道你在那下面会遇到什么，不过有一件事可以肯定。

我们不是唯一对这个地方有兴趣的人。只要动静够大，曾经和我一起侍奉艾利桑德的一个顾问就会出现。

他的名字是凡多斯。有本事的话就杀掉他。

凡多斯是艾利桑德的得力干将，除掉他就意味着我们又取得了一场胜利。

english.title: The Arcway: Opening the Arcway
english.objectives: Slay Advisor Vandros in the Arcway.
english.description:
Deep beneath Suramar is a defunct set of tunnels known as the Arcway. They were abandoned when a disaster disrupted the mana collectors operating there. 

I know not what awaits you down there, but I do know one thing.

We are not the only ones interested in this place. Make enough noise and one of the advisors with whom I served under Elisande is sure to appear.

His name is Vandros. Slay him, if you can.

His death will be our victory, as we deprive Elisande of one more weapon in her arsenal.

text.title: 魔法回廊：掩埋已久的知识
text.objectives: 从魔法回廊中获取苏拉玛魔网地图。
text.description:
苏拉玛城的地下铺有古老的地道网络，名为魔法回廊。

由于一部分岩洞变得不稳定，这些地道很久以前就废弃了。之后的情况，谁知道呢？

且不论那下面现在有什么东西，我相信你会找到有助于我们将来成功的关键物品。

很久以前，我的人民对苏拉玛城内部和周围的魔网进行过一次彻底的调查。他们应该是把调查结果存放在了魔法回廊的图书馆里。

帮我找到那份地图。

english.title: The Arcway: Long Buried Knowledge
english.objectives: Acquire the Suramar Leyline Map from the Arcway.
english.description:
Beneath Suramar City is an ancient network of tunnels known as the Arcway.

They were abandoned some time ago as part of the cavern became unstable. Since then, who knows?

Regardless of what is currently down there, I believe you will find something essential to our continued success.

Long ago my people took a thorough survey of the ley lines in and around Suramar. This they would have stored in the library in the Arcway. 

Find this map for me.

text.title: PH: Withered Scenario
text.objectives: PH
text.description: PH

english.title: PH: Withered Scenario
english.objectives: PH
english.description: PH

text.title: 末日降临！
text.objectives: 调查夜之子宝库。
text.description:
米尔豪斯总能招惹到麻烦，所以大法师瓦格斯要是在这儿，他肯定能碰上。

哦对了，如果你恰好找到了夜之子灵魂石，最好先拿上！

english.title: Impending Dooooooom!
english.objectives: Investigate the Nightborne Vault.
english.description:
Millhouse attracts trouble, so he's sure to find Archmage Vargoth if he's still here. 

Oh and if you do find the Nightborne Soulstone, best get it first!

text.title: 不只是个小贩
text.objectives: 消灭15只恶魔，并将你制造的魔法食品散发给10位饥饿的囚犯。
text.description:
你的勇士们有效削减了敌人的数量。他们也发现了一批急需我们帮助的饥饿的囚犯。你制造的魔法布丁或者煎饼可以帮助他们站起来。

同时你需要把剩下的那些军团入侵者尽可能多地送回扭曲虚空！

english.title: More Than Just A Food Vendor
english.objectives: Eradicate 15 demons and give your conjured food to 10 starving prisoners.
english.description:
Your champions made a good dent in thinning out the enemy's numbers. They also discovered a number of starving prisoners who could use our help. Your Conjured Mana Pudding or Fritters will be useful in getting them up on their feet. 

You should also dispatch as many of the remaining legion invaders back to the twisting nether as you can!

text.title: 完成工作
text.objectives: 前往诅咒之地，在暴风祭坛刺杀卡登·影眼，并在他的身上寻找线索。
text.description: 为了刺杀军团的邪教首领，迦罗娜已经出去了一段时间。她从此音信全无。$B$B更糟的是，她还带走了弑君者。她很清楚，弑君者会让她的缺点暴露无遗！$B$B要找到迦罗娜的最好办法就是完成她的工作。我们的情报指出，一个名叫卡登·影眼的术士正在诅咒之地的暴风祭坛诱惑新的教徒。去看看他身上有没有什么有用的信息。$b$b我的意思是，在他的尸体上寻找线索。

english.title: Finishing the Job
english.objectives: Assassinate Cade Shadowgaze at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands and search his body for information.
english.description: Garona set out to assassinate the leaders of a Legion cult some time ago. We haven't heard from her since.$B$BTo make matters worse, she took the Kingslayers with her. She knows they bring out the worst in her!$B$BYour best bet to find Garona is by continuing her work. Our intel points to a warlock by the name of Caden Shadowgaze inducting new recruits at the Altar of Storms in Blasted Lands. See if he has anything useful in his pockets.$b$bOnce he's dead, I mean.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 无处可藏
text.objectives: 前往暮色森林，在乌鸦岭刺杀邪能召唤者维特雷，并在他的身上寻找线索。
text.description: 我们又得到一条可能有用的线索。去找另一个邪教精英，邪能召唤者维特雷。他每次都能逃过我们的追捕。$B$B根据最新情报，他正藏身于暮色森林乌鸦岭的村庄里。他身上肯定有能够帮你展开搜寻的重要线索。$B$B你知道该怎么做。

english.title: No Sanctuary
english.objectives: Assassinate Felcaller Whitley at Raven Hill in Duskwood and search his body for information.
english.description: We have one other lead that may prove useful. Goes by Felcaller Whitley, another of the cult's elite. He's eluded our agents at every turn.$B$BOur latest reconnaissance report puts him somewhere in the village of Raven Hill in Duskwood. He's sure to have information vital to your search.$B$BYou know what to do.

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用传送门前往卡拉赞

text.title: 破译者
text.objectives: 使用邪能解码器破译加密信息，了解你接下来该去哪里寻找邪教徒。
text.description: <有一股强大的魔力保护着你得到的这条加密信息，使你无法通过常规手段进行破译。>$B$B<借助你从邪能召唤者维特雷身上找到的密码，或许可以破译信息，让你离邪教的行动基地和迦罗娜更近一步。>

english.title: Codebreaker
english.objectives: Use the Fel Cipher to decrypt the Coded Message and learn where you can find the cultists next.
english.description: <The coded message you obtained is protected by powerful magic, rendering it indecipherable by conventional means.>$B$B<If you use the cipher you took from Felcaller Whitley you might be able to crack the code, leading you ever closer to both the cult's base of operations and Garona.>

text.title: 无形之刃
text.objectives: 帮助迦罗娜清除暴风城里的隐蔽之手邪教徒。
text.description: 我们绝不能让暴风城落入燃烧军团之手。我不相信肖尔和他那些军情七处的傻瓜可以解决隐蔽之手教派。$B$B趁着现在还有时间，我们两个必须好好处理。$B$B邪教已经煽动了整座城市，如果稍有不慎，你就可能受到他们的攻击。$B$B其他的影行者都对你赞誉有加。你愿意帮忙吗？

english.title: The Unseen Blade
english.objectives: Help Garona take out the Veiled Hand cultists in Stormwind.
english.description: We can't let Stormwind fall to the Legion, and I don't trust Shaw or his SI:7 goons to take care of the Hand on their own.$B$BThe two of us need to handle this while there's still time.$B$BThe entire city is on edge from murmurs of the cult's activities. They're as likely to turn on you as they are the cultists if you aren't careful.$B$BThe other Shadows spoke highly of your skills. Are you in?

text.title: 龙有利齿
text.objectives: 骑着卡雷苟斯进入魔法回廊地窟。
text.description:
数千年来，魔法回廊地窟都被埋葬在地下，无人触及。感谢燃烧军团，我们得以再次进入，不过我并不希望它重见天日。

我想我们已经快追上大法师瓦格斯了，他可能还在魔法回廊里。要追上他的话，我们可得抓紧了。

english.title: Not A Toothless Dragon
english.objectives: Ride with Kalecgos to the Arcway Vaults.
english.description:
The Arcway Vaults have been buried and untouched for thousands of years. We have the legion to thank for it being accessible once again, though I would give much for it to remain hidden.

I think we are not far behind Archmage Vargoth's heels and he may yet be inside the vaults. We should make haste if we hope to intercept him.

text.title: 不朽灵魂
text.objectives: 找到鲜血祭品以完成仪式，并联络伊利丹·怒风的灵魂。
text.description:
伊利丹那不朽的恶魔之魂迷失在浩瀚的扭曲虚空之中。那里充满了恶魔生物，他们的力量和胃口超乎我们的想象，所以与他联络具有极高的风险。不过，如果我们想取得进展，就必须排除万难。

我们可以用虚空坩埚进行仪式。找到鲜血祭品，$n。

english.title: Immortal Soul
english.objectives: Make the Blood Offering to complete the ritual and contact the soul of Illidan Stormrage.
english.description:
Illidan's immortal demon soul is lost somewhere in the vastness of the Twisting Nether. Contacting him risks much, the Nether is full of creatures of unimaginable power and appetites. But, it must be done if we are to move forward.

The ritual can be performed using the nether crucible. Make the blood offering, $n.

text.title: 至高岭屹立不倒
text.objectives: 击败达古尔。
text.description: 这样应该可以了。达古尔来了，每一个可以战斗的人都要上前线。去吧，我会跟着你。
text.completion: The village. It... it is just... gone. They told me what happened to Riverbend but I figured that was an exageration.

english.title: Highmountain Stands
english.objectives: Defeat Dargrul.
english.description: That will have to do. Dargrul has come and we need every able body on the front line. Go, I will be right behind you.
english.completion: The village. It... it is just... gone. They told me what happened to Riverbend but I figured that was an exageration.

text.title: 力量增长
text.objectives: 与梦境林地的大德鲁伊伦萨·巨蹄对话。
text.description: 大德鲁伊伦萨·巨蹄希望见你。$B$B我们正在准备破碎群岛的防御，而我们需要你来指挥。

english.title: Growing Power
english.objectives: Speak to Archdruid Rensar Greathoof at the Dreamgrove.
english.description: Archdruid Rensar Greathoof has requested your presence.$B$BOur campaign to defend the Broken Isles is getting under way, and we need you at the helm.

text.title: 末日仪式
text.objectives: 在恐痕裂隙的召唤平台进行末日仪式。
text.description:
随着研究的深入，你现在已经可以进行一个非常强大的仪式。不过，如果你想成功召唤出恶魔的话，就需要一些朋友的帮助。

你需要到上面的召唤平台才能进行仪式。

记住，要得到这种力量必须付出代价。你要做好准备，参与召唤的人不一定都能活下来。

english.title: Ritual of Doom
english.objectives: Perform the Ritual of Doom at the Summoning Platform within Dreadscar Rift.
english.description:
Your research has granted you access to a very powerful ritual, one that will require the aid of a few friends if you wish to successfully summon a demon.

The ritual needs to be performed at the summoning platform above. 

Keep in mind, this sort of power always comes at a price. Not all who participate in the summoning will survive, so be prepared.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募伊墨瑞尔和罗伦·雷蹄。
text.description: 你是组织的领袖，其他的猎人都将依赖你的引导。许多人都愿意为你效力，以隐秘通途的名义履行使命。$B$B我知道两位猎人同胞，他们看到你一直以来的努力而对你倍感钦佩。他们希望尽全力提供协助。$B$B找到他们，让他们为你分忧。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Emmarel Shadewarden and Loren Stormhoof.
english.description: As leader of our order, other hunters will look to you for guidance. Many will be willing to pledge themselves to you, doing whatever is necessary in the name of the Unseen Path.$B$BI know of two within our ranks who are impressed with what they've seen from you so far, and want to help any way they can.$B$BSeek them out, and let them ease the burden of leadership.

text.title: 巨大损失
text.objectives: 返回守护者圣殿。
text.description:
之前的我也许会说，事态居然变得这么糟糕。但现在的我不会对任何事情感到吃惊了。这是黑暗的时刻，即便是我们之中最正直的人也会堕落……

我们最好把瓦格斯的背叛通知大法师卡德加。

english.title: A Terrible Loss
english.objectives: Return to the Hall of the Guardian.
english.description:
I would say I am surprised by this terrible turn of events, but nothing surprises me of late. It is dark times when even the most upstanding of us can fall... 

We had best inform Archmage Khadgar of Vargoth's betrayal.

text.title: 我敌人的敌人……
text.objectives: 找到米尔豪斯·法力风暴。
text.description:
米尔豪斯·法力风暴从未掩饰过他对夜之子灵魂石的强烈渴望。如果你找到了他，你也许能利用他一下。

不过，即便在最好的情况下，他也是个喜怒无常的家伙，所以在他身边时，一定要小心你的身后，$n。如果你发现他了，就用这块水晶和我联络。

english.title: The Enemy of My Enemy...
english.objectives: Find Millhouse Manastorm.
english.description:
Millhouse Manastorm has been quite vociferous about his intention to acquire the Nightborne Soulstone. If you find him, you may as well make use of him. 

However, he is unpredictable at best and you should always watch your back around him, $n. Use my crystal to contact me once you have located him.

objectiveDetails.description: 营救米尔豪斯·法力风暴
找到米尔豪斯·法力风暴

text.title: 伊利达雷的领袖
text.objectives: 上楼向其他人宣布你已经成为伊利达雷的新领袖。
text.description:
伊利丹已经正式让你负责，$n。伊利达雷现在听你差遣。

到楼上来找我。我们要向所有人宣布这件事情。

english.title: Leader of the Illidari
english.objectives: Head upstairs and take your place as the new leader of the Illidari.
english.description:
Illidan has officially placed you in charge, $n. The Illidari are now yours.

Meet me upstairs. We will let everyone know together.

text.title: 进行接触
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“乐娜拉需要帮助”。
text.description: 我们已经招募了许多的勇士，我们可以使用侦察地图来完成破碎群岛四处的重要任务。$B$B近些年来，我们的斥候一直在密切关注那些有可能加入我们的猎手，其中一位就是乐娜拉。她在前往神射手营地的途中遭遇了袭击。$B$B我建议派出罗伦·雷蹄去援救她。他极为适合执行此次任务。

english.title: Making Contact
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Lenara Needs Help."
english.description: Now that we have recruited champions for our order, we can use the Scouting Map to complete vital assignments across the Broken Isles.$B$BOver the years our scouts have kept a close eye on hunters that might one day be added to our ranks. One such hunter, Lenara, was on her way to Trueshot Lodge when she was attacked.$B$BI suggest that we send Loren Stormhoof on a mission to rescue her. He may be uniquely suited to this task.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“乐娜拉需要帮助”任务

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与征募官乐娜拉谈一谈并训练一队弓箭手。
text.description: 征募官乐娜拉是一位杰出的弓箭手，她的天赋让我们的勇士如虎添翼。$B$B她可以百步穿杨，箭无虚发。$B$B跟她谈一谈，并训练弓箭手小队。

english.title: Recruiting The Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Recruiter Lenara and train a troop of archers.
english.description: Our champions acquired the talents of Recruiter Lenara, an extraordinary archer.$B$BShe can hit the smallest of targets at extended ranges. Her arrows never miss.$B$BSpeak to her now and train a squad of archers.

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“部队出勤”任务。
text.description: 是时候派出我们新训练的弓箭手上战场了。使用侦察地图，派出你的勇士和部队执行常规侦察任务。

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Troops in the Field."
english.description: It's time to send our newly trained archers out into the field. Look at the Scouting Map and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 在神射手营地与生存专家巴恩谈一谈。
text.description: 我们非常幸运，能够得到生存专家巴恩的帮助。他年轻时在潘达利亚居住，依靠当地的动植物为生。$B$B他在利用有限资源方面的丰富经验对神射手营地的发展举足轻重。$B$B现在，去和他谈谈，看看他能为我们做点什么。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Survivalist Bahn in Trueshot Lodge.
english.description: We are very fortunate to have come across Survivalist Bahn. He spent his younger years living off the land in Pandaria, relying on the native flora and fauna to survive.$B$BHis firsthand experience with building from limited resources could really help shape Trueshot Lodge into something great.$B$BSpeak to him now and see what he can do for us.

text.title: 失落王国
text.objectives: 在激流堡跟加林·托尔贝恩王子谈一谈。
text.description: 巫妖王揭示了天启四骑士中的第二位……或许，即使是国王，面对周围的世界陷入战火的时候，也无法继续安息吧。$b$b就这样吧，死亡领主。$b$b我会让纳兹戈林和萨萨里安到陨落的王国激流堡那里与你汇合。$b$B加林·托尔贝恩王子拥有进入他父亲陵墓的钥匙，那是一把被称为托卡拉尔的名剑。为了将这位国王复活为第二位天启四骑士，我们就必须进入这座陵墓。你必须尽一切可能，说服加林来帮助我们……

english.title: The Ruined Kingdom
english.objectives: Speak with Prince Galen Trollbane in Stromgarde.
english.description: So the Lich King has revealed the second of the Four Horsemen... it appears that not even kings may rest as the world burns around them.$b$bSo be it, Deathlord.$b$bI will send Nazgrim and Thassarian to meet you at the fallen kingdom of Stromgarde.$b$BPrince Galen Trollbane holds the key to the tomb of his father, a famous sword known as Trol'kalar. In order to raise the king as the second of the Four Horsemen, we will need to gain entrance to the tomb.$b$bDo what you must to persuade Galen assist us...

text.title: 最古老的宿敌
text.objectives: 收集15个枯木巨魔的徽记。
text.description: 我可以让黑锋骑士团进入我父亲的墓穴。不过，我要先请你帮个忙。$b$b我继承了父亲的剑和旌旗。我已经收复激流堡，并将保护原本的市民视为己任。不过，还有一个工作尚未完成。$b$b枯木入侵者在城里占据并封锁了原本的法师区。他们的邪恶势力让我的手下损失惨重。$b$b把他们统统杀光！带回他们的徽记，我就把你要的东西交给你。$b$b这是我作为激流堡国王的承诺。

english.title: Our Oldest Enemies
english.objectives: Collect 15 Witherbark Troll heads.
english.description: I will grant the Ebon Blade access to my father's tomb. First though, I must ask a favor.$b$bI have taken up the sword and banner of my father. I have reclaimed Stromgarde with its former citizens as my guard. Yet, one task remains.$b$bWitherbark invaders have blockaded themselves in the former mage district of the city. My men have suffered heavy losses at their vile hands.$b$bCut them down to the last! Bring me their heads and I shall give you what you seek.$b$bYou have my word as the King of Stromgarde.

text.title: 枯萎……凋零
text.objectives: 对10份枯木补给释放瘟疫。
text.description: 我的家族世代与枯木巨魔作战……他们总在阿拉希的土地上出没，就像是诅咒一般。我要把他们彻底赶出激流堡！$b$b摧毁他们的补给，让他们再也不能回来。去释放天灾瘟疫……或者用任何死亡骑士的手段去制造破坏。我不在乎。$b$b只要确保达到目的就好！

english.title: Death... and Decay
english.objectives: Blight 10 Witherbark Supplies.
english.description: My family has fought the Witherbark trolls for generations... their presence in Arathi has always been a curse upon the land. I want to drive them out of Stromgarde for good!$b$bDestroy their supplies and we shall give them no incentive to return. Blight their supplies... or whatever it is you death knights do to defile things. I care not.$b$bJust make sure that it is done!

text.title: 弑君者
text.objectives: 从加林·托尔贝恩王子手里取得托卡拉尔。
text.description: 如果加林·托尔贝恩以为他可以背叛黑锋骑士团，那他就是个十足的傻子。$b$b我受够了他的把戏。英雄们正在挥洒热血拯救这个世界，而堕落王子却在扮演衰落王国的伟大领袖浪费我们的时间。$b$b如果加林·托尔贝恩不愿打开他父亲的墓穴，我们就必须拿到那把剑然后自己动手。$b$b如果他要抵抗，那就走着瞧。

english.title: Regicide
english.objectives: Obtain Trol'kalar from Prince Galen Trollbane.
english.description: Galen Trollbane is a fool if he thinks that he can betray the Ebon Blade.$b$bI have had enough of his games. The fallen prince wastes our time playing the king of a ruined throne, while heroes sacrifice their lives to save this world.$b$bIf Galen Trollbane will not open the tomb of his father, then we must take the sword and do it ourselves.$b$bIf he chooses to resist, so be it.

text.title: 国王复生
text.objectives: 将索拉斯国王复生为死亡骑士。
text.description: 索拉斯国王是这个世界最伟大的战士之一。$b$b人民对他爱戴有加，敌人对他畏惧三分。他从不虚情假意，常常会说出其他人都难以启齿的真相。$b$b他戎马一生，理应在死后得到安息。不过他绝不会放任世界陷入炼狱，而独自享受安宁。$b$b时候已到，死亡领主，该是迎接最后一位真正的激流堡国王加入诅咒大军的时候了。

english.title: The King Rises
english.objectives: Raise King Thoras Trollbane as a Death Knight.
english.description: King Thoras was one of the greatest warriors this world has known.$b$bHis people loved him and his enemies feared him. He only ever spoke truth, often saying the words others were afraid to speak.$b$bKing Thoras lived a life of war and he certainly deserves the peace of death. But this is not a man who would sleep peacefully while the world around him burns.$b$bThe time has come, Deathlord, to welcome the last true King of Stromgarde into the arms of the dead and damned.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 暗里藏刀
text.objectives: 在夜色镇取得无辜者的颅骨和无辜者的鲜血，并尝试刺杀阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克。
text.description: <看来邪教徒在夜色镇有一个行动基地。阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克肯定加入了邪教，不过似乎整个守夜人组织都已经变节。>$B$B<现在最好的办法是取得他们的仪式用品，并尽量拿下阿尔泰娅。迦罗娜只能再等等了。>

english.title: Cloak and Dagger
english.objectives: Retrieve the Skull of the Innocent, the Blood of the Innocent, and make an attempt on Althea Ebonlocke's life in Darkshire.
english.description: <The cultists seem to have a base of operations in Darkshire. At least Althea Ebonlocke is a member, but it is likely that the entire Night Watch has been compromised.>$B$B<The best course of action for now is to retrieve the dark implements for their ritual and make an attempt on Althea's life. Garona will have to wait.>

objectiveDetails.description: 尝试刺杀阿尔泰娅·埃伯洛克

text.title: 该死的枯法者
text.objectives: 找到进入魔能洞窟的堕夜精灵。
text.description: 赛多努说他看到堕夜精灵往魔能洞窟去了？$b$b这可不是什么好事。$b$b祖父似乎可以勉强支撑，但我和大法师需要时刻关注他。你快去我们的巢穴看看。
text.completion: $n? Is that you, my friend?$b$b<Runas coughs violently.>

english.title: Cursed to Wither
english.objectives: Find the nightfallen that entered Leyhollow.
english.description: So Cedonu said he saw nightfallen going into Leyhollow?$b$bI don't like the sound of that.$b$bGrandfather seems to be holding his own, but the archmage and I will keep an eye on him. You go investigate our caves.
english.completion: $n? Is that you, my friend?$b$b<Runas coughs violently.>

text.title: 进城准备
text.objectives: 在暴风城外面找到半兽人迦罗娜。
text.description: <阿尔泰娅逃走了，她只会去一个地方：暴风城。>$B$B如果迦罗娜在寻找邪教行踪方面跟我们有一样的进展，那她一定正在为进城做准备。>$B$B<在进城之前务必要找到她。>

english.title: Preparation
english.objectives: Find Garona Halforcen outside Stormwind.
english.description: <With Althea's escape there is only one place to go: Stormwind.>$B$B<If Garona is keeping a similar pace on the cult's trail, she's bound to be making preparations to enter the city herself.>$B$B<Finding her is paramount before moving into the city.>

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募岑塔布拉和纳拉雷克斯。
text.description: 单凭一己之力是无法打败燃烧军团的。$B$B想要赢得这场战争，我们就必须团结一致，就像多年以前那样。$B$B首先，我们必须招募更多的德鲁伊来协助我们。去找巨魔岑塔布拉和暗夜精灵纳拉雷克斯谈谈。$B$B这两位德高望重的德鲁伊一定会鼎力相助，保卫梦境林地。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Zen'tabra and Naralex.
english.description: The Legion's defeat cannot be accomplished alone.$B$BTo win this war, we must work together, just as we did in ancient times.$B$BTo begin, we must recruit more druids to our aid. Speak to the troll Zen'tabra and the night elf Naralex.$B$BBoth of them are accomplished druids. They will gladly defend the Dreamgrove.

text.title: 莉莉丝
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“莉莉丝”任务。
text.description: 大德鲁伊，在我们发展壮大之前，我们需要更多的盟友来支持我们。一名叫做莉莉丝的强大树妖正在前往梦境林地，但我们接到报告，她可能陷入了麻烦。$B$B你得派遣岑塔布拉去援救她。

english.title: Sister Lilith
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission "Sister Lilith".
english.description: We will need more allies on our side before we can be effective, Archdruid. A skilled dryad by the name of Sister Lilith is on her way to the Dreamgrove, but we've received word that she may be in trouble.$B$BSend Zen'tabra to her aid.

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与莉莉丝谈一谈并招募一些树人。
text.description: 我们的勇士在旅途中碰到了英勇无畏的莉莉丝，她是欢笑姐妹的领袖。$B$B她既是经验丰富的斗士，也是要求严苛的导师，在树妖之中备受尊崇。她一定会成为一名优秀的征募官。$B$B现在去跟她谈谈，并招募一些树人。

english.title: Recruiting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Sister Lilith and recruit some Treants.
english.description: In our champions' travels, they made contact with Sister Lilith, a fearless leader among the Laughing Sisters.$B$BShe is revered among the dryads as a seasoned warrior and a demanding teacher. She will serve as an excellent recruiter.$B$BSpeak to her now, and recruit some Treants.

text.title: 防守林地
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“防守林地”任务。
text.description: 大德鲁伊，有一个新任务需要我们特别注意。在瓦尔莎拉的森林深处，有一个叫做夏多伦林地的德鲁伊岗哨遭到了萨特的攻击。$B$B立刻派我们的勇士去解决这个问题，$n。我们不能任由这些萨特攻击！

english.title: A Glade Defense
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission,"A Glade Defense."
english.description: We have a new mission that needs our attention, Archdruid. Deep in the forests of Val'sharah, a small druidic outpost known as Shal'doren Grove is under attack by satyrs.$B$BSend our champions to deal with this threat at once, $n. We cannot allow these satyr incursions to grow unchecked!

text.title: 横生枝节
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉的梦境林地与传说中的叶须谈一谈。
text.description: 叶须之所以被冠以“传说”之名，那是有原因的。$B$B据说，他知晓从大分裂之前流传下来的传说。如果给他看看勇士找到的叶子，或许他就能为我们提供新的知识和帮助。$B$B把叶子给他带过去吧。

english.title: Branching Out
english.objectives: Speak to Leafbeard the Storied at the Dreamgrove in Val'sharah.
english.description: Leafbeard is known as the Storied for good reason.$B$BIt is said that he remembers tales from before the Sundering. After examining the inscribed leaf that our champions recovered, he may be able to provide new knowledge and improvements for the grove.$B$BGo take it to him now.

text.title: 穆兹一家的团聚
text.objectives: 找到艾瑟·智水，并把她带到雷霆图腾的圣锤之座与她的家人团聚。
text.description:
你不知道我们有多感谢你，$r。正因为有你，穆兹和我丈夫才能平安无事。我再也不会让他们离开我的视线了！

很抱歉，我还得请你帮一个忙。你觉得有没有可能找到我的母亲并把她带来这里，让她亲眼看到她的孙子没事了？

她的名字叫艾瑟，就住在雷霆图腾北边的峭壁。

english.title: Moozy's Reunion
english.objectives: Find Ethel Waterwise and reunite her with her family at the Hammer's Cradle in Thunder Totem.
english.description:
You will never know how thankful we are to you, $r. Because of you, Moozy and my husband are safe. I won't let either of them out of my sight!

I am sorry to ask one last favor of you, but do you think you could find my mother and bring her here so she can see that her grandchild is safe?

Her name is Ethel, and her home is on the northern bluff of Thunder Totem.

objectiveDetails.description: 让艾瑟·智水与家人团聚

text.title: 奥术之道
text.objectives: 在达拉然的紫罗兰城堡找到大法师兰达洛克。
text.description:
要返回黑暗神殿很不容易。黑暗收割议会侵入以后，阿卡玛和他的沙塔尔祭司竖立了一道神圣屏障，让我无法传送。

不过，我们或许有办法绕过防护机制，直接到达神殿之巅。

很久以前，我跟一个叫做兰达洛克的上层精灵……有点私交。他后来加入了肯瑞托。

如果你客客气气地请他帮忙，顺便再提一提我的名字，我相信他会出手相助的。

english.title: The Arcane Way
english.objectives: Locate Archmage Lan'dalock at the Violet Citadel in Dalaran.
english.description:
Getting into the Black Temple is going to be tricky. Following the break-in by the Council of the Black Harvest, Akama had his Sha'tari priests erect a holy barrier. It prevents my teleportation.

However, I might know a way to bypass those protections and take us directly to the Temple Summit.

Long ago, I had a... liaison with a certain high elf wizard named Lan'dalock. He later joined the Kirin Tor.

If you were to ask him very nicely, and drop my name, I am certain that he would help.

text.title: 绕路通行
text.objectives: 捉住鬼祟的小鬼，找回魔典：奥术之道。
text.description:
关于这个全息投影，我很抱歉……我最近真是分身乏术。

你是说，有一个排斥邪能魔法的神圣屏障？我正好有个东西可以帮你们绕过去，并启动玛沃伦丝的传送。

<这位高等精灵翻了翻口袋，立刻露出了讶异的表情。>

小偷！看那里……那个小鬼把它偷走了！
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找贝拉斯·黎明之刃。
text.giverWindow: 捉住鬼祟的小鬼，找回魔典：奥术之道。

english.title: Move Like No Other
english.objectives: Chase down the Sneaky Imp and recover the Grimoire of Arcane Ways.
english.description:
Sorry about the holographic projection... I literally need to be in two places at once these days.

A holy barrier that protects against fel magic, you say? I have just the thing to bypass it and enable Malevolence's teleport.

<The high elf rummages around in his pack, a shocked look quickly coming over his face.>

Sneaky! Look there... that imp just made off with it!
english.completed: Return to Belath Dawnblade on the Fel Hammer.
english.giverWindow: Catch the imp and recover the Grimoire of Arcane Ways!

text.title: 找回山地鹿
text.objectives: 找到$1oa头惊恐的山地鹿，并把它们带回莉萨·驭风的兽栏里。
text.description:
陌生人！你就是传言中所说的那个人吗？

一些幼年驼鹿在卓格巴尔引起骚乱的时候跑掉了！

我没办法去追，不然其他的驼鹿也会乱跑。

你可以帮我把它们带回来吗？
text.completion: Thank you, friend to Highmountain.

english.title: Mountainstrider Round-Up
english.objectives: Find $1oa Frightened Mountainstriders and return them to Liza Galestride's stable.
english.description:
Stranger! You are the one I have heard of?

When the kerfuffle with the drogbar happened, some of the young moose ran off!

I can't chase them down or the others might wander off as well.

Could you bring them back here?
english.completion: Thank you, friend to Highmountain.

text.title: 奥丁召唤
text.objectives: 与苍穹要塞的奥丁对话。
text.description: 奥丁大人希望立刻见到你，我的主人。$B$B他认为你的力量已经很强大，足以直接指挥他的军队。他希望立刻开始准备此事。

english.title: Odyn's Summons
english.objectives: Speak to Odyn in Skyhold.
english.description: Odyn would like to speak to you at once, my liege.$B$BHe is convinced that as you have grown in power you are ready to take direct command of his armies and would like to begin preparations.

text.title: 苍穹要塞的勇士
text.objectives: 招募拉格瓦尔德·龙脉和菲娜·伯恩多提尔。
text.description: 你很快就可以领导现存最强大的军队之一。不过，在我的瓦拉加尔为你效力之前，你需要证明自己有率军作战的能力。$B$B去找跟你一起来到这里的那两位维库勇士谈谈，告诉他们你是被奥丁选中的英雄，现在要开始承担你自己的责任。

english.title: Champions of Skyhold
english.objectives: Recruit Ragnvald Drakeborn and Finna Bjornsdottir.
english.description: You will soon command one of the greatest armies in existence, but before my own Valarjar follow your every command you must prove your ability to lead.$B$BSpeak to the two vrykul champions who ascended into these halls with you and tell them it is time for you to assume your duties as Odyn's chosen.

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 在恐痕裂隙与档案员麦琳达谈一谈。
text.description: 我们非常幸运能够得到档案员麦琳达的帮助。他们一族很少有人会走上我们的道路，所以她算得上是特立独行。她潜心钻研术士之道，她的高才卓识更是让她独树一帜。$B$B跟她谈谈，寻求她的指导。有了她的帮助，我们一定可以让组织更上一层楼。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Archivist Melinda in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description: We are very fortunate to have come across Archivist Melinda. She is somewhat of an anomaly, as not many from her race choose our path. What makes her even more unique is her meticulous study of our craft. Her knowledge will be unsurpassed.$B$BSpeak to her now and seek her council. With her help, we can surely strengthen the council.

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 点击恐痕作战计划，完成“训练中的部队”任务。
text.description: 是时候派出我们新训练的小鬼上战场了。使用恐痕作战计划，派出你的勇士和部队执行常规侦察任务。

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Use the Dreadscar Battle Plans and complete the mission, "Troops in Training".
english.description: It's time to send our newly trained imps out into the field. Look at the Dreadscar Battle Plans and send your champions and troops on a routine scouting mission.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“训练中的部队”任务

text.title: 不计代价获得情报
text.objectives: 使用恐痕作战计划，完成“不计代价获得情报”任务。
text.description: 你已经找到愿意协助你的术士同胞，我们现在可以使用恐痕作战计划在破碎群岛各地完成重要的任务。$B$B想要重建议会的话，我们必须先找到失踪的成员。$B$B我们派出雷特森·焰怒和卡里杜斯审问燃烧军团的爪牙吧。他们或许可以提供一些情报，有助于我们寻找失踪议会成员。

english.title: Information at Any Cost
english.objectives: Use the Dreadscar Battle Plans and complete the mission "Information at Any Cost".
english.description: Now that you've found other warlocks that are willing to aid your cause, we can use the Dreadscar Battle Plans to complete vital assignments across the Broken Isles.$B$BIf we wish to rebuild the council, we must start by locating its missing members.$B$BLet us send Ritssyn and Calydus to interrogate the Burning Legion's minions. They might have information that will help us locate the missing council members.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“不计代价获得情报”任务

text.title: 斯塔索姆队长
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“斯塔索姆队长”任务。
text.description: 的确，英灵殿的灵魂都是极为勇敢的。这也是他们在这里的原因。$B$B但是空有一腔热血的军队是无法变得强大的。你得找人来把他们培养成训练有素的瓦拉加尔。$B$B让你的勇士们传话给斯塔索姆队长吧。桀骜不逊的维库狂战士并不害怕死亡，但是出于对哈尔玛·斯塔索姆的畏惧，他们或许会听从你的指挥。

english.title: Captain Stahlstrom
english.objectives: Use the Eye of Odyn and complete the mission, "Captain Stahlstrom."
english.description: The souls that make it to these halls are brave, yes. That's why they're here after all.$B$BValor alone does not make for an effective army, however. You will need someone who can train those who would be valarjar to fight with discipline.$B$BHave your champions send word to Captain Stahlstrom. Unruly vrykul berserkers may not fear death, but they might fear Hjalmar Stahlstrom enough to make them follow your orders.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“斯塔索姆队长”任务

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募卡里杜斯和雷特森·焰怒。
text.description: 朋友虽然很强大，但是很孤单。你虽然是议会的首座，可是议会的其他人都不见了。$B$B不过，朋友不会一直孤单下去的。有你来领导议会，你的力量就会吸引其他人来跟随你。$B$B找到想帮忙的人，接受他们的效忠。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Calydus and Ritssyn Flamescowl.
english.description: Friend is in a powerful, but lonely position. First of a council whose members are missing.$B$BFriend does not have to be alone though. Others will be drawn to friend's power, willing to follow if friend leads.$B$BFind those who want to help, and accept their pledge of loyalty.

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与哈尔玛·斯塔索姆队长对话并招募瓦拉加尔候选者。
text.description: 斯塔索姆队长已经来了。我建议你跟他谈谈，确保瓦拉加尔已经准备就绪，随时可以上战场。$B$B如果我们想要赢得这场对阵燃烧军团的全面战争，只有两位勇士是不够的。

english.title: Recruiting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Captain Hjalmar Stahlstrom and train Valarjar Aspirants.
english.description: Captain Stahlstrom has arrived. It would be advisable to speak to him and see that the valarjar are armed and ready for battle.$B$BWe'll need more than your two champions if we're to win a full-fledged war against the Legion.

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 使用奥丁之眼，完成“部队出勤”任务。
text.description: 我们已经放任敌人肆意妄为太久了。现在，我们有一只大军来支援你的勇士，你可以派遣他们去对付敌人。$B$B我们的一个战友被奥丁的宿敌，海拉给囚禁了。如果你的部队能把符文法师艾纳尔给救回来，他就可以利用强大的符文来强化部队的实力。

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Use the Eye of Odyn and complete the mission, "Troops in the Field."
english.description: Our enemies' transgressions have gone unchecked for long enough. Now that we have troops to back your champions, you would do well to send them to deal with them.$B$BOne of our own has been taken prisoner by Odyn's sworn nemesis, Helya. If your forces manage to bring back Einar the Runecaster alive he can aid us in using powerful runes to advance the power of your armies.

text.title: 符文法师艾纳尔
text.objectives: 和符文法师艾纳尔对话。
text.description: 作为一名领导者，你要做的事情不只是派士兵上战场。你也必须决定该如何训练部队和提升我们的战斗力。$B$B找刻符者埃纳尔谈谈吧，把你的想法都告诉他。

english.title: Einar the Runecaster
english.objectives: Speak to Einar the Runecaster.
english.description: Being a leader is not just about sending your troops to combat. You will also make decisions about how we train and improve our armies.$B$BSpeak to Einar the Runecaster and let him know how you would like development to progress.

text.title: 仪式用鼓
text.objectives: 在雷霆图腾找到$1oa面大型、$2oa面中型、以及$3oa面小型仪式用鼓。
text.description:
那些蠢牛！

他们又偷走了我们的仪式用鼓，把它们当……普通的鼓一样……当玩具来玩！

你可以帮我把它们找回来吗？他们玩腻了就乱丢，那些鼓现在应该散落在雷霆图腾的各个角落。
text.completion: Nice! Got 'em! Feel free to play the drums, but leave them down here, will you? You're alright by me, $n.

english.title: Ceremonial Drums
english.objectives: Find $1oa Large, $2oa Medium, and $3oa Small Ceremonial Drums in Thunder Totem.
english.description:
Those foolish calves!

They've made off with our ceremonial drums again, treating them as toys... as... common drums!

Can you help me find them? They must be scattered to all corners of Thunder Totem by now, discarded as soon as the fun dries up.
english.completion: Nice! Got 'em! Feel free to play the drums, but leave them down here, will you? You're alright by me, $n.

text.title: 无形之刃
text.objectives: 帮助迦罗娜清除暴风城里的隐蔽之手邪教徒。
text.description: 我们绝不能让暴风城落入燃烧军团之手。我不相信肖尔和他那些军情七处的傻瓜可以解决隐蔽之手教派。$B$B趁着现在还有时间，我们两个必须好好处理。$B$B一定要格外当心，邪教已经煽动了整座城市，他们一看到我们就会痛下杀手。$B$B其他的影行者都对你赞誉有加。你愿意帮忙吗？

english.title: The Unseen Blade
english.objectives: Help Garona take out the Veiled Hand cultists in Stormwind.
english.description: Stormwind is too important to fall to the Legion, and I don't trust Shaw or his SI:7 goons to take care of the Hand on their own.$B$BThe two of us will have to handle this while there's still time.$B$BUse extreme caution. The entire city is on edge from murmurs of the cult's activities, and we're already kill on sight.$B$BThe other Shadows spoke highly of your skills. Are you in?

text.title: 流星锤防御
text.objectives: 消灭$1oa个巫环攻击者。
text.description:
我收到消息，有一群鹰身人正打算带着她们的大鹏发起攻击。

她们会从北边的山岭攻来。

你来使用其中一部套索发射器，我来操作另外一部。

快点！
text.completion: That was some nice work you did there, $n. Thanks for the assist.

english.title: Bolas Bastion
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Coven attackers.
english.description:
I received word that a coven of harpies and their rocs plan to attack in force.

They'll be coming from the mountains to the north.

Use one of the bolas launchers and I'll man the other.

Quick!
english.completion: That was some nice work you did there, $n. Thanks for the assist.

text.title: 黑暗神殿之战
text.objectives: 使用传送门前往黑暗神殿并与阿卡玛对战。
text.description:
兰达洛克的书真是让人醍醐灌顶。它记载了一个方法，可以让我们不费吹灰之力就绕过黑暗神殿的神圣屏障。

我需要一点时间召唤传送门。请退后。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找受难者奥图里斯。
text.giverWindow: 前往黑暗神殿与阿卡玛对峙。说服他加入你的队伍，一起对抗燃烧军团。

english.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
english.objectives: Use the Gateway to the Black Temple and confront Akama.
english.description:
The book from Lan'dalock is very enlightening. It describes a technique which will provide a simple and elegant bypass around the Black Temple's holy barriers.

I will need but a moment to summon a gateway. Stand back, please.
english.completed: Return to Altruis the Sufferer on the Fel Hammer.
english.giverWindow: Travel to the Black Temple and confront Akama. Convince him to join forces with you in the fight against the Burning Legion.

text.title: 戴尔格特的奥秘
text.objectives: 在戴尔格特外的海盗船上收集4块上古戴尔格特石板。
text.description:
伙计，幸会！

我当时正在去研究本地鱼人的路上，不知不觉就来到了这片奇特的废墟。那边的海盗比我先来，似乎他们已经释放了某种远古的邪恶存在。

这个邪恶的存在当然不该放任不管，但我们应该先对其进行深入了解再做打算，不然就会和那些伙计落得相同的下场。

我探查到船员从废墟里带回了一些石板。如果你能把石板带回来给我，我也许有办法查清这个邪恶存在的本质。
text.completion: Excellent! Luckily I brought a copy of the vrykul cipher that the League procured from Northrend.$B$BI'll get to work on this straightforth! Let us hope the dialects are not too dissimilar.

english.title: The Mystery of Dreyrgrot
english.objectives: Gather 4 Ancient Dreyrgrot tablets from the pirate ships outside of Dreyrgrot.
english.description:
Well met, good chap!

I was on my way to study the local murlocs when I stumbled upon these most peculiar ruins. Those pirates over yonder arrived first, and it appears they've unleashed some ancient evil.

I would be remiss to let such an evil run rampant, but we should learn more of it before we proceed, lest we end up like those chaps.

I spied the crew bringing back some tablets from the ruins. If you can bring them to me, I may be able to decipher the nature of this evil.
english.completion: Excellent! Luckily I brought a copy of the vrykul cipher that the League procured from Northrend.$B$BI'll get to work on this straightforth! Let us hope the dialects are not too dissimilar.

text.title: 血之石
text.objectives: 在戴尔格特附近的船上从断牙船长身上收集断牙的红宝石护符。
text.description:
很不幸，一波未平一波又起。废墟里渗出的雾气影响了在其中搜刮的海盗。他们已经发了疯。

只有一人似乎没有受影响，就是那个戴着华丽帽子，看着像船长的家伙。他佩戴着一个巨大的红宝石护符，我认为就是那个护符保护着他免受雾气的影响。你必须戴着那个护符才能进入坟墓。

他也许不愿意乖乖交给你。
text.completion: You have the amulet! Most excellent!$B$BOf course, that probably won't help you with the pirates that are already mad as hatters, but small victories, eh chap?

english.title: A Stone of Blood
english.objectives: Collect Broketooth's Ruby Amulet from Captain Broketooth on the ships near Dreyrgrot.
english.description:
Unfortunately, we may have another problem. That mist seeping out of the ruins has affected the looting pirates. It's driven them quite mad.

Only one of them seems to be unaffected - a captainly fellow with a very fine hat.  He wears a large ruby amulet, which I believe protects him from the mist. You'll need it if you are to enter the tomb.

He may not give it up willingly.
english.completion: You have the amulet! Most excellent!$B$BOf course, that probably won't help you with the pirates that are already mad as hatters, but small victories, eh chap?

text.title: 知识的价值
text.objectives: 在戴尔格特外面的水中收集7箱古代圣物。
text.description:
这个箱子里装满了附近废墟里的圣物。海盗们大概觉得这些东西不值钱，把它们都扔了。

如果你能取回这些圣物并交给探险者协会研究的话，他们肯定会感激不尽。
text.completion: Well that was most noble of you to save these ancient relics from a water-logged fate.$B$BI will be sure that the Explorer's League puts these to good use!

english.title: The Value of Knowledge
english.objectives: Gather 7 Crates of Ancient Relics from the waters outside Dreyrgrot.
english.description:
This crate is filled with relics from the nearby ruins. The pirates have discarded them, likely thinking they're of little value.

The Explorer's League would probably appreciate if you retrieved these relics for them to study.
english.completion: Well that was most noble of you to save these ancient relics from a water-logged fate.$B$BI will be sure that the Explorer's League puts these to good use!

text.title: 骨语者的埋藏之物
text.objectives: 在戴尔格特使用尖锐的木桩消灭鲜血领主卢卡多。
text.description:
妙极了！看来我们有维库吸血鬼要对付了。

我们之前遇到过的都有血精灵血统，但一直以来都有理论说，也有维库人遭受了这个诅咒。糟糕的是，他醒了。我本来很渴望能弄到个研究对象。

看来现在没戏了。拿着这个尖木桩，捅进那位老兄的胸膛。这样肯定能把他干掉。
text.completion: Oh, the stake didn't work you say?  My apologies, I must've had my immortal evil undead mixed up.$B$BYou're all in one piece though, and the evil has seen its end. Hopefully, at least.$B$BVampyr can die, can't they?

english.title: What the Bonespeakers Buried
english.objectives: Use the Sharp Wooden Stake to kill Blood-Thane Lucard in Dreyrgrot.
english.description:
Most Fascinating! It would appear that we're dealing with our very own vrykul vampyr!

All we have encountered have been of blood elven descent, but it has long been theorized that the vrykul have suffered the curse as well. It's too bad he's awake - I would dearly like a subject to study.

Oh well, guess there's nothing for it. Take this stake and put it through the old chap's heart. I'm pretty sure that should do the trick.
english.completion: Oh, the stake didn't work you say?  My apologies, I must've had my immortal evil undead mixed up.$B$BYou're all in one piece though, and the evil has seen its end. Hopefully, at least.$B$BVampyr can die, can't they?

text.title: 斩奸除恶
text.objectives: 在戴尔格特击杀8个嗜血的恶棍。
text.description:
了结这个邪恶的血王子对这片土地是好事一桩，不过我们也不能任由这些疯狂的海盗肆虐。恐怕除了消灭他们别无选择了。

好伙计，继续你的高尚行动，让他们安息吧，之后我们再把酒庆祝。
text.completion: Good riddance to bad rubbish, I say. $B$BThose louts were ne'er-do-wells before they went crazy. Just imagine what they would do if we let them run rampant!$B$BCheers to your bravery, sir.

english.title: Spilling Bad Blood
english.objectives: Kill 8 Blood-Crazed Swashbucklers in Dreyrgrot.
english.description:
Ending the evil of the Blood Prince will be a boon to this land, but we can't just allow these crazed corsairs to run amok.  I'm afraid there is no choice but to put them to the sword.

Carry out this noble deed, my good fellow, and we will celebrate with a nice warm lager.
english.completion: Good riddance to bad rubbish, I say. $B$BThose louts were ne'er-do-wells before they went crazy. Just imagine what they would do if we let them run rampant!$B$BCheers to your bravery, sir.

text.title: 挣脱束缚
text.objectives: 将瑟维甘的物品扔进灵魂火堆，完成解缚仪式。
text.description: 骨语秘法师用这些传家宝将我的灵魂束缚在这个世界中。$B$B我中了他们的诅咒，灵魂无法进入英灵殿。在霍斯瓦尔德找到灵魂火堆，将我的物品扔进火焰里。$B$B他们通过邪恶的魔法，用这堆火束缚了我的灵魂。如今，就再用这堆火来终结这束缚吧！

english.title: Break the Bonds
english.objectives: Throw Svergan's Belongings into the Soul Pyre and complete the Ritual of Unbinding.
english.description: The Bonespeaker mystics used these heirlooms to tie my soul to this world.$B$BUnder their curse, my soul could not enter the Halls of Valor. Find the soul pyre in Haustvald and throw my belongings into the flames.$B$BThe fire that bound my soul through their foul magic will be the same fire that undoes this bond!

text.title: 瑟维甘的承诺
text.objectives: 回苍穹要塞找海姆达尔。
text.description: 感激你为我做了这件事。我曾发誓要用生命来守护迦拉尔之角，我也的确是这么做的。$B$B你得告诉海姆达尔，他的迦拉尔之角被巨虫尤胡塔姆吞进肚子里了！$B$B我手下一整支对抗这头怪兽的军队都被它生吞了。找到尤胡塔姆，你就能找到号角！

english.title: Svergan's Promise
english.objectives: Return to Hymdall in Skyhold.
english.description: I thank you for doing this for me. I swore an oath to protect the Gjallarhorn with my life, and so I did.$B$BYou must tell Hymdall that his Gjallarhorn was devoured by the great worm, Jorhuttam!$B$BIt devoured an entire army of my men who were swallowed whole trying to fend off the beast. Find Jorhuttam and you will find the horn!

text.title: 黑心林地：梦魇橡木
text.objectives: 进入黑心林地地下城，从橡树之心身上取得梦魇橡木。
text.description: 铁匠凯瑞尔对远行者并不陌生。他为我们打造了大量的箭矢，在特殊材料方面的丰富知识使他能够制作出质量更好、威力更强的弹药。$B$B他不仅效率出众，天赋过人，而且善于使用珍稀材料。$B$B他可以用一根烂掉的古树枝桠造出成千上万的箭矢。

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: Nightmare Oak
english.objectives: Collect Nightmare Oak from Oakheart within the dungeon, Darkheart Thicket.
english.description: Blacksmith Kyriel is no stranger to the Farstriders. He has forged countless arrows for us in the past, using his knowledge of unique materials to help build better, stronger ammo.$B$BHe's efficient and gifted, making the most of scarce materials.$B$BUsing a single branch from a corrupted ancient, he can craft thousands of arrows.

text.title: 海底矿石
text.objectives: 从苏拉玛海洋里的矿脉开采蔚蓝矿石。
text.description: 如果要对付哈卡，我的游侠就需要特殊的箭矢和弹药，以刺穿地狱犬那具有魔法抗性的厚实外皮。$B$B达拉然有一位厉害的铁匠，他可以制作出非常锐利的弓箭和刀枪。$B$B他所使用的蔚蓝矿石只有在海平面以下才能找到。$B$B因为这种矿石跟魔石非常相似，所以常常被人忽略，但是经验老到的铁匠手可以用它打造出无坚不摧的利器。

english.title: Ore Under the Sea
english.objectives: Mine Azure Ore from deposits found in the water off the coast of Suramar.
english.description: If we want to bring the fight to Hakkar, my rangers are going to need arrows and ammo that are capable of piercing the thick, magic-resistant hides of his hounds.$B$BThere's a versatile smith in Dalaran who does incredible work with both bows and blades alike.$B$BHe uses azure ore in his creations, which can only be found below sea level.$B$BDue to its proximity to leystone, the ore is often overlooked, but in an expert smith's hands, it can be smelted into something nearly indestructible.

text.title: 蔚蓝武器
text.objectives: 在达拉然找到铁匠凯瑞尔。
text.description:
把材料交给达拉然的铁匠凯瑞尔，他会让它们派上用场。

我说过，他不仅手艺娴熟而且效率很高，所以你不会等太久。

他造好武器以后，你再去找珊蒂斯·羽月谈谈附魔的事。

english.title: Azure Weaponry
english.objectives: Find Blacksmith Kyriel in Dalaran.
english.description:
Take the materials to Blacksmith Kyriel in Dalaran, and he'll use them to craft whatever weapons he can.

As I mentioned before, he's skilled and efficient, so you shouldn't have to wait long.

When his work is complete, speak to Shandris Feathermoon about getting the weapons enchanted.

objectiveDetails.description: 在达拉然找到铁匠凯瑞尔

text.title: 月爪谷的会面
text.objectives: 在瓦尔莎拉找到莉娅娜·星尘。
text.description: 莉娅娜·星尘还在一个恶魔横行的山谷里。尽管那里发生了剧变，她依然不肯放弃自己的家园。$B$B她在面对敌人时展现出非凡的力量与顽强，而她的附魔也同样拥有这些特质。$B$B我们想让自己的武器也拥有她的坚强与刚毅。$B$B到月爪谷去找她，看看她能不能为凯瑞尔所制造的武器附魔。

english.title: Meeting in Moonclaw Vale
english.objectives: Find Lyana Stardust in Val'sharah.
english.description: Lyana Stardust still lingers in a vale that has been overrun by demons. Despite its current start of upheaval, she refuses to abandon her home.$B$BThe strength and stubbornness she exhibits in the face of an enemy are also traits that shine through in her enchantments.$B$BWe want our weapons to be as strong and stubborn as she is.$B$BMeet her in Moonclaw Vale, and see if she can work her magic with the weapons that Kyriel has crafted for us.

text.title: 精妙的附魔
text.objectives: 在莉娅娜·星尘为蔚蓝武器附魔的时候保护她。
text.description: 你肯定注意到了，恶魔已经占领了这个山谷。他们逼走了许多德鲁伊同胞，但是我不愿将自己的家园拱手相让。$B$B先不说这些，我很乐意为你的武器附魔。不过你应该知道，附魔的过程非常讲究，需要耗费大量的时间和精力，而我现在不太方便。$B$B如果你愿意保护我的人身安全，那么我将竭尽全力为你的武器进行附魔。

english.title: Delicate Enchantments
english.objectives: Protect Lyana Stardust while she enchants the azure weaponry.
english.description: As I'm sure you've noticed, demons have taken over the vale. Their arrival has forced many of my fellow druids to flee their homes, but I refuse to go down without a fight.$B$BDespite all this, I'm happy to provide enchantments for your weapons, but you should know that it is a delicate process that takes time and concentration, something I have little of lately.$B$BIf you're willing to shelter me from attackers, I will certainly do my best to enchant your weapons.

text.title: 保卫达拉然
text.objectives: 通过卡德加的传送门进入紫罗兰监狱，并击败训犬者哈卡。
text.description:
我们万事俱备，可以为哈卡设下陷阱了。

大法师卡德加会召唤一道通往紫罗兰监狱的传送门。进去之后，他会根据你的指示将自己的精华引入奥术容器。

我们的盟友会拿上你带来的武器并做好准备，等哈卡上钩以后发动进攻。

english.title: In Defense of Dalaran
english.objectives: Enter the Violet Hold through Khadgar's portal, and defeat Hakkar the Houndmaster.
english.description:
We have everything we need to set the trap for Hakkar.

Archmage Khadgar will summon a portal to the Violet Hold. Once inside, he will begin to channel his essence into the arcane vessel at your command.

Our allies will be armed with the weapons you brought them, ready to fight when Hakkar takes the bait.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往紫罗兰监狱

text.title: 守望者地窟：魔誓之心
text.objectives: 进入守望者地窟地下城，从科达娜身上取得魔誓之心。
text.description:
我在血石方面取得了巨大的进展，这也得感谢你的大量试验。

吸食恶魔血液可以提升血石的力量，不过想要用它控制恶魔的话，还需要让它吞噬腐化的心脏，越强大的心脏的效果越好。

你可以在守望者地窟找到一个拥有这种心脏的人。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: Matters of the Heart
english.objectives: Collect a Felsworn Heart from Cordana within The Vault of the Wardens dungeon.
english.description:
I have made considerable progress with the Bloodstone, thanks in part to your extensive testing.

The stone feeds on blood to grow in power, but its ability to control a demon comes from consuming a corrupted heart; the more powerful, the better.

Within the Vault of the Wardens you'll find someone with such a heart.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募大法师卡雷和大法师茉德拉。
text.description:
提瑞斯秘法会早已解散多年。为了击败燃烧军团，我们必须首先招募一批法师中最强大的勇士来与我们并肩作战。有两位强大的大法师，大法师卡雷和大法师茉德拉，已经来到这里。他们想帮助我们赢得胜利。

和他们谈话，招募他们，使他们成为我们的有力臂助。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Archmage Kalec and Archmage Modera.
english.description:
The Tirisgarde has been defunct for ages. To defeat the Burning Legion, we must first recruit the greatest champions of our class to fight by our side. Two powerful archmages, Archmage Kalec and Archmage Modera, have come to help us succeed. 

Speak to them and enlist their aid.

text.title: 提拔勇士
text.objectives: 招募阿卡玛之影和考瓦斯·血棘成为你的勇士。
text.description:
我们应该大张旗鼓地欢迎阿卡玛之影加入。我们必须让其他人知道，我们把他当成自己人，而不是一个外人。

考瓦斯·血棘一次次地证明了自己的价值。她拥有无与伦比的战斗能力，这一点毋庸置疑。你找不出第二个像她这样能够轻松制敌的人。

是时候将他们正式提拔为勇士了。

english.title: Into Our Ranks
english.objectives: Recruit the Shade of Akama and Kor'vas Bloodthorn as your champions.
english.description:
We should make a show of welcoming this Shade of Akama into our ranks. It is important that the others see him treated as one of us, rather than as an outsider.

Kor'vas Bloodthorn has proven herself invaluable, time and time again. Her skills in combat are unquestioned and unparalleled. You will find no champion better suited to destroying our enemies.

It is time to officially raise them up as champions.

text.title: 返回邪能之槌号
text.objectives: 在邪能之槌号与战争领主加尔顿谈一谈。
text.description:
$n，战争领主加尔顿派我来找你。他说他有件很重要的事情需要你的帮助。

他希望你尽快返回邪能之槌号。
text.giverWindow: 指挥官，请尽快返回邪能之槌号。

english.title: Return to the Fel Hammer
english.objectives: Speak with Battlelord Gaardoun on the Fel Hammer.
