english.description:
$n, Battlelord Gaardoun asked me to retrieve you. He says there is a very important matter that he needs your help with.

He requests your presence back on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible.
english.giverWindow: Return to me on the Fel Hammer as soon as possible, commander.

objectiveDetails.description: 回去找战争领主加尔顿
使用伊利达雷传送门（可选）

text.title: 入侵准备
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“入侵准备”系列任务。
text.description:
我们不仅有萨格里特钥石，还有庞大的部队，而且我们已经制定好一个计划。

现在，我们需要找到邪魂兄妹。不管他们躲在哪个恶魔世界里，我们都要做好准备，发动入侵。

请把这件事交给我。如果你可以让我调遣你的勇士，我将不择手段，借助夺魂之镰的力量从恶魔口中问出情报。

english.title: Preparations for Invasion
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Preparations for Invasion" missions.
english.description:
We have the Sargerite Keystone. We have most of the forces we will need. We even have a plan.

Now we need to locate the Felsouls and prepare for an invasion of whatever demon world they're hiding out on.

Please leave it to me. If you will grant me the use of your champions, I and the Scythe of Souls will extract the information by any means necessary from the demons that we question.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“入侵准备：邪魂在哪？！”任务
完成“入侵准备：井井有条”任务
完成“入侵准备：抢夺”任务
完成“入侵准备：武器改良”任务
完成“入侵准备：侦察堡垒”任务

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募受难者奥图里斯和阿莎·鸦歌成为你的第一批勇士。
text.description:
我和主母赛丝诺女士一直在关注你和其他的伊利达雷。我们可以从局外人的角度进行观察，所以我们的判断非常客观。我们已经达成共识：想要维持伊利达雷的团结，你必须开始招募勇士。

这些高贵的勇士可以协助你在邪能之槌号以外开展行动。

我们一致推荐你首先招募奥图里斯和阿莎这两位勇士。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Altruis the Sufferer and Asha Ravensong as your first champions.
english.description:
The matron mother, Lady S'theno, and I have been watching you and the rest of the Illidari. We have something of an outsider's perspective on things, which gives us a degree of objectivity. We have come to a unanimous recommendation: in order to keep the Illidari from splintering, you must begin to recruit champions.

These exalted few will aid in projecting your power beyond the confines of the Fel Hammer.

Our unanimous recommendations for the first two are Altruis and Asha.

text.title: 崛起吧，勇士
text.objectives: 招募凯恩·日怒和阿莎·鸦歌成为你的第一批勇士。
text.description:
主母赛丝诺女士和我一直关注着你和其他的伊利达雷战士。我们有一些作为旁观者的建议想要告诉你，这可以让我们不至于当局者迷。我们已经达成了一致的共识：为了防止伊利达雷人的分裂，你必须立即开始招募勇士。

这些高贵而稀少的勇士，将在邪能之槌号无法企及的地方继续散播你的威光。

我们一致推荐凯恩和阿莎担任你最初的两位勇士。

english.title: Rise, Champions
english.objectives: Recruit Kayn Sunfury and Asha Ravensong as your first champions.
english.description:
The matron mother, Lady S'theno, and I have been watching you and the rest of the Illidari. We have something of an outsider's perspective on things, which gives us a degree of objectivity. We have come to a unanimous recommendation: in order to keep the Illidari from splintering, you must begin to recruit champions.

These exalted few will aid in projecting your power beyond the confines of the Fel Hammer.

Our unanimous recommendations for the first two are Kayn and Asha.

text.title: 加尔顿的需求
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“加尔顿的需求”任务。
text.description:
战争领主加尔顿主动请缨，要为我们的事业招募更多的破碎者战士。首先，他需要一些东西。他提到要有合适的工具才能事半功倍之类的话。

是时候派出你的新勇士接受考验了。我敢肯定，这次的任务会非常辛苦。

english.title: Things Gaardoun Needs
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Things Gaardoun Needs".
english.description:
Battlelord Gaardoun has offered to recruit more broken warriors for the cause. He just needs a few things first. He said something about the right tool for the job, or something like that.

Time to put your new champions to the test. I'm sure it will be a grueling mission.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“加尔顿的需求”任务

text.title: 黑鸦堡垒：进入黑鸦堡垒
text.objectives: 召集队友进入黑鸦堡垒并夺取丹塔利纳克斯的渡鸦之眼。
text.description:
这件物品非常古老，只是翻阅一下都有可能损坏。

看这里，我找到一条关于渡鸦之眼的记载。

<瓦莉拉的手指从书页的左边划到右边。她好像有所发现，不过很快又皱起了眉头。>

这里写着拥有眼睛的最后一个人就是拉文凯斯领主。你必须进入黑鸦堡垒，从他手里夺取渡鸦之眼。
text.completed: 返回暗影大厅去找瓦莉拉·萨古纳尔。

english.title: Black Rook Hold: Into Black Rook Hold
english.objectives: Gather a group and enter Black Rook Hold to take the Raven's Eye from Dantalionax.
english.description:
This thing is ancient. Just turning the pages risks them disintegrating in my hands.

Here, I have found it. An entry about the Raven's Eye.

<Valeera traces her finger from left to right above the page. A look of discovery comes over her features, which is quickly replaced by a frown.>

It says here that the last person to have possession of the eye was Lord Ravencrest himself. You are going to have to go into Black Rook Hold and take it from him.
english.completed: Return to Valeera Sanguinar in the Chamber of Shadows.

text.title: 破碎战士
text.objectives: 与战争领主加尔顿谈一谈，并训练灰舌战士。
text.description:
壮大队伍对我们来说十分重要。相信我，我对这方面很了解。想要快速完成这种任务，最好是派战争领主加尔顿和他的灰舌部队出马。

你应该找他谈谈，让他知道你需要什么样的破碎士兵。

english.title: Broken Warriors
english.objectives: Speak with Battlelord Gaardoun and train Ashtongue Warriors.
english.description:
It's important that we increase our numbers. Trust me, I know these things. Battlelord Gaardoun and his Ashtongue warriors are our best bet to quickly accomplish such a task.

You should speak with him and let him know just what kind of broken you want trained.

text.title: 破译信件
text.objectives: 使用渡鸦之眼破译军情七处的加密信件。
text.description:
我们有渡鸦之眼。$n，用它破译军情七处的信件。

我们必须知道里面的秘密！

english.title: Deciphering the Letter
english.objectives: Use the Raven's Eye to decipher the encrypted SI:7 Letter.
english.description:
We have the Raven's Eye. Use it, $n. Decipher the SI:7 letter.

We must know what secrets it contains!

text.title: 洛拉姆斯，是你吗？
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“洛拉姆斯，是你吗？”任务。
text.description:
贝拉斯·黎明之刃从阿苏纳的邪焰隘口给我们发来了一份奇怪的侦察报告。里面说恐惧魔王，污染者拉瑟莱克已经回到这个世界。不过，这不是奇怪的地方。

怪就怪在，他有时会到处屠戮其他的恶魔，并自称是洛拉姆斯！

我们知道，我们的恶魔猎手兄弟洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯为了打败拉瑟莱克牺牲了自己，而他已经被魔王占据。

你需要派出勇士和灰舌战士前往阿苏纳，查明事情的来龙去脉。

english.title: Loramus, Is That You?
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Loramus, Is That You?".
english.description:
Belath Dawnblade has given us a strange scouting report from the Felblaze Ingress in Azsuna. The dreadlord, Razelikh the Defiler has returned to the world. That's not the odd part, though.

Strangely, he's sometimes going around killing the other demons and calling himself, Loramus!

Last we knew, our demon hunter brother, Loramus Thalipedes sacrificed himself to defeat Razelikh, whom he'd been possessed by.

Your champions and Ashtongue warriors need to go to Azsuna and find out what is going on.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“洛拉姆斯，是你吗？”任务

text.title: 额外配备
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“额外配备”任务。
text.description:
听说你试图联络伊利丹在扭曲虚空里的不朽灵魂。这样的话，你需要许多魔法物品。

我斗胆为你准备了一份清单，希望会对你有用，$g帅哥:美女;。

english.title: Additional Accoutrements
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Additional Accoutrements".
english.description:
I heard a rumor that you are going to attempt to make contact with Illidan's immortal demon soul in the Twisting Nether. You are going to need many magical things.

I have taken the luxury of putting together a potential list for you. I do so hope that it proves helpful, $g handsome:gorgeous;.

text.title: 魔化提升
text.objectives: 聆听洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯说话，然后为你的职业大厅升级。
text.description:
尽管洛拉姆斯被困在拉瑟莱克体内……而且恶魔有时还会占据主导，不过他的回归为我们带来了一大优势。

他仍然是我们最强大的恶魔猎手之一，而且他现在还掌握了一个恐惧魔王的知识。

我认为，应该让他和我们分享他的知识和智慧，让我们在这场战争中更有胜算。
text.giverWindow: 虽然他的样子是污染者拉瑟莱克，但实际是恶魔猎手洛拉姆斯·萨里比迪斯的灵魂在控制这个恐惧魔王……大多数时候是这样。

english.title: Demonic Improvements
english.objectives: Listen to Loramus Thalipedes' story and then upgrade your Class Hall.
english.description:
Having Loramus back will work greatly to our advantage, despite the fact that he's trapped inside Razelikh's body... and also that the demon sometimes takes control.

Still, he was one of our most powerful demon hunters. And now, he also has the knowledge of a dreadlord at his disposal.

I think we should have him share his knowledge and wisdom with us to improve our odds in this war.
english.giverWindow: He may look like Razelikh the Defiler, but the soul of the demon hunter, Loramus Thalipedes is actually in control of this dreadlord... mostly.

text.title: 混淆视听
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“混淆视听”系列任务。
text.description:
我们每次都被军情七处逮个正着。这次绝对不能让他们听到任何风声。

为此，我对你在任务分配方面有一些建议。我不管你怎么派遣勇士和部队，重要的是要让他们离开瓦尔莎拉并且远离黑鸦堡垒。

至少在我们破译那封该死的信件以前要这么做。

english.title: Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Throwing SI:7 Off the Trail" missions.
english.description:
SI:7 is dogging our heels at every turn. We must make certain that they do not catch wind of what we are up to.

To that end, I have some suggestions for you in the form of missions. Send your champions, assign your forces, it matters little to me. The important thing is that we keep them out of Val'sharah and away from Black Rook Hold.

At least until we can decipher that damned letter.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“混淆视听：苏拉玛”任务
完成“混淆视听：至高岭”任务
完成“混淆视听：阿苏纳”任务
完成“混淆视听：风暴峡湾”任务
完成“混淆视听：达拉然”任务

text.title: 部队出勤
text.objectives: 完成“部队出勤”任务。
text.description: 部队已经就绪！是时候来点实战考验了。$B$B我们收到情报，破碎海滩附近还有幸存者，不过那片地区仍然被军团恶魔所占据。$B$B赶快派出我们的部队，协助救援！

english.title: Troops in the Field
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "Troops in the Field."
english.description: Our troops are ready! It's time to test them out in the field.$B$BWe've received word of survivors near the Broken Shore, but the area is still crawling with Legion.$B$BSend our troops quickly to help with the rescue!

text.title: 亲爱的Mrgl
text.description: Mrmlgr！Mrglr rlmgrg mlrgr！Mrlgmr……$b$b<费恩给你看了看珍珠一侧的瑕疵。>$b$bMmlrgmlr rlmgr grlmrmlg mglrmglr。Mlrgmrl rmglr? Mlgrmglr！$b$bGmmlrgmrl mlrgmlr lrglrmgrl lrlgllrlm mglrlr grlm-grlm。$b$b<费恩做了个捏的手势。>$b$bMrlgmlgr mgrlmlgr? Mlrgmlr gmrlmglr Mrgrlilgrl。

english.title: Mrgls of Endearment
english.description: Mrmlgr! Mrglr rlmgrg mlrgr! Mrlgmr...$b$b<Phin shows you a flaw on the side of the pearl.>$b$bMmlrgmlr rlmgr grlmrmlg mglrmglr. Mlrgmrl rmglr? Mlgrmglr!$b$bGmmlrgmrl mlrgmlr lrglrmgrl lrlgllrlm mglrlr grlm-grlm.$b$b<Phin makes a pinching motion with his hand.>$b$bMrlgmlgr mgrlmlgr? Mlrgmlr gmrlmglr Mrgrlilgrl.

text.title: 知己知彼
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳与奇拉·艾索尔谈一谈。
text.description: 如果我们想打败哈卡，就需要更加了解他饲养的猎犬，并找到它们的弱点。$B$B我知道一个专门研究各种恶魔的术士。她或许见过这种猎犬，知道该怎么消灭它们。

english.title: Knowing Our Enemy
english.objectives: Speak to Kira Iresoul in Azsuna.
english.description: If we hope to gain the upper hand against Hakkar, we need to find out more about these hounds that he's breeding and pinpoint their weaknesses.$B$BI know of a warlock that studies demons extensively. Maybe she has seen some of these hounds, and knows how to defeat them.

text.title: 魔虫诱饵
text.objectives: 在阿苏纳的魔能洞窟收集魔虫内脏。
text.description: 地狱犬容易被魔法吸引，而幼崽更加禁不住诱惑。$B$B只要闻到一丝魔法气味，就能激起它们的强烈食欲！你不像法师那么容易引起它们的注意，所以你需要佩戴一些东西，让地狱犬以为你就是它的下一顿魔法大餐。$B$B魔虫内脏应该派上用场。

english.title: Leyworm Lure
english.objectives: Collect Leyworm Entrails from worms within Leyhollow in Azsuna.
english.description: Felhounds are attracted to magic, young ones especially.$B$BThey get a whiff and go into a feeding frenzy! You're not quite as enticing as a mage, so you'll need to cover yourself in something that can fool a felhound into thinking you're its next magical meal.$B$BLeyworm entrails should do the trick.

text.title: 纳萨拉斯的后人
text.objectives: 在纳萨拉斯废墟找到三部古代上层精灵书籍。
text.description: 嗨！你是$n吧？达拉然的大法师说我们或许可以在这里见到你。$b$b我和我的兄弟正在调查这里。我们在找我们的父母。$b$b我们一直以为自己的家人在一万年前死在了阿苏纳，不过看看这里！大多数精灵都是鬼魂。$b$b欧洛希尔一直在查阅资料，想要找到原因，不过我们需要一些帮助。
text.completion: This Prince Farondis opposed Queen Azshara, so she got mad and blew everything up? That's awesome!$b$bHey Olothil, listen to this!

english.title: Children of Nar'thalas
english.objectives: Find three Ancient Highborne Tomes in the Ruins of Nar'thalas.
english.description: Hi! $n, right? The archmages in Dalaran said we might see you down here.$b$bMy brother and I are here on a reconnaissance mission. We're looking for our parents.$b$bWe've lived our entire lives thinking that our family was killed in Azsuna several thousand years ago, but look around! Most of the elves here are ghosts.$b$bOlothil's been searching through books for clues as to why, but we could use some help.
english.completion: This Prince Farondis opposed Queen Azshara, so she got mad and blew everything up? That's awesome!$b$bHey Olothil, listen to this!

objectiveDetails.description: 第三部古代上层精灵书籍
第二部古代上层精灵书籍
第一部古代上层精灵书籍

text.title: 占卜一下才知道
text.objectives: 取得$1oa块积怨宝石。
text.description: 为了找到我们家人的灵魂，我需要一些材料进行占卜。$b$b纳迦身上佩戴着一些注入了魔网能量的魔法饰品，它们与这里的关联胜过达拉然的任何东西。如果给我一些这样的东西，我就可以进行占卜了。
text.completion: Perfect. Let's get this ritual started, shall we?

english.title: You Never Know Until You Scry
english.objectives: Obtain $1oa Hatecoil Glyptics.
english.description: In order to find the spirits of our family, I will need materials to scry their location.$b$bThe naga carry magical trinkets imbued with ley energy that is better-attuned to this land than anything we have in Dalaran. If I had a few of those, I could do some real scrying.
english.completion: Perfect. Let's get this ritual started, shall we?

text.title: 精灵鬼魂
text.objectives: 使用占卜宝珠找出暗夜精灵鬼魂可能的所在地，然后进行搜寻。
text.description: <欧洛希尔叹了口气。>$b$b我的姐妹总是考验我的耐心。$b$b没关系。我已经找到了几个我父母有可能会出现的地点。我会和卡利斯蒂雅在这块区域搜寻。你已经出了这么多力，不如就帮人帮到底……帮我们看看东边的区域？$b$b你可以用我的占卜宝珠查看仪式里发现的地点。
text.completion: After over ten thousand years... to see mother and father again...$b$b<The elven mage is at a loss for words.>$b$bThank you, $n. Thank you.

english.title: Back from the Dead
english.objectives: Use the Scrying Orb to determine potential locations of night elf spirits, then go rescue them.
english.description: <Olothil sighs.>$b$bMy sister tries my patience sometimes.$b$bNo matter. I've identified a few locations that our parents might be. I shall search in this area with Kallistia. You've already helped us so much... would you help us look to the east?$b$bYou can use my scrying orb to see the locations that our ritual has uncovered.
english.completion: After over ten thousand years... to see mother and father again...$b$b<The elven mage is at a loss for words.>$b$bThank you, $n. Thank you.

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 与记载者艾瑞安妮交谈。
text.description: 多亏了你，守护者圣殿正在发生全面的变化。$B$B然而我们还有很多工作要做。作为我们的领袖，你将决定我们组织未来的方向。$B$B和记载者艾瑞安妮谈谈吧。她会为你指点迷津。

english.title: Tech It Up A Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Chronicler Elrianne
english.description: Thanks to you, the Hall of the Guardian is gradually re-assembling.$B$BHowever, there is much more work to do. As our leader, you can determine the trajectory of our order's future.$B$BSpeak to Chronicler Elrianne. She will show you the ropes.

text.title: 勇士：米尔豪斯·法力风暴
魔法技师
text.objectives: 和大法师麦丽丝交谈。
text.description:
既然你已经找到了前两位勇士，我们手头可是有一大堆任务需要他们帮忙。

大法师麦丽丝一直努力着试图让我们的指挥室运作起来。到楼下去，她会告诉你现在需要做些什么。

english.title: Technical Wizardry
english.objectives: Talk to Archmage Melis.
english.description:
Now that you have your first two champions, there is an abundance of work they can do to help us.

Archmage Melis has been hard at work getting our command room up and running. Head downstairs and ask her to show you what needs to be done.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：魔法诅咒
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉之怒身上弄到一瓶魔法之水。
text.description:
大法师瓦格斯的背叛对我们的事业造成的损失难以估量，$n。我们早晚要处理这个问题，但现在更要紧的是，梅瑞尔的情况进一步恶化了。

不幸的是这根本不是什么疾病，而是源自邪能的魔法攻击。可能是他的宿敌卡萨纳提尔在背后捣鬼。我们需要为他争取一些时间。

艾萨拉之眼蕴含着大量来自艾萨拉女王本人的奥术能量。如果我们能从艾萨拉之怒身上弄到一瓶水，就能帮他维持一段时间。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: A Magical Affliction
english.objectives: Fill a vial with arcane water from the Wrath of Azshara.
english.description:
Archmage Vargoth's betrayal is an unimaginable loss to our cause, $n. We will have to deal with him, but first Meryl's condition has become dire. 

Unfortunately it is not an illness at all, but a magical attack of fel origin. It may be his old nemesis Kathra'natir is behind it. We need to buy him time.

The Eye of Azshara contains a vast store of arcane energy from Queen Azshara herself. If we could obtain a vial of water from the Wrath of Azshara's body, that will sustain him for a while.

text.title: 私人请求
text.objectives: 从幽暗城救出库尔迪拉·织亡者。
text.description: 死亡领主，如果你有空的话……我有一件私事想跟你谈谈。$b$b前阵子，有一位黑锋骑士团的兄弟被黑暗女王关到了洛丹伦的废墟下面。$b$b希尔瓦娜斯拒绝所有的沟通协商，不愿放他出来。现在，世界正在面临毁灭，我们不能再通过外交手段来解决问题。$b$b库尔迪拉·织亡者无法带着锁链对抗燃烧军团。$b$b我们要打破他的枷锁。

english.title: A Personal Request
english.objectives: Rescue Koltira Deathweaver from Undercity.
english.description: If you have a moment, Deathlord... there is a personal matter I would like to speak with you about.$b$bSome time ago, a brother of the Ebon Blade was imprisoned beneath the ruins of Lordaeron by the Dark Lady.$b$bSylvanas has refused all attempts to negotiate his release. Now, our world faces destruction and the time for diplomacy has passed.$b$bKoltira Deathweaver cannot fight the Burning Legion in chains.$b$bSo we will break them.

objectiveDetails.description: 在幽暗城与萨萨里安交谈

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Slug It Out

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：净化梦境之路
text.objectives: 从艾萨拉之眼的纳迦身上取得25份纯化之水，并击败艾萨拉之怒。
text.description: 光明之翼有很多朋友。我喜欢交朋友！$B$B但你知道谁不是光明之翼的朋友吗？来自梦魇的可怕怪物！$B$B他们伤害光明之翼的好朋友，还把林地变得好恶心！$B$B这个地方需要清理一下，但我的魔力用完了。$B$B你能帮忙给光明之翼带些纯净的水么？你得走很远很远……一路走到纳迦聚居的艾萨拉之眼。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: Cleansing the Dreamway
english.objectives: Collect 25 Rarefied Water from the naga in the Eye of Azshara, and defeat the Wrath of Azshara.
english.description: Brightwing has lots of friends. I like friends!$B$BBut you know who isn't Brightwing's friend? Scary monsters from the nightmare!$B$BThey hurt Brightwing's allies, and they made the grove all yucky!$B$BThis place needs to be cleansed, but I'm all out of magic.$B$BCan you bring Brightwing some purified water to help? You'll have to go far, far away... to the Eye of Azshara where the naga live.

text.title: 笼中伙伴
text.objectives: 释放3名被囚禁的夜之子平民。
text.description:
<康妮跺了跺脚，拒绝离开。>

他们把我的朋友关在笼子里！

别让坏人继续伤害我的朋友！坏人把他们带出花园，让他们再也回不了家！

<康妮固执地指着大门。>

我是不会丢下他们一个人回去的！

english.title: Friends in Cages
english.objectives: Release 3 Nightborne Citizens from their captivity.
english.description:
<Korine stomps her foot and refuses to move.>

They put my friends in cages!

Make the bad men stop hurting them! They take them out the garden and they never come back!

<Korine gestures stubbornly toward the door.>

I am not going home until they do!

text.title: Eye of Azshara: A Tough Shell

english.title: Eye of Azshara: A Tough Shell

text.title: 分享财富
text.objectives: 收集20瓶魔力酒。
text.description:
最近发生了一系列令人不安的变动，关系到我们最珍贵的资源，魔力酒。

我猜塔莉萨已经详细向你说明，夜之子没有魔力酒之类的能量供给后会发生什么。

随着恶魔的不断涌入，缺乏的补给让许多人都难以支撑。

给我带来尽可能多的魔力酒。我会把它们交给合适的人。

english.title: Sharing the Wealth
english.objectives: Collect 20 Bottles of Arcwine.
english.description:
Lately there have been a disturbing array of changes involving our most precious resource, Arcwine. 

I imagine Thalyssra has thoroughly educated you about what happens when a Nightborne does not have access to a source of power like Arcwine.

With the presence of the demons came rationing. There are many who do not have enough to sustain themselves.

Bring me as much Arcwine as you can carry. I will see that it gets to the right people.

text.title: 给Grlmrgl的Mlrglrmg
text.description: Mrglm，rmgrlg mrlgmrl。$b$bGrmrglmrl mlrmglrgr mlrmlgr！Rglrmgl rmglrgmlr mlmlglr mglgrgrlm——grlgmr, mlgr——lrgmlrgr rmgrmlg mlrg! Mlrgr？$b$bMrlgmrlgmrl rmglrmglr！$b$b<猎珠人菲恩做了个捅人的动作。>

english.title: A Mlrglrmg For Grlmrgl
english.description: Mrglm, rmgrlg mrlgmrl.$b$bGrmrglmrl mlrmglrgr mlrmlgr! Rglrmgl rmglrgmlr mlmlglr mglgrgrlm - grlgmr, mlgr - lrgmlrgr rmgrmlg mlrg! Mlrgr?$b$bMrlgmrlgmrl rmglrmglr!$b$b<Pearlhunter Phin makes a stabbing motion.>

text.title: 诺格弗格的合理请求
text.objectives: 收集$1oa株安瑟瑞尔花。
text.description:
噢，去他的绿皮讨厌鬼！马林·诺格弗格简直是在敲诈。他说如果我们不能满足他的“合理需求”，他就不让我们使用锻炉。

马林对安瑟瑞尔花的需求量大得惊人。他好像说你最近把他逼得太紧，这只是一报还一报。

当然，如果你认为有必要的话，我可以把他干掉。
text.completed: 返回无冕宝库找到马林·诺格弗格。

english.title: Noggenfogger's Reasonable Request
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Aethril.
english.description:
Oh, the gall of that little green-skinned twerp! Marin Noggenfogger is blackmailing us. He says that if we do not meet his "very reasonable requisition request", he is going to close off access to the crucible.

Marin's asking for a hefty amount of Aethril. He said something about you recently holding a blade to his throat and that he's simply returning the favor.

Of course, if you would rather, I can eliminate him.
english.completed: Return to Marin Noggenfogger in the Uncrowned Vault.

text.title: 配合守望者
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“配合守望者”系列任务。
text.description:
虽然我们也不喜欢这样，不过要找到萨格里特钥石的话，我们就需要守望者的帮助。我们被囚禁在地窟里的时候，他们把钥石拿走了。

玛维失踪了，现在赛拉·月卫是他们的领袖。我已经替你答应下来，我们会帮他们寻找一些逃出守望者地窟的强大生物。作为交换，她会告诉我们该去哪里寻找钥石。

english.title: Working With the Wardens
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the "Working With the Wardens" missions.
english.description:
As much as we might not like it, we need the aid of the Wardens if we're to locate the Sargerite Keystone. They took it from you when we were all imprisoned in the vault.

With Maiev missing, their current leader is Sira Moonwarden. On your behalf, I have agreed that we will assist them in tracking down some of the more powerful creatures that escaped from the Vault of the Wardens. In return, she will direct us to where we need to go to get the Keystone.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“配合守望者：腐蚀者马尔戴斯”任务
完成“配合守望者：法斯尼尔”任务
完成“配合守望者：麦罗克，图鲁克之子”任务
完成“配合守望者：斯库瓦克斯”任务
完成“配合守望者：守望岛”任务

text.title: 强化战刃
text.objectives: 收集$1oa份抑魔金。你可以从达拉然魔法商业区的命运熔炉获得抑魔金，也可以在拍卖行购买。
text.description:
洛拉姆斯通过研究找到了一种方法，可以让我们的战刃更加致命，尤其是在对抗恶魔的时候。

如果他说的都是真的，那么他只需要一些抑魔金就能实现他的想法。一般来说，这种物质常被用来提升护甲的防御力。但洛拉姆斯却坚称，他可以用这种物质来改进我们的战刃。

如果我们的战刃可以变得更加致命，那么我们绝对能在战场上取得更大的优势。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找杰斯·织暗。

english.title: Deadlier Warglaives
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Obliterum, which can be obtained either from your Forge of Fate in Dalaran's Magus Commerce Exchange or from the Auction House.
english.description:
Loramus has researched a way to make our warglaives even deadlier, especially against demons.

If he's to be trusted, he says that all he needs is an amount of Obliterum. Normally, the substance is used to improve the protection of armor, but Loramus insists he can use it for our warglaives.

I am certain we will all benefit from their increased deadliness on the battlefield.
english.completed: Return to Jace Darkweaver on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 特殊燃料
text.objectives: 在《军团再临》地下城里收集$1oa个优质灵魂。
text.description:
所有的军团构造体，包括邪能之槌号在内，都是由灵魂来供能。如果我们要把指挥部开到尼斯卡拉，就需要许多强大的灵魂！

你很有创造力，$n。我相信你会找到办法，从合适的生物身上搞到我们需要的东西。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找杰斯·织暗。

english.title: A Very Special Kind of Fuel
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Sovereign Souls from bosses in Legion dungeons.
english.description:
All Legion constructs, including the Fel Hammer, are powered by souls. If we are going to take the command center to Niskara, we are going to need some very powerful souls, indeed!

You are a very creative person, $n. I am certain that you will find a way to get what we need from the right sorts of creatures.
english.completed: Return to Jace Darkweaver on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 进入魔环
text.objectives: 准备好前往魔环之后与大法师卡德加对话。
text.description:
恐怕卡萨纳提尔就是此次袭击梅瑞尔的幕后黑手。我们几乎没时间做出反应。

我怀疑大法师瓦格斯并不是因为意外才卷入此事当中的。他是一名如此有才能的大法师，同时也是我曾经的好友。即使我会因为消灭他而感到无比的痛苦，我也绝不能轻饶他的背叛。

是时候跟随他进入魔环了。

english.title: Into the Oculus
english.objectives: Talk to Archmage Khadgar when you are ready to travel to the Oculus.
english.description:
I fear Kathra'natir is behind the attack on Meryl. We have little time to act. 

I suspect Archmage Vargoth's involvement is no coincidence. While it greatly pains me to destroy an archmage of his caliber and worse, someone I once called friend, we cannot permit his betrayal to stand unpunished. 

It is time to follow him into the Oculus.

text.title: 维库地盘上的玛拉丝
text.objectives: 从奥鲁丹·白云那里取得飞行工具，然后到风暴峡湾找玛拉丝·夜影。
text.description:
我对风暴峡湾做了一番调查。我发现蔑潮是一支维库部族，曾经被他们的克瓦迪尔同胞断绝了所有的海上活动。许多蔑潮族人都投靠了燃烧军团，成为了蔑魔者。

玛拉丝·夜影之前正在前往蔑魔战争营地。她很可能已经被抓住了。

我为你安排了一趟前往风暴峡湾的空中飞行。你准备好以后就用传送门前往达拉然，然后到克拉苏斯平台找奥鲁丹·白云。
text.giverWindow: 到风暴峡湾找到这个守望者。她之前朝蔑魔战争营地去了。

english.title: Malace in Vrykul Land
english.objectives: Grab a flight from Aludane Whitecloud and find Malace Shade in Stormheim.
english.description:
I did some recon in Stormheim. What I discovered is that the Tideskorn are a tribe of vrykul who have been cut-off from the sea by their kvaldir brethren. Many of the Tideskorn have pledged their services to the Legion and become Felskorn.

Malace Shade was last seen heading toward the Felskorn Warcamp. It is likely that she was captured.

I have arranged a flight to Stormheim for you. When you are ready, you can use the gateway to travel to Dalaran and speak with Aludane Whitecloud at Krasus' Landing.
english.giverWindow: Find this Warden in Stormheim. Last seen heading toward the Tideskorn Warcamp.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用奥鲁丹的飞行工具（可选）

text.title: 符文问题
text.objectives: 让三个符文石失效以救出玛拉丝。
text.description:
单凭一个牢笼是关不住我的，所以他们用这些符文石把我困在这里。每个符文石都由不同的蔑魔符文提供能量。

糟糕的是，他们把符文交给了不同的守卫，这些守卫分散在风暴峡湾的各个角落。

如果赛拉说你可以拿回你的宝贝钥石，那么你就得先把我救出去。

然后我们再做打算。

english.title: Rune Ruination
english.objectives: Deactivate the three runestones to set Malace free.
english.description:
A cage wasn't enough to hold me, so the vrykul ensorcelled these runestones to trap me in here. Each is powered by a different Felskorn rune.

Unfortunately, they gave the runes to different guardians, who have all scattered to different places around Stormheim.

So, if Sira said that you could have your precious keystone back, you're first going to have to get me out of here.

Then, we'll see.

text.title: 符文问题：符文创造者罗洛
text.objectives: 取得罗洛的符文。
text.description: <从符文创造者罗洛身上取得符文，并让符文石失效。>
text.giverWindow: 除掉他，拿到他手里的符文。

english.title: Rune Ruination: Runeskeld Rollo
english.objectives: Collect Rollo's Rune.
english.description: <Collect the rune from Runeskeld Rollo to deactivate this runestone.>
english.giverWindow: Kill him and take the rune he is guarding.

text.title: 符文问题：符文领主拉格纳
text.objectives: 取得拉格纳的符文。
text.description: <从符文领主拉格纳身上取得符文，并让符文石失效。如果你身上没有适合的工具，请先获取一个抓钩枪，以便登上赫达沙尔的城墙。>
text.giverWindow: 你需要他的邪能符文来使符文石失效。

english.title: Rune Ruination: Runelord Ragnar
english.objectives: Collect Ragnar's Rune.
english.description: <Collect the rune from Runelord Ragnar to deactivate this runestone. If you do not already have one, obtain a grapple launcher in order to scale the walls of Hrydshal.>
english.giverWindow: You need his fel rune to deactivate the runestone.

text.title: 符文问题：符文贤者弗洛奇
text.objectives: 取得弗洛奇的符文。
text.description: <这块符文石困住了玛拉丝·夜影。只有符文贤者弗洛奇的符文才可以摧毁它。>
text.giverWindow: 找到并消灭弗洛奇。拿走他的符文，这样你才可以救出玛拉丝。

english.title: Rune Ruination: Runesage Floki
english.objectives: Collect Floki's Rune.
english.description: <This runestone is entrapping Malace Shade. It can only be destroyed by using Runesage Floki's rune upon it.>
english.giverWindow: Hunt down and slay Floki. Take his rune so that you can set Malace free.

text.title: 破碎海滩之战
text.objectives: 搭乘第三舰队的舰船前往破碎海滩。
text.description:
这就是你的船，$n。她是艘很棒的船，历经许多战役。当你准备好离开之后，就跟船长说一声。

祝你一路顺风。我们接到了几份有关破碎海滩的报告，但我敢肯定，瓦里安国王现在还有一大堆手头的事情要忙。
text.completion: Ah, $n, you're up! I'm relieved you made it out of that bloodbath alive. We lost so many good women and men down there...$b$b<Genn Greymane clenches his teeth.>$b$bDamn the Horde for serving us up to the Legion!

english.title: The Battle for Broken Shore
english.objectives: Take the third fleet ship to the Broken Shore.
english.description:
This is your vessel, $n. She's a fine ship, been through many a campaign. Speak with the ship's captain when you're ready to depart.

Good luck out there. We've received few reports about what's happening at the Broken Shore, but I'd wager King Varian has matters well in hand.
english.completion: Ah, $n, you're up! I'm relieved you made it out of that bloodbath alive. We lost so many good women and men down there...$b$b<Genn Greymane clenches his teeth.>$b$bDamn the Horde for serving us up to the Legion!

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘舰船前往破碎海滩

text.title: Darkheart Thicket: A Burden to Bear

english.title: Darkheart Thicket: A Burden to Bear

text.title: 枭兽在哪里
text.objectives: 在失落之光岩洞中杀掉$1oa只枭兽和$2oa只波动的骨质软泥怪。
text.description:
枭兽经常担负着保护重要的艾露恩之地的职责。但如果她对它们的影响减弱，或被切断，那么这种生物有可能变得非常危险。

不幸的是，这些枭兽必须处理掉。瓦尔莎拉近日的扰动已将这些生物逼至疯狂。

一旦某只生物迷失，就只有一种解决问题的方法。

我不能亲手屠杀艾露恩的造物，但我知道这是不可避免的事。

english.title: Where the Wildkin Are
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Owlbeasts and $2oa Undulating Boneslimes within Lostlight Grotto.
english.description:
Owlbeasts are often charged with protecting places of importance to Elune. But if her influence over them wanes or is cut off, the creatures can become dangerous.

These wildkin, unfortunately, must be dealt with. The recent disturbances in Val'sharah have driven these creatures to madness.

Once an individual is lost, there is only one way to address the problem.

I cannot bring myself to kill one of Elune's creations, but I know what must be done.

text.title: 翡翠姐妹
text.objectives: 在失落之光岩洞援救$1oa名月之姐妹。
text.description:
这里的枭兽断开了与艾露恩的联系。

一支树妖小分队闯入了它们的领地，想要弄清楚究竟发生了什么问题，但没有一个人回来。

我担心她们遇到了不测，但还是坚信她们只是急需救援。

在我努力研究枭兽能否得到拯救的时候，如果你能帮忙释放在岩洞中找到的月之姐妹，我会非常感激的。

english.title: Emerald Sisters
english.objectives: Rescue $1oa Sisters of the Moon in Lostlight Grotto.
english.description:
The owlbeasts here are disconnected from Elune.

A contingent of dryads went into their territory to find out what went wrong, but none of them have returned.

I fear the worst, and I believe they are  in need of rescue.

While I try to learn if the owlkin can be saved, I would appreciate your help in freeing any Sisters you find in the grotto.

text.title: 奇怪的盟友
text.objectives: 在勇者之门的大桥处和玛拉丝·夜影见面，然后消灭洛查伯。
text.description:
我来这里是为了追捕一个叫做洛查伯的邪能领主。不过，我已经没心情把他抓回去，我们干脆把他就地正法。

我要先拿回武器，再赶到勇者之门前面的大桥那里。那是一个满是蔑魔维库人和恶魔的恐怖之地。

不过，你觉得我是怎么被抓的？

所以，最好还是不要进去。我知道一个办法，可以把恶魔引到我们这里。
text.giverWindow: 帮玛拉丝·夜影消灭这个邪能领主，然后她就会告诉你怎么取回萨格里特钥石。

english.title: Strange Bedfellows
english.objectives: Meet Malace Shade on the bridge at the Gates of Valor and then slay Lochaber.
english.description:
The reason why I came out here was to capture or kill a fel lord named, Lochaber. I am no longer in a capturing mood.

I'll grab my weapon and then head up to the bridge in front of the Gates of Valor. That place is a scary mess full of Felskorn vrykul and demons.

How do you think I got caught?

So, I'd rather not go back in there. But, I think I know a way to get the demon to come out to us.
english.giverWindow: Help Malace Shade kill this fel lord and she will tell you how to recover the Sargerite Keystone.

text.title: 捕梦网
text.objectives: 用失落之光岩洞中的枭兽图腾为捕梦网充能。
text.description:
我坚持不了太久了……

我带来了一个捕梦网。我本来是要用它偷取枭兽图腾中的魔法。

这是打破它们关押守护者雷姆洛斯的屏障的唯一方法。

请帮我完成我失败的这件事。

english.title: Dreamcatcher
english.objectives: Charge the dreamcatcher using owlbeast totems in Lostlight Grotto.
english.description:
I cannot hold on for much longer...

I brought a dreamcatcher with me. I was to use it to steal the magic from owlbeast totems.

It is the only way to break the barrier where they hold Keeper Remulos.

Please help where I have failed.

text.title: 月之劫掠者
text.objectives: 在地底峡谷击败骨流，并援救守护者雷姆洛斯。
text.description:
我们不能耽误时间！如果守护者雷姆洛斯身处危险之中，我们必须保护他。

有了捕梦网，我们应该能够进入枭兽骨流的老巢。

我们必须击败它，才能释放守护者雷姆洛斯！

english.title: Moon Reaver
english.objectives: Defeat Boneflux and rescue Keeper Remulos in The Undergorge.
english.description:
We must not delay! If Keeper Remulos is in danger, he must be protected.

With the dreamcatcher, we should be able to enter the lair of the owlbeast Boneflux.

It must be defeated so Keeper Remulos can break free!

text.title: 守望者地窟：勇闯地窟
text.objectives: 取得萨格里特钥石。
text.description:
<现在你只需要前往阿苏纳西南方的守望岛，想办法进入守望者地窟，并回到你曾经被囚禁的地底深处。>

<守望者原本把伊利丹的遗体保存在一个被称为背叛者地窟的地方，萨格里特钥石就在那里。>
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找贝拉斯·黎明之刃。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
english.objectives: Retrieve the Sargerite Keystone.
english.description:
<All that is left now is to travel to the Isle of the Watchers off of southwest Azsuna. There, you will need to break back in to the Vault of the Wardens and descend down into its lowest recesses where once you were imprisoned.>

<Within the so-called Vault of the Betrayer, where the Wardens once held Illidan's corpse, the Sargerite Keystone awaits.>
english.completed: Return to Belath Dawnblade on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 守望者地窟：勇闯地窟
text.objectives: 取得萨格里特钥石。
text.description:
守望者这次很守信。现在你只需要前往阿苏纳西南方的守望岛，想办法进入守望者地窟，并回到你曾经被囚禁的地底深处。

守望者原本把伊利丹的遗体保存在一个被称为背叛者地窟的地方，萨格里特钥石就在那里。

祝你好运，$n。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找贝拉斯·黎明之刃。

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: Vault Break-In
english.objectives: Retrieve the Sargerite Keystone.
english.description:
The Wardens made good on the deal. All that's left is to travel to the Isle of the Watchers off of southwest Azsuna. There, you'll need to break back in to the Vault of the Wardens and descend down into its lowest recesses where we were once imprisoned.

Within the so-called Vault of the Betrayer, where the Wardens once held the Master's corpse, you'll find Sargerite Keystone.

Good luck, $n.
english.completed: Return to Belath Dawnblade on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 实现迁跃
text.objectives: 取得邪能引擎注射器、灵魂构造矩阵、邪能引擎点火器，以及邪魂转化器。
text.description:
虽然邪能之槌号有充足的能量，不过它的迁跃引擎无法运行。如果我们要入侵恶魔世界，就必须让指挥部实现迁跃。

我们需要一些可以替代的零件。

幸运的是，燃烧军团带了几个指挥中心和灵魂引擎到破碎群岛上。你可以在阿苏纳的法罗纳尔，以及苏拉玛的邪魂堡垒找到它们。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找杰斯·织暗。

english.title: Jump-Capable
english.objectives: Collect a Fel Engine Injector, a Soul Configuration Matrix, a Fel Engine Ignition, and a Vile Spirit Converter.
english.description:
While it is true that the Fel Hammer is powered, sadly, its jump engines are non-functional. If we are going to invade a demon world, we're going to have to make the command center jump-capable.

We need some replacement parts.

Luckily for us, the Legion brought a couple of command centers and soul engines along with them to the Broken Isles. You will find them at Faronaar in Azsuna, and at Felsoul Hold in Suramar.
english.completed: Return to Jace Darkweaver on the Fel Hammer.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往法罗纳尔（可选）
使用传送门前往邪魂堡垒（可选）

text.title: 饥渴结束
text.objectives: 消灭艾尔伊斯和他的构造体。
text.description: 我很虚弱。我饥渴难耐，朋友。我现在总算明白为什么你的巨龙会在这些池子里栖息。$b$b<咳，咳>$b$b我想来警告你……不过好像已经晚了。$b$b我听到他的声音，就在外面。艾尔伊斯……已经……来了……
text.completion: Hah! Ha ha ha haaaa!$b$bI haven't felt this alive in YEARS!$b$bWhat you've done, $n - not only to replenish my mana pools, but also to save my brood - will not be forgotten. The blues of Azsuna are ever in your debt.

english.title: Hunger's End
english.objectives: Kill Ael'Yith and his construct.
english.description: I am weak. The hunger is devastating, my friend. I understand now why your dragon rests in these pools.$b$b<cough, cough>$b$bI came to warn you but... it looks like I was too late.$b$bI hear him outside now. Ael'Yith... is... here...
english.completion: Hah! Ha ha ha haaaa!$b$bI haven't felt this alive in YEARS!$b$bWhat you've done, $n - not only to replenish my mana pools, but also to save my brood - will not be forgotten. The blues of Azsuna are ever in your debt.

text.title: Maw of Souls: Menace of the Seas

english.title: Maw of Souls: Menace of the Seas

text.title: 你需要一条大船！
text.objectives: 拔33颗锋利的鲨鱼利齿。
text.description:
鲨鱼。它们是对我们海盗最大的威胁。呃……仅次于坏血病、忍者以及司法系统。幸运的是，我们今天只要对付鲨鱼就行了。

去帮我从它们的臭嘴里拔几颗牙齿来。我需要一条新项链！

english.title: You're Gonna Need A Bigger Boat!
english.objectives: Pull 33 Razor-Sharp Shark Teeth.
english.description:
Sharks. They be the biggest threat to us pirates. Well... after scurvy, ninjas, and the judicial system. Luckily, we only have to deal wit' sharks today.

Go pull some teeth out of their ugly faces 'n bring 'em back to me. I needs a new necklace!

text.title: 云游者之友
text.objectives: 与泰克泰克交谈以飞往天禅院，与美猴王见面。
text.description: 福枬……明智的选择。如果传说是真的，它的力量就对我们的事业至关重要。$b$b我们相信美猴王拥有的法杖就是福枬，不过一年多了，都没人见过他的武器。$b$b美猴王最后一次出现的地方是天禅院。做好万全的准备！他可是出了名的……拐弯抹角。$b$b猢狲风筝大师泰克泰克就在寺庙的西边，快去找他吧。

english.title: The Wanderer's Companion
english.objectives: Speak to Tak-Tak to fly to Tian Monastery and meet with the Monkey King.
english.description: Fu Zan... a wise choice. If the legends are true, its powers will be essential to our cause.$b$bWe believe that the staff possessed by the Monkey King could be fabled Fu Zan, yet no one has seen him with the weapon for over a year.$b$bThe Monkey King was last spotted at Tian Monastery. Be prepared for anything! He is known for being... less than forthcoming with his answers.$b$bTak-Tak, a hozen kite-master, is skulking around west of the temple. Speak to him without delay.

text.title: Court of Stars: Wraith in the Machine

english.title: Court of Stars: Wraith in the Machine

text.title: 青龙试炼
text.objectives: 跟随美猴王前往青龙寺，并取得福枬，云游者之友。
text.description: 这柄法杖威力无穷，不过我不是它的主人，所以法杖不可能一直在我手上。$b$b法杖是青龙玉珑的礼物，我只是暂时借用一下。任务完成以后，法杖就得还给她。$b$b玉珑是法杖的守护者，她只会交给有资质的勇士。我们现在去找她，向她提出你的请求。

english.title: The Trial at the Temple
english.objectives: Accompany the Monkey King to the Temple of the Jade Serpent and obtain Fu Zan, the Wanderer's Companion.
english.description: My staff was strong and mighty without peer, but since I not its master, in time it would soon disappear.$b$bThe staff was a gift from the Jade Serpent, Yu'lon, but for only a single task. With my work finished, to her again it has passed.$b$bYu'lon be the staff's keeper, holding it for those who are blessed. To her we now go now, to announce your request.

text.title: 美酒之谜
text.objectives: 寻找美猴王谜语里描述的物品。
text.description:
我的武器很强大，
不打架也需要它。

钟爱酒壶系上去，
美酒甚合我心意。

想要武器问肚皮，
烈酒格外飘香气。

english.title: The Riddle of the Barrel
english.objectives: Search for the objects the Monkey King has described in his riddle.
english.description:
My weapon is great when in a fight,
It's even handy when you sit for a bite.

My favorite flask I've tied on it, hanging from a cord,
The brews within are some of the best that I've ever scored.

If you truly seek my weapon then bring me something nice to put into my belly,
A powerful brew is what I want, something strong and smelly.

text.title: 土地之谜
text.objectives: 寻找美猴王谜语里描述的物品。
text.description:
武器不止能打架，
锄强扶弱都靠它。

谷中农民耕地沃，
劳动果实呈给我。

袋袋谷物高温烤，
为了福祉不能少。

找来我需要的东西。

english.title: The Riddle of the Land
english.objectives: Search for the objects the Monkey King has described in his riddle.
english.description:
My weapon is strong but not for attacking, 
Protecting the weak is what it's enacting.

In the valley are people who till the land from dawn to night,
The fruits of their labor, you must show me tonight.

Sacks of grain are what I require,
Not just any will do, only those kissed by a fire.

Bring me what I seek.

text.title: 纯净之谜
text.objectives: 寻找美猴王谜语里描述的物品。
text.description: 你想寻求我的武器？那你最好回答我的问题。$b$b“什么东西柔韧无脊，$b$b留下混乱只需冲击。$b$b它带来死亡与生机：$b$b少量就够，多则窒息。$b$b它虽常见犹如尘土，$b$b但却来自纯净之湖。”$b$b找来我需要的东西。

english.title: The Riddle of Purity
english.objectives: Search for the object the Monkey King has described in his riddle.
english.description: Do you seek my weapon? Then you better answer my question.$b$b  "I seek something curvy and bendy but with no spine,$b$b   It rushes and rushes leaving chaos behind.$b$b   Sometimes it brings life, sometimes it brings death:$b$b   A little is good, but a lot steals your breath.$b$b   It's as common as dirt, but this part's obscure:$b$b   This stuff comes from a pool that's known to be pure."$b$bBring me what I seek.

text.title: Court of Stars: Bring Me the Eyes

english.title: Court of Stars: Bring Me the Eyes

text.title: 寻求指引
text.objectives: 在西瘟疫之地的乌瑟尔之墓与玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵见面。
text.description: 或许大领主提里奥已经牺牲，不过灰烬使者还在某个地方等待着我们。它的力量可以摧毁燃烧军团。我们必须找到它！$B$B只可惜，我们不一定能在提里奥的陨落之处找到灰烬使者，它现在可能在那片“地狱”的任何地方。$B$B我觉得有一个老朋友可以帮我们找到圣剑。请你相信我，去一趟瘟疫之地的乌瑟尔之墓。你将在那里寻找答案。
text.completion: These brave watchers require our aid. The Light may well ignore our prayers if we choose not to help our brethren.

english.title: Seeking Guidance
english.objectives: Meet Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Uther's Tomb in Western Plaguelands.
english.description: Highlord Tirion may be gone, but the Ashbringer is still out there somewhere. Its power would devastate the Legion. We must find it!$B$BI wish it were as simple as returning to where Tirion fell. It could be anywhere on that infernal landscape by now.$B$BI believe an old friend can help us find the blade. I ask that you place your faith in me and journey to Uther's tomb in the Plaguelands. We will seek answers there.
english.completion: These brave watchers require our aid. The Light may well ignore our prayers if we choose not to help our brethren.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: （可选）使用达拉然的传送门前往达拉然巨坑

text.title: 维护和平
text.objectives: 清除$1oa个灵魂。
text.description: 因为圣光扰动的余波，在墓地游荡的迷失灵魂被吸引到了生者的世界。事实上，他们只是在寻求抚慰……正如我们在大领主提里奥逝世后的黑暗时期所做的一样。$B$B不过，这些不得安宁的灵魂对我们誓要守护的神圣墓地是一种威胁。如果要让此地恢复平静，就必须将他们清除干净。
text.completion: Those poor souls are finally at peace. Thank you.

english.title: Keeping the Peace
english.objectives: Exorcise $1oa spirits.
english.description: The lost souls roaming the cemetery grounds have been drawn to the realm of the living in the wake of the Light's disturbance. In truth, they merely seek comfort... as we all do in these dark times since Highlord Tirion's passing.$B$BHowever, their unrest threatens the very sanctity of the tomb we have sworn to protect. If we are to restore peace here, then they must be exorcised.
english.completion: Those poor souls are finally at peace. Thank you.

text.title: 神圣之地
text.objectives: 净化悔恨岭的墓地。
text.description: 我们必须让埋葬于此的死者得到安息。这些灵魂的出现只会对圣光产生进一步的干扰。$B$B不能再这样下去了。$B$B我必须维持这个屏障，不让任何躁动的灵魂进入光明使者的安息之地。如果你可以净化这片墓地，就可以终结这场疯狂。
text.completion: Good. Given time, the last few lingering souls will make their way home.

english.title: Sacred Ground
english.objectives: Purify the graveyards in Sorrow Hill.
english.description: We must ensure that those buried here are never again disturbed. Their spirits' very presence only further perturbs the Light.$B$BThis cannot continue.$B$BI must maintain this barrier to ensure none of the wayward souls enter the Lightbringer's resting place. If you can purify the graves themselves, this madness can finally cease.
english.completion: Good. Given time, the last few lingering souls will make their way home.

text.title: 启示之光
text.objectives: 与乌瑟尔·光明使者交流。
text.description: 虽然这位朋友已经离世，不过我们仍然需要他的帮助。$B$B光明使者乌瑟尔深谙圣光之微妙，远甚我所知的任何圣骑士。如果我们可以见到他，他或许可以帮我们找到灰烬使者。$B$B仪式已经准备就绪。你准备好以后就到墓穴去。
text.completion: Tirion... could it be?

english.title: The Light Reveals
english.objectives: Commune with Uther the Lightbringer.
english.description: We seek aid not from a living friend, but one who passed long ago.$B$BUther the Lightbringer was more attuned to the subtleties of the Light than any paladin I've ever known. If we reach out to him, he may be able to help us find the Ashbringer.$B$BThe ceremony has been prepared. Approach the tomb when you are ready.
english.completion: Tirion... could it be?

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 在墓穴与玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯会合

text.title: 希望致胜
text.objectives: 在圣光之愿礼拜堂与玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵见面。
text.description: 提里奥……还活着！我们必须去救他。$B$B圣光之愿礼拜堂离这不远。我们必须集结部队，立刻前往破碎海滩。
text.completion: We're ready to depart when you are.

english.title: Hope Prevails
english.objectives: Meet Lord Maxwell Tyrosus at Light's Hope Chapel.
english.description: Tirion... still alive! We have to save him.$B$BLight's Hope Chapel is not far from here. We must rally our forces and leave at once for the Broken Shore.
english.completion: We're ready to depart when you are.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 展望未来
text.objectives: 把萨格里特钥石放到侦察地图上面。
text.description:
阿卡玛加入了我们。科达娜·邪歌也被消灭。而且，我们还拿到了萨格里特钥石。

一切进展顺利。

荣耀归于你，$n。

english.title: The Crux of the Plan
english.objectives: Place the Sargerite Keystone above the Scouting Map.
english.description:
We have Akama. Cordana Felsong has been eliminated. And, we have the Sargerite Keystone.

Everything is falling into place.

The honor is all yours, $n.

text.title: 两位助手
text.objectives: 招募贝拉斯·黎明之刃和主母玛沃伦丝成为你的勇士。
text.description:
随着我们部队的不断壮大，以及影响力的不断扩张，你需要更多值得信任的伙伴来处理最为紧要的任务。

是时候提拔两位得力助手成为你的勇士了。

我认为，你可以考虑招募贝拉斯和玛沃伦丝。他们都是不可或缺的人才。
text.completed: 与邪能之槌号下层的食魂者阿莱利谈一谈。

english.title: Two Worthies
english.objectives: Recruit Belath Dawnblade and Matron Mother Malevolence as your champions.
english.description:
As our forces grow, and our reach extends ever outward, you have need of more trusted companions to handle the most important of missions.

The time has come for you to elevate two worthies into the ranks of your champions. 

It's my opinion that you should consider recruiting Belath and Malevolence. They have both proven themselves indispensable.
english.completed: Speak with Allari the Souleater down below in the lower level of the Fel Hammer.

text.title: Maw of Souls: From Hell's Mouth

english.title: Maw of Souls: From Hell's Mouth

text.title: Court of Stars: Disarming the Watch

english.title: Court of Stars: Disarming the Watch

text.title: 整装待发
text.objectives: 拜访暴风城港口的联盟军队。
text.description:
艾泽拉斯各地的盟友们都纷纷来到暴风城，为我们对抗燃烧军团的战斗献上自己的力量。

在你出航之前，应该去见一见他们。我们准备得越充分，就越有帮助！
text.completion: It's good to see you've prepared yourself. You never know what you'll be facing out there.$b$bWe've commissioned these rings for high-ranking members of the Alliance. May this one protect you in the battle to come.

english.title: To Be Prepared
english.objectives: Visit Alliance forces in Stormwind Harbor.
english.description:
Allies from across Azeroth have come to Stormwind to support our efforts against the Burning Legion.

Before you ship out, you should pay them a visit. Every bit of preparation helps!
english.completion: It's good to see you've prepared yourself. You never know what you'll be facing out there.$b$bWe've commissioned these rings for high-ranking members of the Alliance. May this one protect you in the battle to come.

english.title: Court of Stars: They Bloom at Night

objectiveDetails.description: 采集精心栽培的魔力之花

text.title: Court of Stars: The Deceitful Student

english.title: Court of Stars: The Deceitful Student

text.title: 怪异的残渣
text.objectives: 在耳语崖与古薇娜·刃歌谈一谈。
text.description:
这些怪诞的残渣是果冻状软泥和某种树妖骨头的混合体。

古薇娜·刃歌应该会对这些很有兴趣。

english.title: Grotesque Remains
english.objectives: Speak to Guviena Bladesong at the Whispering Bluffs.
english.description:
These grotesque remains are an amalgamation of jelly-like ooze and what appear to be dryad bones.

Guviena Bladesong would be interested in seeing these.

text.title: 亲自出马
text.objectives: 在至高岭消灭噬人黑暗，在苏拉玛消灭赫萨·格里姆多迪，并在瓦尔莎拉消灭泰莉西亚。
text.description:
在我看来，守望者把我们关了这么多年，是他们亏欠我们。只可惜，他们的新领袖赛拉·月卫不同意我的观点。

虽然你的勇士已经解决了许多越狱的囚犯，但她还想要更多的帮助。事实上，为了看到我们的诚意，她甚至要求你亲自出马。

你必须熄灭狗头人蜡烛的火焰才能召唤噬人黑暗。而剩下的两个要更加直接一些。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找贝拉斯·黎明之刃。

english.title: Deal With It Personally
english.objectives: Kill the Devouring Darkness in Highmountain, Hertha Grimdottir in Suramar, and Theryssia in Val'sharah.
english.description:
The way I see it, the Wardens owe us for all of those years we were imprisoned. Unfortunately, their new leader, Sira Moonwarden doesn't agree with my assessment.

Even though your champions have already dealt with several of their escaped bounties, she wants more. In fact, as a sign of good faith, she's asking that you deal with it personally.

You'll have to extinguish the flames of the kobold candles to summon forth the Devouring Darkness. The other two should be more straightforward.
english.completed: Return to Belath Dawnblade on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: Maw of Souls: Return of the Beast

english.title: Maw of Souls: Return of the Beast

text.title: 标下你的记号
text.objectives: 招募塞莱莎、希尔乐和洛林，杀死监视者杜兰特。
text.description:
在你出去的时候，我去打听了一下。

你要找的人叫监视者杜兰特。他就住在跃影花园附近。

我可以帮你对付他，但你还需要帮助。我知道三个有这种能力的人，而他们也都效忠于我们的事业。

你要对希尔乐说：“猫头鹰在黄昏下啼鸣。”

对洛林说：“刃豹在广场上徘徊。”

并告诉塞莱莎：“那个刻薄的桶匠已经咽气了。”

他们知道该怎么做。

等任务完成后，就去告诉凡瑟尔吧。

english.title: Make Your Mark
english.objectives: Recruit Sylessa, Cyrille, and Lorin and slay Overseer Durant.
english.description:
While you were out, I asked around.

You are looking for Overseer Durant. Turns out he lives near the Shimmershade Garden.

I can help you confront him, but you will need help. There are three individuals with the necessary skills, and they serve our cause.

Tell Cyrille that the owl hoots at dusk.

Inform Lorin that the saber prowls the plaza.

Mention to Sylessa that the cruel caskmaster has breathed his last.

They will know what to do. 

Speak to Vanthir when the deed is done.

text.title: 重归黑暗
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“重归黑暗”任务。
text.description:
在你进入黑暗神殿以前，我们还需要更多的情报。我们可不希望把你送到一个陷阱里去。

我们要弄清楚他们的部队结构，巡逻部署，新的防御工事，以及阿卡玛的早餐吃什么。

<贝拉斯咧嘴一笑。>

我建议你派出我们的破碎者战士执行任务。他们可以混入阿卡玛部署在神殿里的灰舌部队。只要有人能够全身而退，我们就可以得到重要的情报。

我们可以派遣一位或两位勇士在神殿外围侦察接应。

english.title: Back in Black
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Back in Black".
english.description:
Before you head into the Black Temple, we need more information. The last thing we want is for you to teleport into a trap.

We must discern their force structure, patrol schedule, new defenses, and what Akama eats for breakfast.

<Belath grins.>

I suggest you send our broken warriors to handle this. They can blend in with the rest of Akama's Ashtongue forces inside the temple. We'll get what we need to know from the ones that make it back.

A champion handler or two can scout outside the temple.

text.title: 肃清马顿
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“肃清马顿”任务。
text.description:
马顿的恶魔活动愈演愈烈。我们入侵以后，那里仍然残留着许多恶魔。

为了清除邪能之槌号可能受到的任何威胁，我们必须消灭那些恶魔。

english.title: Securing Mardum
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Securing Mardum".
english.description:
There has been increased demonic activity below on Mardum. There are still demons leftover down there from when we first invaded.

To eliminate any threat to the Fel Hammer, it's time that they were destroyed.

text.title: 危险：“墓穴冰魔”弗约拉格
新晋精英
text.objectives: 与伊利达雷征募官阿里亚娜·火心对话。
text.description:
虽然我很希望能够不费吹灰之力地取得胜利，但现实却是如此的冰冷而残酷：我们需要更多的军队。

加尔顿已经在尽力招募更多的破碎士兵。

现在我们有了阿里亚娜·火心，她可以为我们训练更多的恶魔猎手。

english.title: Green Adepts
english.objectives: Speak with your Illidari recruiter, Ariana Fireheart.
english.description:
As much as I would love us to finesse our way to victory, the cold, hard reality is that we need more powerful forces.

We are already straining Gaardoun's ability to recruit more broken.

But now that we have Ariana Fireheart, she can train new demon hunters for us.

text.title: 入侵尼斯卡拉
text.objectives: 启动邪能之槌号的控制台，完成“入侵尼斯卡拉”场景战役。
text.description:
一切安排妥当。所有系统运转正常，并且我们拥有充足的燃料。邪能之槌号的迁跃引擎也已就绪。

凯丽娅和瓦雷迪斯知道你在找他们。根据贝拉斯的情报，他们已经躲到一个叫做尼斯卡拉的恶魔世界里了。

我们要发动入侵，彻底做个了结。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找受难者奥图里斯。

english.title: The Invasion of Niskara
english.objectives: Activate the Fel Hammer's control console and complete the scenario, "The Invasion of Niskara".
english.description:
Everything is in place. All systems are operational and we have plenty of fuel. The Fel Hammer's jump engines are ready.

Caria and Varedis know that you are coming for them. Belath's intelligence indicates that they have retreated to the demon prison world of Niskara.

It's time to begin the invasion and finish this once and for all.
english.completed: Return to Altruis the Sufferer on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 最后的提议
text.objectives: 调查邪能之槌号外面出了什么事。
text.description:
那是什么？听起来外面好像出事了。

出大事了……

你最好去看看，$n！

english.title: A Final Offer
english.objectives: Investigate whatever is happening outside of the Fel Hammer.
english.description:
What was that? Sounds like something's outside.

Something big...

You'd better get up there, $n!

text.title: 圣光之愿会师
text.objectives: 前往东瘟疫之地，进入圣光之愿礼拜堂地下的圣光之愿大殿，和其他圣骑士会合。
text.description: 我们必须安葬大领主提里奥。$B$B只有一个地方适合成为这位伟大圣骑士的安息之地……那就是我们礼拜堂地下的秘密堡垒，圣光之愿大殿。$B$B世界各地的圣骑士正在赶去那里参加葬礼。我知道，提里奥最希望能到场的人就是你。

english.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
english.objectives: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: We must put Highlord Tirion to rest.$B$BThere is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel.$B$BPaladins the world over will join us for the ceremony. I know Tirion would want you there most of all.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
text.objectives: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
text.description: Before we march on the Broken Isles, $n, we must put Highlord Tirion to rest.$B$BThere is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel here.$B$BPaladins the world have gathered below for the ceremony. They await your arrival to begin the ceremony.

english.title: We Meet at Light's Hope
english.objectives: Join the other paladins at Light's Hope Sanctum beneath Light's Hope Chapel in Eastern Plaguelands.
english.description: Before we march on the Broken Isles, $n, we must put Highlord Tirion to rest.$B$BThere is but one place suitable for a paladin of his caliber... Light's Hope Sanctum, a secret bastion of the Light hidden beneath our chapel here.$B$BPaladins the world have gathered below for the ceremony. They await your arrival to begin the ceremony.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 重要任务
text.objectives: 在达拉然的克拉苏斯平台与达纳斯·托尔贝恩谈一谈。
text.description: 勇士！我带来了达纳斯·托尔贝恩的紧急消息。$b$b他要你到克拉苏斯平台跟他会合。他有一个重要任务急需你协助！

english.title: An Important Mission
english.objectives: Speak with Danath Trollbane at Krasus' Landing in Dalaran.
english.description: Champion! I bear an urgent message from Danath Trollbane.$b$bHe requests that you join him at Krasus' Landing. He has an urgent mission that requires your expertise!

text.title: 重返破碎海滩
text.objectives: 搭乘达纳斯的备用坐骑前往破碎海滩并提供帮助。
text.description: 如果要为这场战争出力，我就需要第一手的信息。我要飞到破碎海滩，亲眼看看那片战场。$b$b你的确是一位战功赫赫的指挥官，而且当时你也在场。我需要你的指点。$b$b你愿意陪我一起去破碎海滩吗？虽然我不想引起敌人的注意，不过谁也说不准在靠近邪能风暴的地方会发生什么事。

english.title: Return to the Broken Shore
english.objectives: Take Danath's spare mount to the Broken Shore and provide assistance.
english.description: If I'm to assist in this war, I need firsthand information. I will fly to the Broken Shore and  see the battlefield for myself.$b$bYour record as a proven commander is unquestioned, and you were there. I could use your insight.$b$bWill you accompany me to the Broken Shore? I don't anticipate engaging the enemy, but that close to the Fel Storm, one can never be sure.

objectiveDetails.description: 在破碎海滩证明你的勇气

text.title: 血色突击
text.objectives: 在血色修道院与萨萨里安谈一谈。
text.description: 血色十字军的大检察官？！$b$b你不会在记录阵亡英雄的历史履历中看到大检察官怀特迈恩的名字。$b$b不过……尽管她已经陷入了疯狂，她对圣光的信仰就连最虔诚的圣骑士也比不上。$b$b虽然世上的血色十字军已经所剩无几，但血色修道院却远没到废弃的地步。现在，这座修道院里聚集着剩下的最狂热的血色十字军。$b$b想获得成功，就要全力出击。

english.title: The Scarlet Assault
english.objectives: Speak with Thassarian in Scarlet Monastery.
english.description: The High Inquisitor of the Scarlet Crusade?!$b$bYou will not find High Inquisitor Whitemane listed in the annals of history alongside the names of fallen heroes.$b$bStill... despite her madness and zealotry she held a bond to the Light unmatched by even the greatest paladins.$b$bThere are few scarlet crusaders left on this world, but Scarlet Monastery is far from abandoned. The monastery now houses the most zealous and crazed crusaders the order has left.$b$bSuccess will require a full blown assault.

text.title: 组建大军
text.objectives: 利用血色十字军战士的尸体召唤12只生疮的食尸鬼。
text.description: 我们低估了修道院里残存的血色十字军数量。争夺大教堂的战斗已经耗费了太久时间。$b$b我们应该采取更巧妙的办法来解决战斗……$b$b将倒下的十字军复生为食尸鬼，让他们去对抗自己曾经的兄弟姐妹。$b$b在亡灵大军的碾压之下，血色十字军撑不了多久。

english.title: Raising an Army
english.objectives: Raise 12 Festering Ghouls from the corpses of Scarlet Crusaders.
english.description: We underestimated the number of scarlet crusaders still residing in the monastery. The battle for control of the cathedral is taking too long.$b$bIt's time to take a more resourceful approach to the battle...$b$bRaise the fallen crusaders as ghouls and send them back into the battle against their brothers and sisters.$b$bThe Scarlet Crusade will not be able to hold back the tide of undeath for long.

text.title: 血色指挥官
text.objectives: 消灭高级指挥官古尔乔。
text.description: 现在我们与萨莉·怀特迈恩之墓中间就只剩下最后一个障碍了。$b$b高级指挥官古尔乔守卫着通往陵墓的道路。尽管他是个狂热者和谋杀犯，但他依然是一个顽强的骑士，一生致力于彻底消灭我们的族类。$b$b我们决不能小瞧了他……$b$b杀了他，我们来这儿的任务就差不多完成了。

english.title: The Scarlet Commander
english.objectives: Slay High Commander Goodchilde.
english.description: There is only one more obstacle standing between us and the tomb of Sally Whitemane.$b$bHigh Commander Goodchilde guards the path to the tomb. Although he is a zealot and a murderer, he is still a hardened knight who has dedicated his life to the eradication of our kind.$b$bHe should not be underestimated...$b$bSlay him and our work here will be nearly done.

text.title: 狂热者重生
text.objectives: 将萨莉·怀特迈恩复活为死亡骑士。
text.description: 有些时候英雄和恶徒之间不过是一念之差。作为一名大审判官，萨莉·怀特迈恩将自己视为守护人类对抗天灾的勇士。然而在她的率领下，血色十字军将生者和亡者一同屠戮。$b$b死亡能让灵魂归于平静，但萨莉·怀特迈恩的灵魂除外。她的死亡充满悔恨和不甘。$b$b我们应该给她一个赎罪的机会。这样做代价高昂，但我相信她会给予足够的回报。

english.title: The Zealot Rises
english.objectives: Raise Sally Whitemane as a Death Knight.
english.description: Sometimes the line between hero and villain is nothing more than perception. As High Inquisitor, Sally Whitemane saw herself as a champion of humanity in the war against the scourge. Yet under her leadership the Scarlet Crusade slew the living along with the undead.$b$bDeath can bring a silent peace to the soul, but not for Sally Whitemane. Her death is one of regret and unrest.$b$bWe will offer her the chance to atone for her crimes. The price will be high, but I have little doubt she will pay it.

enders.name: 大领主达里安·莫格莱尼

text.title: 飞蛾扑火
text.objectives: 收集4只地光蚱蜢。
text.description:
你肯定注意到了我们的客人。

我已然观察它们一段时间，发现它们对树非常感兴趣。我不知道它们对树苗是否有害，但我们不能冒这个险。

收集一点昆虫，带来给我。我会检验它们，然后决定是否不用去管。

english.title: Moths to a Flame
english.objectives: Collect 4 Underglow Locusts.
english.description:
No doubt you have noticed our guests.

I have watched them for a time and seen how they are attracted to the tree. I do not know if they are harmful to our sapling, but we cannot take that chance.

Collect a handful of the insects and bring them to me. I will examine them and determine if they are to be left alone.

text.title: 进入酒庄
text.objectives: 在暮光酒庄的外围与莉莉丝·月郡会面。
text.description:
你必须潜入暮光酒庄，找到能够对付这些虫子的东西，然后把它带回来。

要做到这一点的话，你就得想办法绕过看守果园的守卫。

莉莉丝这次可以帮上我们的忙。我会安排你和她在入口附近见面。

快去吧！

english.title: Make an Entrance
english.objectives: Meet with Ly'leth Lunastre outside the Twilight Vineyards.
english.description:
I need you to infiltrate the Twilight Vineyards and bring back something to deal with these insects.

To do that, you will need a way to bypass the guards that keep the orchards secure.

Ly'leth will be able to help us there. I will arrange to have her meet you near the entrance.

Go quickly!

objectiveDetails.description: 向玛尔迦展现你的忠诚
搭乘肩舆前往酒庄大门

text.title: 工作成果
text.objectives: 品尝蜂蜜酒、顺滑的美酒和油腻的生啤。
text.description:
我得帮你维持这副外表。

<玛尔迦露出歉意的微笑。>

在我带你穿越酒庄之前，你得暂时忍耐一下这副尊荣。这是免遭守卫怀疑的唯一方法。

只要有机会，我就会帮你的，可必须等到一切安全的时候才行。

跟我来——我们的第一站就是品酒馆。在这里，你可以品尝到我们酿造的作品。

english.title: The Fruit of Our Efforts
english.objectives: Taste the Honeyed Infusion, Supple Nectar, and Unctuous Draught.
english.description:
It is my job to maintain appearances here.

<Margaux smiles apologetically.>

You will have to endure a little showmanship while I walk with you through the vineyard. It is the only way to avoid suspicion.

I will try to help you as I can, but only when it is safe to do so.

Come with me- our first stop is the tasting pavilion. There you can sample some of our work.

text.title: 酿造法：魔力酒
text.objectives: 跟随玛尔迦走过酒庄。在安全的地方交换信息。
text.description:
<玛尔迦低声地说道。>

在我们穿越酒庄的过程中，也许我们能找到机会交换一下信息。

不管你看到什么东西，都尽量保持镇定的样子，知道了吗？

<玛尔迦的脸上挂着虚假的微笑。>

我们继续前进吧？

english.title: How It's Made: Arcwine
english.objectives: Follow Margaux through the Vineyard. Exchange information where possible.
english.description:
<Margaux speaks in a hushed tone.>

While we walk through the Vineyard, we may find time to exchange information.

Try not to look alarmed at what you see, hm?

<Margaux flashes a vacant, forced smile.>

Shall we press on?

text.title: 超高浓度
text.objectives: 使用能量容器接住15滴暗夜井精华。
text.description:
这是一份无上的殊荣，我希望你能明白。并不是所有人都有资格出现在这一神圣的场所。

<希尔维林优雅地整理了一下袖口。>

如果你想要参加此次活动，只要拿起能量容器，然后走进我们旁边的水池就可以了。

用碗来接住充满暗夜井能量的露珠——这是安全处理它的唯一方式。

一旦你的容器盛满，请走到木桶前，并小心地将液体倒进去。

尽情享受吧！

english.title: Intense Concentration
english.objectives: Catch 15 drops of Nightwell Essence using an Energy Vessel.
english.description:
This is a rare treat, I hope you know. Not just anyone is allowed to stand on this hallowed ground.

<Sylverin adjusts his cuffs in a dignified fashion.>

To participate in the demonstration, simply take up an energy vessel and wade into the pool beside us. 

Catch the delicate dewdrops of Nightwell energy in the bowl as they fall- this is the only way one can safely manage its essence.

Once your vessel is full, proceed to our demonstration cask and gently pour the amalgamation into it.

Enjoy!

text.title: 经典方法
text.objectives: 参与一次榨汁演示。
text.description:
这自然而威严的场面被称为暗夜井灌注。你在此体验的同时，玛尔迦正忙着为你准备另一场演示。

穿过桥向左，然后再穿过桥向右走。你会在榨汁游廊上找到她。

请尽情享受接下来的参观之旅！

<希尔维林露出紧张的假笑。>

english.title: The Old Fashioned Way
english.objectives: Participate in a juicing demonstration.
english.description:
While you experienced the raw majesty that is Nightwell Infusion, Margaux was busy preparing another demonstration for you.

Head across the bridge and to the left, then again across a bridge and to your right. You will find her on the juicing veranda.

Enjoy the remainder of your tour!

<Sylverin offers an intensely fake smile.>

text.title: 丝翼之灾
text.objectives: 消灭8只破烂的丝翼巨蛾。
text.description:
蛾子。从没有听说过这么……野蛮的东西！

它们在啃食我们的作物，而法力浮龙完全不予阻止。

你！你看上去有点实力。阻止这些东西，让我们按时完成收割。

咳咳，拜托。

english.title: Silkwing Sabotage
english.objectives: Slay 8 Tattered Silkwings.
english.description:
Moths. Who ever heard of something so... barbaric!

They are eating our crop and the mana wyrms do nothing to deter them.

You. You seem capable. Deter these creatures so we can complete our harvest on schedule.

Ahem. Please.

text.title: 多余的浮龙
text.objectives: 收集8只影鳞捕蝇者。
text.description:
我们旅程就要结束了。我会让你去“自由参观果园”，现在的话这种行为是不会引起怀疑的。

你在那边会发现大量的法力浮龙。

我敢肯定，果园里到处都是那种东西。但愿你能顺利地解决你的害虫问题，我的朋友。

<玛尔迦向你露出了温暖人心的微笑。>

english.title: Balance to Spare
english.objectives: Collect 8 Shadescale Flyeaters.
english.description:
Our tour is just about over. I will let you loose to 'walk the orchard', as is proper at this stage.

While you are there, you will notice a large number of mana wyrms floating about.

I am certain the vineyard would not miss a handful of them.

Good luck with your insect problem, friend.

<Margaux smiles warmly at you.>

text.title: 局势突变
text.objectives: 找到玛尔迦。
text.description:
<希尔维林心神不安地看着你。>

我本来是打算在这里和你还有玛尔迦汇合的，这样我就能带你们离开酒庄了。

我的主人玛尔迦从不迟到。恐怕她是遇到了麻烦。

请你找到她并确认一下她的安危吧。

english.title: Reversal
english.objectives: Locate Margaux.
english.description:
<Sylverin regards you uneasily.>

I was meant to meet you and Margaux here so I could escort you from the Vineyard. 

My mistress Margaux is never late. I fear that something terrible may have happened.

Please find her and make sure she is well.

text.title: 找到坏人
text.objectives: 与凡瑟尔谈一谈。
text.description:
我……无言以对。

为了将这些法力浮龙交给我们，玛尔迦付出了一切。我不能接受这个结果。

我要你找到一个可以解决问题的人，一个可以不择手段去除掉监视者杜兰特的人。

去跟凡瑟尔谈谈吧。他肯定知道我们应该找谁。

english.title: Seek the Unsavory
english.objectives: Speak to Vanthir.
english.description:
This is just... unspeakable.

Margaux risked everything to get these mana wyrms to us. I cannot let it end this way.

I need you to find someone who can make this right. Someone who will do whatever it takes to see Overseer Durant slain.

Speak with Vanthir. I am certain he will know exactly who we need.

text.title: 如果道理讲不通……
text.objectives: 用800份远古魔力收买阿鲁因。
text.description:
除非你能开出值得我去拼命的价钱，否则我是不会动弹一步的。

凡瑟尔已经告诉过你了，我的要价可是向来都不便宜的。

就比如说……足以供我用一个月的魔力。

<阿鲁因一副自命不凡的样子，就好像你完全无法接受他无理的要求一样。>

english.title: If Words Don't Work...
english.objectives: Bribe Arluin with 800 Ancient Mana.
english.description:
Unless you have something worth risking my life for, I will not budge.

Vanthir must have told you that my services do not come cheap.

Let's say... enough mana to sustain me for a month.

<Arluin looks smug, as if you could never agree to this request.>

objectiveDetails.description: 向阿鲁因支付足够的贿赂

text.title: 大收获
text.objectives: 袭击魔导师的魔力酒货物，将偷到的货物分给阿鲁因。
text.description:
我除了情报，什么都没有，但对于有你这种能力的人来说，情报可能很有用。你帮了我的忙，接下来可以帮助你自己了。

魔导师每天都会收到一批魔力酒物资，在森严的护送下运往宫殿。我可以告诉你货物地点，前提是你给我留一份货物分成。

我手下有个人已经渗透进护卫队中，并且会尽量拖延送货时间，以便让你发动进攻。

english.title: A Big Score
english.objectives: Attack the Magistrix's arcwine shipment and bring Arluin his cut of the stolen goods.
english.description:
I'm not rich in anything but information, but maybe that can be of use to someone with your skills. You helped me, now you can help yourself.

The Magistrix receives a daily shipment of arcwine, which travels to the palace with a heavy escort. I can share the location, provided you leave me a cut of the goods.

One of my men has infiltrated the group and will hold up the delivery long enough for you to strike.

text.title: 力量增长
text.objectives: 与圣光秘殿的玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯对话。
text.description: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵希望你返回圣光秘殿。$B$B我们的破碎群岛防御战役已经正式开始，我们需要你来指引我们的方向。
text.completion: Thank you for coming so quickly, Highlord.

english.title: Growing Power
english.objectives: Speak to Maxwell Tyrosus at the Sanctum of Light.
english.description: Lord Maxwell Tyrosus has requested your presence back at the Sanctum of Light.$B$BOur campaign to defend the Broken Isles is getting under way, and we need you at the helm.
english.completion: Thank you for coming so quickly, Highlord.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

text.title: 鲜血主母
text.objectives: 招募女伯爵莉亚德琳作为白银之手骑士团的勇士。
text.description: 我只是站出来的第一个。你必须找到最为伟大的圣骑士来担任我们的勇士。$B$B我认为还有一个人配得上这一光荣的名号——女伯爵莉亚德琳，血骑士的领袖。$B$B请你立刻动身去寻找她吧。
text.completion: Excellent. Both Lord Tyrosus and Lady Liadrin will serve proudly.

english.title: The Blood Matriarch
english.objectives: Enlist Lady Liadrin as a champion of the Order of the Silver Hand.
english.description: I am but the first of many; you must find the holiest of paladins to champion our order.$B$BThere is one other I believe deserves such an honor - Lady Liadrin, Matriarch of the Blood Knights.$B$BGo speak to her now.
english.completion: Excellent. Both Lord Tyrosus and Lady Liadrin will serve proudly.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 黑暗风暴
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图，完成“黑暗风暴”任务。
text.description: 你好，大领主。$B$B我身旁的这个就是侦察地图。我们可以通过侦察地图来派遣我们的盟友，让他们前往破碎群岛的各地，完成各项重要的任务。$B$B我们的第一个任务十分重要——萨格拉斯之墓上方的风暴正在愈演愈烈。我们应该派出勇士去关注那个地区的动向，并尽可能地寻找幸存者。
text.completion: Maxwell Tyrosus has returned with important news. First, he did recover some survivors. They are recovering in the chapel now. Among them was Commander Ansela, a veteran paladin and trainer.$B$BAs for the second, I will let Sir Tyrosus tell you himself.

english.title: Dark Storms
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Dark Storms."
english.description: Greetings, Highlord.$B$BBeside me is the Scouting Map. From it, you can direct our allies to carry out vital assignments across the Broken Isles.$B$BThe first task is critical - the storms above the Tomb of Sargeras are intensifying. We should send our champions to keep an eye on that region, and scour the area for possible survivors.
english.completion: Maxwell Tyrosus has returned with important news. First, he did recover some survivors. They are recovering in the chapel now. Among them was Commander Ansela, a veteran paladin and trainer.$B$BAs for the second, I will let Sir Tyrosus tell you himself.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 壮大部队
text.objectives: 与指挥官安瑟拉对话并招募一个新晋侍从。
text.description: 指挥官安瑟拉是一位久经沙场的老兵，也是一名经验丰富的导师。很多英勇的骑士都曾经师从她的门下。$B$B现在去和她谈谈吧，然后招募一个新晋侍从。
text.completion: Good. These squires will fight well.

english.title: Recruiting the Troops
english.objectives: Speak to Commander Ansela and recruit a squad of Squires.
english.description: Commander Ansela is a grizzled war veteran and seasoned teacher. Many of our most valiant knights once trained under her.$B$BGo speak to her now, and recruit a squad of Squires.
english.completion: Good. These squires will fight well.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 愤怒与正义
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“愤怒与正义”。
text.description: 有新的任务在等待我们的指示，大领主$n。壁炉谷遭到了小股恶魔部队的袭击。$B$B毫无疑问，他们在试探我们的兵力……还有耐心。$B$B我们的兵力十分雄厚，但我的耐心可没那么足。我建议派出我们的勇士和部队去解决这一威胁。
text.completion: Our mission was a success! Not only did we defeat the enemy, but we recruited Alamande Graythorn, a noted scholar from the Hearthglen archives.

english.title: Wrath and Justice
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "Wrath and Justice."
english.description: A new mission requires our attention, Highlord $n. Hearthglen has come under attack by a small demon army.$B$BNo doubt, they are testing our strength... and our patience.$B$BStrength we have in bounds, but my tolerance wears thin. I suggest we send our champions and troops to deal with this threat.
english.completion: Our mission was a success! Not only did we defeat the enemy, but we recruited Alamande Graythorn, a noted scholar from the Hearthglen archives.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 更上一层楼
text.objectives: 与阿拉曼德·格雷索恩对话并选择一项大厅升级。
text.description: 阿拉曼德·格雷索恩是一位著名的圣光学者。$B$B他很久之前就已经解甲归田，但他的头脑仍然如往昔一般睿智。即使他能在决斗中连胜几个回合，我也不会感到丝毫的意外。$B$B和他谈谈看吧，了解一下他对我们的职业大厅的改进有什么看法。
text.completion: Excellent. I knew Sir Graythorn would come through.

english.title: Tech It Up a Notch
english.objectives: Speak to Alamande Graythorn and choose a class hall upgrade.
english.description: Alamande Graythorn is well known among scholars of the Light.$B$BHe has long since retired from battle, but his mind is sharp as ever. I wouldn't be surprised if he could take a bout or two in a duel, either.$B$BSpeak to him and see if he has any knowledge to share regarding the improvement of our order hall.
english.completion: Excellent. I knew Sir Graythorn would come through.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

text.title: 勇士：裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂

enders.name: 裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂

text.title: 潮湿之篱
text.objectives: 在灰白原野中收集$1oa个潮湿的刺肉果。
text.description:
这些水果是劣魔的食物。

如果把它们从村庄里清除掉，老灰背也许会非常感激。

english.title: Moist Around the Hedges
english.objectives: Collect $1oa Moist Grizzlecombs  in Grizzleweald.
english.description:
These fruit appear to be food to grell.

Old Grizzleback might appreciate it if they were removed from the village.

text.title: 劣魔的代价
text.objectives: 击败灰白原野中的安德坎德。
text.description:
劣魔头目必须伏诛。

它的皮肤是白色的，说话带刺，很容易认出来。
text.giverWindow: 劣魔头目。首席捣蛋鬼。暴力又难以捉摸。满嘴恶言。

english.title: Grell to Pay
english.objectives: Defeat Enderkind in Grizzleweald.
english.description:
The ringleader of the grell must be sent to his final rest.

You will know him by the white of his skin and the bite of his tongue.
english.giverWindow: Ringleader of the grell. Chief mischief maker. Violent and unpredictable. Foulmouthed.

text.title: 天空印记
text.objectives: 与达拉然的大法师卡德加对话。
text.description: 向您致敬，大领主。我有一些重要的事情要告诉你。$B$B在我前往破碎群岛期间，我亲眼看到一个极为耀眼的发光物体从邪能风暴之中诞生。它坠落到了苏拉玛的海岸上，甚至在暴风雨之中划出了一道轨迹！$B$B我在它身上感到了一股难以置信的能量波动，之后它就消失在了地平线上。$B$B我们必须立刻向大法师卡德加汇报这一消息。
text.completion: I see that you have an urgent message for me. What is it?

english.title: A Sign From The Sky
english.objectives: Speak to Archmage Khadgar in Dalaran.
english.description: Greetings, Highlord. I have important news to share with you.$B$BDuring my expedition to the Broken Shore, I saw with my own eyes an extraordinarily luminescent object emerge from the Felstorm. It fell down towards the coast of Suramar, cutting a swath through the tempest itself!$B$BFrom it I felt an incredible surge of power, before it vanished beyond the horizon.$B$BWe need to bring news of this immediately to Archmage Khadgar.
english.completion: I see that you have an urgent message for me. What is it?

text.title: 白银之手聚会
text.objectives: 与女伯爵莉亚德琳、守备官波鲁斯、裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂、救赎者阿拉托尔和奥伯妮·亮鬃对话。
text.description: 我们的高墙可以保证圣光之心的安全，但它正在遭受黑暗之潮的侵蚀。$B$B我们应该将骑士团的各位领袖召集起来并共同商议。$B$B你需要与女伯爵莉亚德琳、守备官波鲁斯、裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂、救赎者阿拉托尔和奥伯妮·亮鬃对话。我们应该借助他们的智慧，以应对未来的威胁。
text.completion: Thank you for gathering everyone together.

english.title: Meeting of the Silver Hand
english.objectives: Speak to Lady Liadrin, Vindicator Boros, Justicar Julia Celeste, Arator the Redeemer, and Aponi Brightmane.
english.description: The Light's Heart will be safe within our order's walls, but it bears dark tidings.$B$BWe should gather the leaders of our order for a council.$B$BGo and speak to Lady Liadrin, Vindicator Boros, Justicar Julia Celeste, Arator the Redeemer, and Aponi Brightmane. We should seek their wisdom for the days ahead.
english.completion: Thank you for gathering everyone together.

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 与救赎者阿拉托尔交谈
与女伯爵莉亚德琳交谈
与外面的裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂交谈

text.title: 美猴王的挑战
text.objectives: 帮美猴王酿酒。
text.description:
你有头脑也有实力，甚至还能上天入地……
不过能否好好学习？美酒才是爱的真谛！
收集东西混合一起，
听我指示才会讨喜。
通过这门酿酒课题，
我才考虑武器给你。

english.title: The Monkey King's Challenge
english.objectives: Help the Monkey King to complete his brew.
english.description:
You can roll, you can hit, even shoot flaming spit...
But can your training you heed? Tasty brew's what I need!
The goodies you've gathered are what you must mix,
The instructions to follow will come from my lips.
Just pass this final brewing lesson,
And I will point you to my weapon.

text.title: 不懈警戒
text.objectives: 通过滑翔前往克拉苏斯平台下方的伊利达雷棱堡。
text.description: <考瓦斯看着你的战刃，瞪大了眼睛。>$B$B我好想亲眼看看它们的威力！或许我们可以在下一次屠魔行动之前稍微切磋一下？$B$B你不在的时候，我们在平台下面搭建了一个营地，以便监视燃烧军团的活动。我们应该尽快赶过去，杰斯在找你，好像有什么特别重要的事情！

english.title: Eternal Vigil
english.objectives: Glide to Illidari Redoubt off of Krasus' Landing.
english.description: <Kor'vas glances at your glaives, her eyes widening.>$B$BI'm excited to see what those can do in person! Maybe we can spar a bit before heading out on the next hunt?$B$BWhile you were gone we built a camp just off of this landing to help us watch over the Legion's movements. We should head there right away - Jace needed your help with something. It sounded big!

text.title: 打开通道
text.objectives: 用你的战刃打开一扇通往位于马顿的邪能之槌号的传送门。
text.description: 我联系上了马顿的部队。在我们离开的这些年里，他们拿下了邪能之槌号，并且一直在那里坚守！$B$B玛沃伦丝已经优化了曲速系统，可以将我们的大部队传送到船上，不过这几乎会耗光本就不充裕的能源储备。$B$B我相信一定有更好的办法。$B$B你的战刃拥有基尔加丹的一部分力量，你应该可以用它们打开一扇通往邪能之槌号的永久传送门。

english.title: Securing the Way
english.objectives: Use your glaives to rip open a gateway to the Fel Hammer in Mardum.
english.description: I was able to make contact with our forces on Mardum - they secured the Fel Hammer after our departure all those years ago and have held it ever since!$B$BMalevolence has utilized the ship's warp systems to transport the bulk of our forces aboard, but doing so greatly taxes what little power remains.$B$BI believe there to be a better way.$B$BYour glaives carry a piece of the power of Kil'jaeden - you should be able to use them to open a permanent gateway to the Fel Hammer.

objectiveDetails.description: 打开一扇通往邪能之槌号的传送门

text.title: Tome of Illusions - Secrets of the Shado-Pan

english.title: Tome of Illusions - Secrets of the Shado-Pan

objectiveDetails.description: 与葡萄酒商伊苏克斯交谈

text.title: 勇士：女伯爵莉亚德琳
text.completion: Good tidings, $n. I am told that you seek to stop the demon's reign of terror. Is this true?$B$BThe Legion has hunted our people across countless worlds... taken countless lives. With each of our paladins that falls the Light reels in pain.$B$BI have had enough - I will fight by your side.

english.title: Champion: Lady Liadrin
english.completion: Good tidings, $n. I am told that you seek to stop the demon's reign of terror. Is this true?$B$BThe Legion has hunted our people across countless worlds... taken countless lives. With each of our paladins that falls the Light reels in pain.$B$BI have had enough - I will fight by your side.

text.title: 血色屠杀
text.objectives: 消灭16名血色十字军。
text.description: 我们来此只有一个目的，将萨莉·怀特迈恩复生为黑锋骑士团的一员。为此，我们志在必得。$b$b然而，血色十字军一直危害着艾泽拉斯的人民。所以，我们今天要消灭每一个十字军，烧光他们的每一面旌旗，把这里彻底摧毁，否则绝不停手。$b$b来吧，死亡领主，让我们向血色十字军渲泄毁灭！

english.title: The Scarlet Massacre
english.objectives: Slay 16 Scarlet Crusaders.
english.description: We have a single purpose here, to raise Sally Whitemane as a Death Knight of the Ebon Blade. Such is our goal and we will see it through.$b$bHowever, the Scarlet Crusade has terrorized the people of Azeroth long enough. Therefore, our work here this day will not be done until every crusader has fallen, every stone has crumbled, and every banner burned.$b$bCome, Deathlord, let us bring ruin upon the Scarlet Crusade.

text.title: 劣魔之涌
text.objectives: 在灰白原野杀掉$1oa个怒目地劣魔。
text.description:
劣魔发疯了，不断攻击我的弟兄，破坏我们的村庄！

求你了，陌生人，请帮我们把这些讨厌的恶棍干掉吧。

english.title: All Grell Broke Loose
english.objectives: Slay $1oa Wildeyed Undergrell in Grizzleweald.
english.description:
The grell are in a frenzy, attacking my brethren and destroying our village!

Please, stranger, help us send these wicked miscreants to the soil.

text.title: 除草工作
text.objectives: 在灰白原野中使用老灰背的法杖摧毁$1oa个纠缠的荆棘。
text.description:
我到家时，发现前门被魔法根须挡住了。

我可以把它们铲除掉，但我的族人中很少有人能够亲手铲除它们。

带上我的法杖。凭它的力量可以轻而易举地松开碍事的根须。

english.title: Grassroots Effort
english.objectives: Use Old Grizzelback's Staff to destroy $1oa snarled brambles in Grizzleweald.
english.description:
When I arrived at my home, the front door was barred by magical roots.

I was able to remove them, but few of my tribe possess the necessary ability to do so themselves.

Take my staff. Its powers will easily disentangle the obstructing roots.

text.title: 大领主的指令
text.objectives: 完成任务“大领主的命令：宿敌。”
text.description: 我们目前最重要的任务就是找到恐惧魔王巴纳扎尔。我们应该派出骑士团的守护者去追查他最近的下落。

english.title: The Highlord's Command
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "The Highlord's Command: Nemesis."
english.description: Tracking down the dreadlord Balnazzar is our highest priority. Let us send defenders of our order to pinpoint his recent movements.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“大领主的命令：宿敌”任务

text.title: 挺进法罗纳尔
text.objectives: 在旧海滩小径与守备官波鲁斯谈一谈。
text.description: 我们正在密切关注燃烧军团在阿苏纳的法罗纳尔附近的动向。$B$B我们的情报显示，他们的一个高级军官，甚至有可能是恐惧魔王巴纳扎尔本人，正在那里策划一次袭击。$B$B我们或许可以借此机会，给燃烧军团的指挥层造成沉重的打击。$B$B守备官波鲁斯目前指挥着我们的前线部队。他肯定会欢迎你的援助，大领主。
text.completion: Excellent, Highlord. You've arrived.

english.title: To Faronaar
english.objectives: Speak to Vindicator Boros along Old Coast Path.
english.description: We are keeping a close eye on Legion movements at Faronaar in Azsuna.$B$BOur intel suggests that a high-ranking lieutenant, possibly the dreadlord Balnazzar himself, masterminds the attacks in that region.$B$BThis may be our chance to strike a blow at the Legion's leadership.$B$BVindicator Boros commands our forces at the front. He would welcome your help, Highlord.
english.completion: Excellent, Highlord. You've arrived.

text.title: 释放惩戒
text.objectives: 在法罗纳尔低地杀死20个恶魔。
text.description: 我简直怒火中烧。$B$B就像活火山一样随时会爆发 。$B$B军团对埃索达的攻击无疑是火上浇油，大领主。我不想再眼睁睁地看着同胞们死去。$B$B现在，我要惩戒邪恶，伸张正义！帮助我吧，大领主，消灭你在法罗纳尔低地看到的所有恶魔。
text.completion: Glorious.

english.title: This Is Retribution
english.objectives: Kill 20 demons in lower Faronaar.
english.description: Anger seethes within me like smoldering coals.$B$BOne stoke, and that anger will flare into a roaring flame.$B$BThe Legion's attack on Exodar was just the motivation I needed, Highlord. I've watched my brethren die for the last time.$B$BNow, I will be the one who does the killing. I WILL have justice! Help me, Highlord, and slay any demons you encounter in lower Faronaar.
english.completion: Glorious.

text.title: 通讯宝珠
text.objectives: 摧毁3个军团宝珠。
text.description: 我们有重要的事情需要处理，大领主。$B$B军团营地里散布着一些宝珠，它们对恶魔的战略部署极其重要。$B$B如果摧毁那些宝珠将对他们造成沉重的打击。我会跟你一起处理这件事情，大领主。

english.title: Communication Orbs
english.objectives: Destroy 3 Legion Orbs.
english.description: We have important work at hand, Highlord.$B$BSpread out across the legion camp are orbs that are vital to the Legion's planning and strategy.$B$BDestroying them will severely damage their efforts. I will go with you, Highlord, to see this through.

enders.name: 裁决者朱莉亚·塞雷斯蒂

text.title: 返程车票
text.objectives: 激活道标。
