text.description: 喂？这里是首席传送师欧库勒斯。看来你已经安全抵达。$b$b此时此刻，我正在锁定你的位置。我得请你激活你那边的道标，这样才能建立传送链接。$b$b明白了吗？很好。
text.giverWindow: 激活传送门，并返回沙尔艾兰。

english.title: The Way Back Home
english.objectives: Activate the beacon.
english.description: Hello? This is Chief Telemancer Oculeth. I see you have emerged safely!$B$BI am locking in your location as we speak. I will need you to activate the beacon on your end so we can establish a teleportation link.$b$bGot it? Good.
english.giverWindow: Activate the portal and return to Shal'Aran.

text.title: 命令法典
text.objectives: 取得命令法典并救出守备官波鲁斯。
text.description: 波鲁斯有大麻烦了。$B$B邪能领主贾沃克斯镇守着西边的深渊。波鲁斯也被困在那里了。$B$B我们必须击败贾沃克斯，取得他手里的命令法典并救出守备官波鲁斯。$B$B我跟你一起去，大领主！

english.title: The Codex of Command
english.objectives: Collect 1 Codex of Command and rescue Vindicator Boros.
english.description: Boros is in serious trouble.$B$BThe fel lord, Jarvox, guards the pit to the west. Boros is trapped in there, too.$B$BWe need to defeat Jarvox, take the Codex of Command that he carries, and rescue Vindicator Boros.$B$BI am with you, Highlord!

text.title: Illusion - Mark of the Shattered Hand

english.title: Illusion - Mark of the Shattered Hand

text.title: Illusion - Mark of the Bleeding Hollow

english.title: Illusion - Mark of the Bleeding Hollow

text.title: 浸水的魔力
text.objectives: 帮咒法师马戈斯钓到浸水的魔力。
text.description:
你怎么来这了？唉，这个时候在哪里都无所谓了。重要的是我需要你的帮助！

我看你的钓鱼技术还不错。愿不愿意试试身手？
text.completion: That's it! This will do nicely. Please bring me as many of these as you can!

english.title: Drowned Mana
english.objectives: Fish up a Drowned Mana for Conjurer Margoss.
english.description:
How did you end up out here?  Ah well, that's neither here nor there at this point.  What matters is that I need your help!

I see you have some experience fishing. Think you could put that skill to use for me?
english.completion: That's it! This will do nicely. Please bring me as many of these as you can!

text.title: 恶魔符文
text.objectives: 从破碎群岛的恶魔身上获取30块恶魔符文。
text.description: 霍迪尔曾英勇地穿过了那道恶魔传送门。他本该光荣战死，但却被军团的渣滓俘虏了。$B$B我们一直想象着末日之战在艾泽拉斯打响，但是如果主动出击可以让我们救出悲惨的同胞，那我们就非战不可。$B$B海姆达尔认为，只要有合适的能量源，他就可以将其导入燃烧军团的传送门，从而进行重启。从燃烧军团的恶魔身上收集恶魔符文石，促成最后的决战！

english.title: Demonic Runes
english.objectives: Obtain 30 Demonic Runes from demons in the Broken Isles.
english.description: Hodir valiantly went through that demonic portal. He should've earned an honorable death, but instead was taken prisoner by Legion scum.$B$BWe always imagined the battles of the end days to take place here in Azeroth, but we shall bring the fight to the enemy if it means sparing one of our own that terrible fate.$B$BHymdall thinks that with the right power source, he can reactivate and redirect to Legion's own gateways. Gather demonic runestones from Legion and let the final conflict begin!

text.title: 子嗣的遗产
text.objectives: 听取领袖们的会议发言。
text.description: 白银之手的领袖们已经集合。倾听他们的意见。
text.completion: Our mission is clear, but what are our next steps?

english.title: The Scion's Legacy
english.objectives: Listen to the leaders of the council.
english.description: The leaders of the Silver Hand have gathered. Listen to their counsel.
english.completion: Our mission is clear, but what are our next steps?

enders.name: 玛克斯韦尔·泰罗索斯男爵

objectiveDetails.description: 与泰罗索斯交谈并选择战略

text.title: 入侵尼斯卡拉
text.objectives: 启动邪能之槌号的控制台，完成“入侵尼斯卡拉”场景战役。
text.description:
一切安排妥当。所有系统运转正常，并且我们拥有充足的燃料。邪能之槌号的迁跃引擎也已就绪。

凯丽娅和瓦雷迪斯知道你在找他们。根据贝拉斯的情报，他们已经躲到一个叫做尼斯卡拉的恶魔世界里了。

我们要发动入侵，彻底做个了结。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找凯恩·日怒。

english.title: The Invasion of Niskara
english.objectives: Activate the Fel Hammer's control console and complete the scenario, "The Invasion of Niskara".
english.description:
Everything is in place. All systems are operational and we have plenty of fuel. The Fel Hammer's jump engines are ready.

Caria and Varedis know that you are coming for them. Belath's intelligence indicates that they have retreated to the demon prison world of Niskara.

It's time to begin the invasion and finish this once and for all.
english.completed: Return to Kayn Sunfury on the Fel Hammer.

text.title: 黑暗神殿之战
text.objectives: 使用传送门前往黑暗神殿并与阿卡玛对战。
text.description:
兰达洛克的书真是让人醍醐灌顶。它记载了一个方法，可以让我们不费吹灰之力就绕过黑暗神殿的神圣屏障。

我需要一点时间召唤传送门。请退后。
text.completed: 回邪能之槌号找凯恩·日怒。
text.giverWindow: 前往黑暗神殿与阿卡玛作战。说服他加入你的队伍，一起对抗燃烧军团。

english.title: Confrontation at the Black Temple
english.objectives: Use the Gateway to the Black Temple and confront Akama.
english.description:
The book from Lan'dalock is very enlightening. It describes a technique which will provide a simple and elegant bypass around the Black Temple's holy barriers.

I will need but a moment to summon a gateway. Stand back, please.
english.completed: Return to Kayn Sunfury on the Fel Hammer.
english.giverWindow: Travel to the Black Temple and confront Akama. Convince him to join forces with you in the fight against the Burning Legion.

text.title: Vault of the Wardens: Startup Sequence

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: Startup Sequence

text.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Grim Matter

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: A Grim Matter

text.title: 守望者地窟：他是怎么上去的？

english.title: Vault of the Wardens: How'd He Get Up There?

text.title: 毁灭之锤的下落
text.objectives: 跟萨尔和米尔拉一起乘着风暴比克飞进大漩涡。
text.description: 你救了我们所有人，萨满！谢谢你！$b$b萨尔想要直奔大漩涡，取回毁灭之锤，但我很担心。他在上一场战斗中身负重伤，而掉下去的那个恶魔格斯逊可能还活着。你应该跟他一起行动。$b$b你准备好之后就跳上风暴比克，我们一起去找回神器！

english.title: Where the Hammer Falls
english.objectives: Use Stormbeak to fly into the Maelstrom with Thrall and Mylra.
english.description: You saved us all, shaman! Thank you!$b$bThrall wants to dive right into the Maelstrom and retrieve the Doomhammer, but I worry - he was badly wounded in that last fight, and that demon Geth'xun may still be alive down there. We should go with him.$b$bHop on Stormbeak when you're ready and we'll track down that artifact!

objectiveDetails.description: 搭乘风暴比克飞进大漩涡

text.title: 石母所知
text.objectives: 前往塞拉赞恩的王座，与石母塞拉赞恩谈一谈。
text.description: 我们必须分头行动。格斯逊让我身负重伤，到现在还没有恢复，我不想让石母看出我的虚弱。这个任务就交给你了。$b$b到塞拉赞恩的王座去找她谈谈，看她知不知道毁灭之锤的下落。$b$b如果她有什么要求，就尽量提供帮助。虽然她危险又善变，不过这里是她的地盘，没有她帮忙的话，我们就得不到什么收获。
text.completed: 前往塞拉赞恩的王座，与石母塞拉赞恩谈一谈。

english.title: What the Stonemother Knows
english.objectives: Travel to Therazane's Throne and speak with Therazane the Stonemother.
english.description: We must split up. I am still badly wounded from my encounter with Geth'xun, and I don't want to appear weak before the Stonemother. This task falls to you.$b$bTravel to Therazane's Throne and speak to Therazane herself. Find out if she has seen the Doomhammer.$b$bHelp her if she asks. She is dangerous and mercurial, but this is her realm, and without her aid we will find nothing.
english.completed: Travel to Therazane's Throne and speak with Therazane the Stonemother.

text.title: 万恶穴居人
text.objectives: 在苍白栖地消灭25个邪岩穴居人。
text.description: 你是说“恶魔”？“燃烧军团”？哼！除了我的怒火，这里没什么可以燃起来的，萨满。如果这些怪物妄想侵蚀我的领域，他们就会尝到被我美丽的双脚所践踏的滋味！$b$b我没见过你所说的战锤，不过石头穴居人知道空中掉下来的所有东西。而且，自从绿色的火焰掉到他们的栖息地附近，他们就开始在苍白栖地胡作非为。$b$b到西边去收拾那些邪岩穴居人。或许你可以让他们开口。

english.title: The Troggs that Fel to Earth
english.objectives: Slay 25 Felrock Troggs in the Pale Roost.
english.description: "Demons" you say? A "Burning Legion?" Hrmph! Nothing burns here but for my ire, shaman, and if these monsters think to corrupt my domain, they will be crushed beneath my dainty beautiful feet!$b$bI have not seen this hammer of yours, but the stone troggs witnessed everything that fell from the sky. Moreover, they've been running amok in the Pale Roost ever since the green fire landed near their home.$b$bBe a dear and lay waste to the Felrock Troggs west of here. Perhaps you can get one of them to talk.

text.title: 石龙救援
text.objectives: 在苍白栖地击败折磨幼龙的穴居人，救出$oa只石龙。
text.description: 你说的那个恶魔在掉进我的地盘以后，肯定对穴居人动了什么手脚。他们以前根本不敢伤害我的石龙。$b$b现在，他们在苍白栖地禁锢幼龙，胡作非为。快去终止这场闹剧，救出那些幼龙！它们以后对我们还有用处。

english.title: Stone Drake Rescue
english.objectives: Rescue $oa Stone Drakes in the Pale Roost by defeating the troggs that torment them.
english.description: When that demon of yours fell into my realm he must have done something to the troggs. They were never a threat to my beloved stone drakes before.$b$bNow they're loose all over the Pale Roost, subduing drakes on the ground. Put a stop to this insult at once, and free those drakes! They may be of use to us later.

text.title: 在此一举
text.objectives: 把5个乳石守护者送到埃奥瑟拉身边。
text.description: 我承认，我和石龙主母过去的关系时好时坏。你知道吗，在大灾变时她竟然会支持死亡之翼。但是埃奥瑟拉已经得到教训，我有责任保护她。$b$b问题是就算是受到穴居人的攻击，她也不愿放弃她的蛋。$b$b幸好你是萨满！用你的元素之力在苍白栖地帮助倒下的乳石守护者，把他们送到埃奥瑟拉身边，好让他们把龙蛋送到我这里来。

english.title: Clutch Play
english.objectives: Escort 5 Opalescent Guardians to Aeosera.
english.description: I confess the stone drake broodmother and I have had a rocky relationship in the past. She supported Deathwing during the Cataclysm, you know. But Aeosera has been put back in her place and it is my responsibility to protect her.$b$bThe problem is that she refuses to abandon her eggs, even in the midst of a trogg attack.$b$bYou're a shaman! Use your natural magnetism to reassemble fallen Opalescent Guardians in the Pale Roost. Escort them to Aeosera so they can carry her eggs to safety of my bosom.

objectiveDetails.description: 把守护者送到埃奥瑟拉身边

text.title: 针石强袭
text.objectives: 和埃奥瑟拉一起飞到针石熔渣场，击败深渊灾星波罗克。
text.description: 穴居人知道战锤掉到哪了，而且我认为那些胆小鬼已经向燃烧军团通风报信。哼！$b$b自大灾变以来，“波罗克” 一直是石头穴居人的首领。他是一个没头脑的投机主义者，他的报应就要来了。到针石熔渣场找他，强迫他说出情报。$b$b让埃奥瑟拉跟你一起，她和她的孩子们要找那些冒失的野兽单独算笔账。

english.title: Needlerock Beatdown
english.objectives: Fly with Aeosera to Needlerock Spire and defeat Borlock of the Deeps.
english.description: The troggs saw where your hammer fell, and I expect those cowards told the Legion where to find it. Hmph!$b$bThe leader of the stone troggs since the Cataclysm has been "Borlock," a thick-headed little dirt-grubber who's about to get what's coming to him. Find him at Needlerock Spire and beat the information out of him.$b$bTake Aeosera with you. Her and her brood have their own score to settle with those belligerent little beasts.

objectiveDetails.description: 和埃奥瑟拉一起攻击针石熔渣场
和埃奥瑟拉一起飞到针石熔渣场

text.title: Tracking Down Uthalesh
text.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
text.description: The logbook contains the latest information on Uthalesh. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

english.title: Tracking Down Uthalesh
english.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description: The logbook contains the latest information on Uthalesh. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

text.title: 有志者事竟成
text.objectives: 命令你的勇士们找出进入魔环的方法。
text.description:
魔环似乎落入了燃烧军团之手，并且受到了严密的守卫。我们得找个办法把你弄进去。

我想你的勇士们能帮上大忙。

english.title: When There's a Will, There's a Way
english.objectives: Ask your champions to find a way into the Oculus.
english.description:
The Oculus appears to have fallen to the Burning Legion and is heavily shielded. We will need to figure out a way to get you inside. 

I suspect your champions can help us out quite a bit.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“魔环的准备工作”任务

text.title: Tracking Down the Skull
text.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
text.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Skull of the Man'ari. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

english.title: Tracking Down the Skull
english.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Skull of the Man'ari. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

text.title: 一个小忙
text.objectives: 和艾丽对话。
text.description:
梅瑞尔的病症让人困扰。我之前见过相似的病症，但我想不起来它的名字了……

去和我的朋友谈谈吧。我叫她艾丽。她从守护者圣殿上次还在运作时就一直住在这儿了。如果这里有什么有关魔法病症的书籍，她应该知道要去哪儿找。

english.title: A Small Favor
english.objectives: Talk to Ari.
english.description:
Meryl's illness is troubling. I have seen something similar before, but I cannot think of its name...

Talk to my friend. I call her Ari. She has lived here in the Hall of the Guardian since it was last in use. If a tome on magical afflictions is to be found here, she would know where to look.

text.title: 解决方法
text.objectives: 从苏拉玛城的夜之子那里汲取50瓶暗夜井能量。
text.description:
大法师卡德加是我的朋友。他对你的信任意义重大。

我知道有一本书里有你需要的，但它不愿意被找到。它古老而愤怒，并且渴求着力量。我们需要找一个妥善的方法说服它自己出现。如果你去苏拉玛城，从夜之子精灵那里取一些暗夜井能量作为礼物给它，或许它就会平静下来。

english.title: The Proper Way of Things
english.objectives: Siphon 50 phials of nightwell energy from the nightborne in Suramar City.
english.description:
Archmage Khadgar is my friend. That he trusts you means much. 

I know of the book in which you seek, but it does not want to be found. It is old and angry and thirsts for power. We will have to convince it to emerge from hiding in the proper way. Perhaps if you bring it a gift of nightwell energy from the nightborne elves in Suramar City it will be mollified.

text.title: 艾丽的包裹
text.objectives: 把艾丽的包裹带给大法师卡德加。
text.description:
看啊！它就在我们的眼皮底下。“治疗罕见病症的奥术指南”。温顺的小东西。大多数书籍只不过想要被掸掉灰尘，有人时不时去翻看一下罢了。我们会把暗夜井能量留在这儿，它就会乖乖跟着你走了。

拿着。我把这本书包了起来，给你带去给卡德加。包书时用的是蛾子的翅膀，那样可以让它感到轻松舒适。另外这里还有个礼物给你。只是个小东西，真的。

english.title: Ari's Package
english.objectives: Bring Ari's package to Archmage Khadgar.
english.description:
Look! It was right here under our noses. "Arcanists Guide to Rare Diseases." Sheepish thing. Most books just want to be dusted off and read from time to time. We will leave the phials of nightwell energy and it will go with you meekly enough.

Here. I have packaged the book up for you to bring to Khadgar. I wrapped it in moth's wings to keep it soothed and light-hearted. And there is a gift for you. Just a small thing, really.

text.title: 东游记
text.objectives: 前往翡翠林，在青龙寺和美猴王见面。
text.description:
你虽然答出了我的谜语，不过你的工作还没有结束。

到青龙寺来找我寻求答案。

english.title: Journey to the East
english.objectives: Meet with the Monkey King at the Temple of the Jade Serpent within the Jade Forest.
english.description:
My riddles you've solved but your job is not complete.

Come, meet me at the Jade Serpent Temple for the answers you seek.

text.title: 好事成三
text.objectives: 给她带三件特别的礼物。这些礼物能在地下城中的强大敌人身上找到。
text.description:
你知道么，艾丽比她看起来的样子厉害多了。她曾是艾泽拉斯最强的大法师之一，也曾是提瑞斯法议会的一员。不幸的是她的心灵遭受了重创，自那之后她就再没离开过守护者圣殿。

她送你礼物一定是因为她很喜欢你。如果你给她带一些特殊的回礼，她一定会让你更加喜出望外。她喜欢成三的东西。

english.title: Three Is a Lucky Number
english.objectives: Bring Ari 3 special gifts. These gifts can be found on powerful enemies in dungeons.
english.description:
Ari is much more than she appears, you know. She was once one of the most powerful archmagi on Azeroth and a member of the Council of Tirisfal. Unfortunately her mind was badly damaged and she has not left the Hall of the Guardian since.

She must like you very much to have given you a gift. If you bring her something special in return, I suspect she will surprise you. She prefers things in threes.

text.title: 秘密通信
text.objectives: 用夜之子魔刃从夜之子信使身上取得3叠信件。

english.title: Secret Correspondence
english.objectives: Acquire 3 Stacks of Letters from Nightborne Couriers using the Nightborne Spellblade.

text.title: 大领主的指令
text.objectives: 完成任务“大领主的命令：神圣同盟”。
text.description: 英明的决定，大领主。我们应当加大征兵力度，进一步扩建我们的军队。我们可以派出勇士们去执行这些命令。

english.title: The Highlord's Command
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "The Highlord's Command: Holy Allies."
english.description: Good decision, Highlord. We should be bolstering our forces by increasing recruitment efforts. Let us send our champions to carry out these orders.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“大领主的命令：神圣同盟”任务

text.title: 大领主的指令
text.objectives: 完成任务“大领主的命令：军团防御”。
text.description: 说得好，大领主。燃烧军团并不是单个的敌人，它是一头巨兽，长着许多个头颅。$B$B如果想要击败它们，我们就必须在各条战线都保持警惕。$B$B我们应该派出我们的勇士去击退燃烧军团的入侵。

english.title: The Highlord's Command
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "The Highlord's Command: Legion Defense."
english.description: Well said, Highlord. The Legion is not one individual enemy - it is a massive beast with many heads.$B$BTo defeat them, we will need to stay vigilant on all fronts.$B$BLet us send our champions to deal with the Legion incursions as they come.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“大领主的命令：军团防御”任务

text.title: 大领主的指令
text.objectives: 完成任务“大领主的命令：获取军需”。
text.description: 你是对的，大领主。如果没有良好的后勤供应，我们的战斗就没有成功的希望。$B$B也就是说，我们需要获得稳定的补给，包括武器、食物、药品和其它必需品。$B$B我们应该派出勇士前去建立一条补给线。
text.completion: Excellent. Our paladins will be well equipped for battle.

english.title: The Highlord's Command
english.objectives: Complete the mission, "The Highlord's Command: Procuring Supplies."
english.description: You are right, Highlord. Our military efforts cannot succeed without solid logistics.$B$BThat means we need a steady supply of weapons, food, medicine, and other provisions.$B$BLet us send our champions to establish a supply line.
english.completion: Excellent. Our paladins will be well equipped for battle.

enders.name: 格雷森·沙东布瑞克公爵

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“大领主的命令：获取军需”任务

text.title: 钻石之王
text.objectives: 与布莱恩、卡德加一同前往奥杜尔，听取麦格尼·铜须的信息。
text.description: 我的哥哥麦格尼，也就是铁炉堡的前任国王，在一个泰坦仪式中变成了一座钻石雕像。他在城市下面呆站了好几年。$b$b但我刚才收到消息，他已经可以走动了……还声称他知道了击败燃烧军团的方法！$b$b听着，$n，我不知道麦格尼是不是疯了，也不知道那是否真的就是他本人。但是，就算有一丝可能性，如果他真的能帮助我们的话……$b$b我听说他还提到了奥杜尔的名字。那里正是我准备去的地方！如果你和卡德加能够和我一同前往那里，那可就帮大忙了。
text.completion: Magni's information was crucial to our efforts against the Legion. And it was good to see him again.$b$bNow to find that tome about the Pillars of Creation...
text.completed: 在卡拉赞外围找到卡德加。

english.title: The Diamond King
english.objectives: Go with Brann and Khadgar to Ulduar and hear Magni Bronzebeard's message.
english.description: Me brother Magni, once King o' Ironforge, got changed into a diamond statue by a titan ritual. He's stood frozen in the belly o' the city fer years.$b$bBut I just got word that he's up and around... sayin' he knows somethin' 'bout how to beat the Legion!$b$bLook, $n, I dunno if Magni's crazy, or if that's even really him. But if there's even a chance he kin help us...$b$bI'm told he muttered the name Ulduar. That's where I'm headed! I'd be obliged if you an' Khadgar were ta join me.
english.completion: Magni's information was crucial to our efforts against the Legion. And it was good to see him again.$b$bNow to find that tome about the Pillars of Creation...
english.completed: Meet with Khadgar outside Karazhan.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用卡德加的传送门前往卡拉赞
使用布莱恩的传送门前往奥杜尔
告诉布莱恩是时候出发了

text.title: 驾驭元素
text.objectives: 取回烈焰、流水和空气残留物，并在塞拉赞恩阵营达到崇敬声望。
text.description: $r，靠近一点。$b$b火焰之地的拉格纳罗斯，风神王座的奥拉基尔和潮汐王座的耐普图隆。自从世界形成之初，他们就一直是我的眼中钉肉中刺。$b$b向我证明你的力量凌驾于那些弱小元素之上，我就会教导你如何向所有人展示你的力量。

english.title: Controlling the Elements
english.objectives: Retrieve Remnants of Fire, Water, and Air, and reach Revered status with Therazane.
english.description: Come closer, $r.$b$bRagnaros in the Firelands, Al'Akir in his Throne of the Four Winds, and Neptulon in Throne of the Tides. They have been thorns in my hide since the world was new.$b$bProve to me your strength over the weaker elements, and I shall teach you how to display your power for all to see.

text.title: 霍迪尔的命运
text.objectives: 在邪焰隘口与你的部队一起完成场景战役：霍迪尔的命运。
text.description: 是时候了，$n。前往阿苏纳，用我们占领的传送门进入尼斯卡拉，然后找到霍迪尔。$B$B燃烧军团一定会为了他们侵略艾泽拉斯的行为而后悔的！

english.title: The Fate of Hodir
english.objectives: Join your forces at Felblaze Ingress and Complete the Fate of Hodir scenario.
english.description: It is time, $n. Go to Azsuna and use the captured gateway to travel to Niskara and find Hodir.$B$BThe Legion will regret they set foot on Azeroth!

objectiveDetails.description: 在邪焰隘口与你的部队会合

text.title: 逐风者的仆从
text.objectives: 在希利苏斯与德米提恩谈一谈。
text.description: 元素领主们必须团结起来。但是自从风元素领主奥拉基尔死后，风元素到现在都群龙无首。$b$b桑德兰王子曾是风神王座的继承人，但他在凡人国度被击败了，仍在等待重生。只有一个人知道如何让王子重生。$b$b桑德兰的一个忠实的仆人正在希利苏斯的沙漠中游荡。去找到他，他会告诉你该怎么做。

english.title: Servant of the Windseeker
english.objectives: Speak with Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.
english.description: The elemental lords must be united,  but there has been no Windlord to lead the air elementals since the death of Al'Akir.$b$bOnce, there was an heir to the Throne of Four winds named Prince Thunderaan, but the prince was defeated in the mortal realm and still awaits rebirth. Only one man holds the knowledge necessary to complete the prince's rebirth.$b$bThere is a servant of Thunderaan who wanders the sands of Silithus. Find him, and he will show you the way.

text.title: 觐见国王
text.objectives: 到暴风要塞向安度因·乌瑞恩国王报到。
text.description: $n：$B$B你和我的父亲一样戎马一生。他教会我，要带领国家走向和平，要实现理想，我们必须为之而战。而你已经身经百战。$B$B你展现了无比崇高的英勇精神，堪称联盟之中的典范。诚心可鉴，勇气可嘉。$B$B请立刻赶到暴风要塞，接受应得的嘉奖。$B$B- 安度因·乌瑞恩国王

english.title: A Royal Audience
english.objectives: Report to King Anduin Wrynn in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: $n,$B$BMy father lived by the sword, as you do. He taught me that if we truly want peace for our kingdom then we must be willing to fight to preserve it, as you have fought.$B$BYou have demonstrated valor of the highest order - bravery unsurpassed in the ranks of the Alliance. Valor that must be recognized.$B$BPlease join me in Stormwind Keep at once so that you can be properly rewarded for your service.$B$B- King Anduin Wrynn

text.title: 英雄的嘉奖
text.objectives: 在暴风要塞高举你的武器并接受嘉奖。
text.description: 只有真正的英雄才能日复一日坚守阵线，为了保卫自己的家园，让其他人过上安定的生活而不断奋斗。$B$B你英勇无畏，殚心竭力，为联盟的人民和利益做出了巨大的贡献。$B$B为了表示我们的感谢，请转向在你前面聚集的英雄们并高举你的武器，接受嘉奖。

english.title: The Victor's Spoils
english.objectives: Raise your weapon and be recognized in Stormwind Keep.
english.description: It takes a true hero to put their life on the line day after day in defense of their home so that others do not have to.$B$BYou have dutifully safeguarded the people and interests of the Alliance, never faltering in your courage or devotion.$B$BAs a small token of our appreciation for your valiance, please turn to the gathered heroes before you, raise your weapon high, and be recognized.

text.title: 凛风精华
text.objectives: 从旋云之巅的风元素身上收集100份凛风精华。穿过艾泽拉斯之心的传送门，前往旋云之巅。
text.description: 要修复漩涡之柱，我们必须向其中注入空气精华。$B$B这就需要大量凛风精华。$B$B你可以在旋云之巅的很多元素生物身上找到凛风精华。$B$B如果你能将元素精华收集齐并交给我，我就能继续进行漩涡之柱的修复工作。

english.title: Mistral Essence
english.objectives: Collect 100 Mistral Essences from wind elementals in Vortex Pinnacle. Travel to the Vortex Pinnacle through the portal in the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: To restore the Maelstrom Pillar, we will need to infuse it with the essence of air.$B$BA large quantity of Mistral Essence will be required to do this.$B$BMistral Essence can be found on many of the elementals in Vortex Pinnacle.$B$BIf you can return to me with a ready supply of elemental essence, I will be able to continue my restoration work on the Maelstrom Pillar.

text.title: 艾萨拉之眼：风暴权杖
text.objectives: 在地下城“艾萨拉之眼”中，从积怨夫人身上收集风暴权杖。
text.description: 空气元素很难控制。我们得想办法用魔法将其固定在柱子上。$B$B不管空气多么变化无常，也无法抵御风暴的力量。$B$B在艾萨拉之眼里面，有一个被称为积怨夫人的纳迦巫师。她拥有一件名为风暴权杖的强大圣物。$B$B取得权杖，我们就能用它将空气元素束缚在漩涡之柱上。

english.title: Eye of Azshara: The Scepter of Storms
english.objectives: Collect the Scepter of Storms from Lady Hatecoil in the Eye of Azshara dungeon.
english.description: The element of air can be difficult to contain. We will need a way to magically anchor it to the pillar.$B$BAir, no matter how capricious, cannot resist a good storm.$B$BIn the Eye of Azshara, the naga sorceress known as Lady Hatecoil possesses a powerful relic known as the Scepter of Storms.$B$BRetrieve the scepter, and we will use it to bind the elements of air to the Maelstrom Pillar.

text.title: 觐见酋长
text.objectives: 到幽暗城向大酋长希尔瓦娜斯·风行者报到。
text.description: $n：$B$B一切反动势力都是部落的敌人。勇士，你坚持奋战，灭敌无数。$B$B我很欣赏你的努力。正因为有你，我们才能崛起，我们才能变得前所未有的强大，我们一定会彻底打败联盟。$B$B立刻到幽暗城来见我，我要嘉奖你的功绩。$B$B- 大酋长希尔瓦娜斯·风行者

english.title: A Royal Audience
english.objectives: Report to Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner in the Undercity.
english.description: $n,$B$BThose who do not stand with the Horde stand against it. You, champion, have cut down such enemies in droves.$B$BI admire your dedication. It is through you that we will rise up, more powerful than ever, and put the Alliance in their place once and for all.$B$BJoin me in the Undercity at once. Your victories must be met with due reward.$B$B- Warchief Sylvanas Windrunner

text.title: 空气之敌
text.objectives: 完成4个“桑德兰的敌人”任务。
text.description: 风元素领主桑德兰重新夺回了旋云之巅，但有些臣民不服他的统治。$B$B他的国度里依然动荡不安，似乎有四名宰相已经造反了。他们是：米斯图斯、泽弗、阿拉克里斯和图尔莫斯。$B$B我们得派出勇士协助天空之墙平息内乱，好让桑德兰专心对抗燃烧军团。

english.title: Enemies of Air
english.objectives: Complete 4 "Thunderaan's Enemies" missions.
english.description: Windlord Thunderaan has retaken the Vortex Pinnacle, but not all of his subjects have taken to his leadership kindly.$B$BIn his kingdom there is still unrest, and it appears there are four viziers who have risen up against him: Mistius, Zeph, Alacris, and Tulmos.$B$BWe will let Thunderaan focus on the war against the Burning Legion while we send our champions to aid Skywall against its enemies.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“桑德兰的敌人”系列任务

text.title: 英雄的嘉奖
text.objectives: 在幽暗城高举你的武器并接受嘉奖。
text.description: 只要有你坚守阵线，我们就能屹立不倒。只要我们同心协力，就能扫清阻挡我们的任何敌人。$B$B你不畏牺牲，为部落做出了巨大的贡献。我必须表彰你的功绩。$B$B去面对你的勇士同伴吧，$n。去面对他们，并接受嘉奖。

english.title: The Victor's Spoils
english.objectives: Raise your weapon and be recognized in the Undercity.
english.description: We will never be dominated so long as you stand at the front of our lines. Together we will slaughter anyone who stands in our way.$B$BYou have sacrificed as much as any in the name of the Horde. I will not let your dedication go unnoticed.$B$BFace your fellow champions, $n. Face them, and be recognized.

text.title: 世界修复者
text.objectives: 完成10个世界任务。
text.description: 元素们已经集结，尽管火焰之地还没与我们联手，但是现在我们的力量已经是前所未有的强大。$B$B不过，我们与燃烧军团的战争仍在继续，现在我们必须把注意力集中到破碎群岛。$B$B我们把迫在眉睫的威胁解除后，再专门想办法争取到火焰之地的支持。

english.title: Worldmender
english.objectives: Complete 10 World Quests.
english.description: The elements have gathered, and though the Firelands have yet to unite with us, we have more strength on our side than ever before.$B$BHowever, the war with the Burning Legion still rages, and for now we must turn our gaze to the Broken Isles.$B$BWhen we have dealt sufficiently with the immediate threats of the war, we will turn our attention to uniting the Firelands to our cause.

text.title: 无畏者玛哈特
text.objectives: 前往深岩之洲与无畏者玛哈特交谈，并获取一枚化石蛋。他要你拿5份萨格拉斯之血跟他换。
text.description: 为了将大地精华注入漩涡之柱，我们需要一种艾泽拉斯最珍贵的化石——蛋。$B$B盖亚斯的蛋不是普通的蛋；其中含有未出生的原始土灵的遗骸，并以化石的形式完好地保存了下来。也许有办法把它复活，不过那个以后再说。$b$b首先，我们得找到那枚蛋！$B$B大地之环得到消息说蛋在一个远古存在的手里，但他不白给，你要拿鲜血去换！

english.title: Ma'haat the Indomitable
english.objectives: Speak to Ma'haat the Indomitable in Deepholm to acquire a Fossilized Egg. He will require 5 Blood of Sargeras in trade.
english.description: In order to imbue the Maelstrom Pillar with the essence of earth, we will need one of the rarest fossils found on Azeroth - an egg.$B$BThe Egg of Gaiath is no ordinary egg; it contains the remnants of an unborn earthen primal, perfectly preserved in stone. There may be a means by which to revive it, but more on that later.$b$bFirst, we must find that egg!$B$BThe Earthen Ring has heard of an ancient being who possesses such an item, but he will require payment in blood!

text.title: 奈萨里奥的巢穴：大地护符
text.objectives: 前往奈萨里奥的巢穴，从地底之王达古尔身上取得大地护符。
text.description: 你能取得盖亚斯的蛋已经非常了不起了，不过下一步几乎是不可能完成的任务。但……这也是我们唯一的希望。$B$B我们必须唤醒潜藏在蛋中的元素能量，仪式才能大功告成。$B$B要唤醒蛋中的能量，需要依靠一件名为大地护符的圣物。据说此物由洛肯亲手制作。$B$B很久以前，此物就不见了踪影，最后落到了地底之王达古尔手里。

english.title: Neltharion's Lair: The Earthen Amulet
english.objectives: Retrieve the Earthen Amulet from Dargrul the Underking in Neltharion's Lair.
english.description: That you were even able to acquire the Egg of Gaiath  is an incredible feat in itself, but the next step may well be impossible. Still... it is our only hope.$B$BFor the ritual to work, we will need to awaken the latent elemental energy resting inside of this egg.$B$BThere is an item that just may have the ability to do this - a relic known as the Earthen Amulet, rumored to have been created by Loken himself.$B$BIt was lost many ages ago, and has fallen into the hands of Dargrul the Underking.

text.title: 漩涡之柱：空气
text.objectives: 在艾泽拉斯之心与元素师佳奈谈一谈。
text.description: 先知，元素师佳奈之前在找你。看来她研究漩涡之柱大有收获。$b$b你有空的话，就去找她谈谈研究取得的进展吧。

english.title: The Maelstrom Pillar: Air
english.objectives: Speak to Elementalist Janai at the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: Elementalist Janai was looking for you earlier, Farseer. It appears that her study of the Maelstrom Pillar has been most enlightening.$b$bIf you have a moment, you should go and meet with her to discuss her progress.

text.title: 漩涡之柱：土
text.objectives: 在艾泽拉斯之心与元素师佳奈谈一谈。
text.description: 元素师佳奈一直在为恢复漩涡之柱而辛勤工作。最近，她把研究重心放在大地元素上。$b$b你有机会时应该和她谈谈。听说她即将取得突破性进展了。

english.title: The Maelstrom Pillar: Earth
english.objectives: Speak to Elementalist Janai at the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: Elementalist Janai has been hard at work restoring the Maelstrom Pillar. As of late, she has been focusing her research on the element of earth.$b$bYou should speak with her when you have a chance. I have heard that she is close to a breakthrough.

text.title: 逐风者的祝福之剑
text.objectives: 找到遗失的逐风者之剑。
text.description: 你是说大地之环想复活我的主人？$b$b<高阶领主德米提恩一阵狂笑。>$b$b我终于等到这一天啦！人类终于理解逐风者的力量了！$b$b风王子死于卑鄙凡人之手时，他的灵魂被困在了神圣之刃雷霆之怒里。$b$b要想复活我的主人，你得找到这把剑，并将其交还至天空之墙。据我所知，偷了我主人的剑的叛徒跑到破碎群岛对抗恶魔去了。

english.title: Blessed Blade of the Windseeker
english.objectives: Locate the lost blade of the Windseeker.
english.description: So the Earthen Ring wishes to resurrect my master?$b$b<Highlord Demitrian laughs maniacally.>$b$bI knew this day would come! At last, humanity understands the power of the Windseeker!$b$bWhen Prince Thunderaan was slain at the hands of treacherous mortals, his soul was trapped within the sacred blade Thunderfury.$b$bTo resurrect my master you will need to find his sword and return it to Skywall. Last I heard, the betrayer who stole my master's sword traveled to the Broken Isles to fight demons.

text.title: 回去找佳奈
text.objectives: 返回艾泽拉斯之心找元素师佳奈。
text.description: <无畏者玛哈特以闷雷般低沉的声音说道>$b$b这……就是盖亚斯的蛋。现在是你的了。$b$b你可以安心地离开了。

english.title: Return to Janai
english.objectives: Return to Elementalist Janai at the Heart of Azeroth.
english.description: <Ma'haat the Indomitable speaks to you with a low, rumbling voice.>$b$bHere... is the Egg of Gaiath. It is yours now.$b$bGo... in peace.

text.title: 返回暗影大厅
text.objectives: 与暗影大厅的乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵对话。
text.description:
乔拉齐·拉文霍德公爵派我来找你，$n。他希望在一件重要的事情上听听你的意见。

他希望你能够尽快赶回暗影大厅。
text.giverWindow: 等你有了时间，就尽快返回暗影大厅。

english.title: Return to the Chamber of Shadows
english.objectives: Speak with Lord Jorach Ravenholdt in the Chamber of Shadows.
english.description:
Lord Jorach Ravenholdt sent me out to find you, $n. He wants your counsel on some matter of importance.

He requests your presence back at the Chamber of Shadows.
english.giverWindow: Return to me in the Chamber of Shadows at your earliest convenience.

text.title: 盗贼学校
text.objectives: 与洛妮卡·静刃交谈并训练盗匪。
text.description:
很好！她似乎已经搬进来了。这是件好事，因为我们需要找新人来压榨。

你应该去转转，看看她手下的那些盗贼们是不是在躺着偷懒。

english.title: The School of Roguery
english.objectives: Speak with Lonika Stillblade and train a Gang of Bandits.
english.description:
Great! Sounds like she's already settled in. That's good, cuz we already need some fresh meat for the grinder.

You should mosey over an' see if she's got any thieves just lying around takin' up space.

text.title: 大坏蛋沃尔菲
text.objectives: 使用侦察地图并完成任务“大坏蛋沃尔菲”。
text.description:
你听说过温斯顿·沃尔菲，对吧？你肯定听过。谁没听过？

在你和校长闲扯的时候，我有幸见到了拉文霍德公爵，真的是他本人。我没想到他居然会从那个房间出来。

不管怎样，他用自己的方式强烈建议我们派迦罗娜、梵妮莎和我们新招募的盗贼去拉文霍德庄园跟“孤狼”聊聊。

记得叫他们态度好一点，不然我们可就再也见不到他们了。

english.title: The Big Bad Wolfe
english.objectives: Use the Scouting Map and complete the mission, "The Big Bad Wolfe".
english.description:
You've heard of Winstone Wolfe, right? Of course you have. Who hasn't?

So, while you were off gabbin' with the headmistress, Lord Ravenholdt graced me with his presence. In the flesh. I didn't think he ever came out of that chamber.

Anywhoodles, he more than suggested, in that way of his, that we send Garona, Vanessa, and our new merry gang of bandits off to have a little chat with The Wolf at Ravenholdt Manor.

Just make sure they're nice and civil, or that's the last we'll see of them.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成“大坏蛋沃尔菲”任务

text.title: 温斯顿的建言
text.objectives: 与温斯顿·沃尔菲对话。
text.description:
如果要说有人可以让这里的事业更上一层楼，那就非温斯顿·沃尔菲莫属了。我跟你说，这个人能够创造奇迹！

既然他现在替我们干活，那我们为什么不借助一些他的智慧呢？
text.giverWindow: “孤狼”是来帮助我们解决问题的。他才智过人、魅力非凡，同时还散发出一丝可怕的杀气。

english.title: What Winstone Suggests
english.objectives: Speak to Winstone Wolfe.
english.description:
If anyone can improve the way things run around here, it's Winstone Wolfe. I tell ya, the man is a miracle-worker!

Now that he's workin' for us, shall we pick his brain an' see what he suggests?
english.giverWindow: The Wolf is here to solve problems for us. He's brilliant and charming with an extra helping of deadly piled on top.

text.title: 充足库存
text.objectives: 带来100份香辣烤肋排、至高岭鲑鱼或丝纹绷带，帮助老舒充实库存。烹饪和急救的能力应该对这个任务有帮助。
text.description: 我检查了好几次库存，但不管我再怎么节约开支，我们还是缺少供给。$B$B食物和药品的短缺会令我们的战争行动变得迟缓……这就是事实。$B$B我们急缺食物和绷带。如果你知道哪里能找到这些东西，就把它们带来给我。

english.title: An Ample Stockpile
english.objectives: Turn in 100 Spiced Rib Roasts, Highmountain Salmon, or Silkweave Bandages for Lao Shu's stockpile. The Cooking and First Aid professions may be useful for this task.
english.description: I have gone through our stockpile several times and no matter how I try to cut corners, we come up short.$B$BA lack of food and medicine will halt our war efforts... that is simply the reality.$B$BWe desperately need food or bandages. If you know how to acquire any such items, you can bring them to me.

text.title: 修炼精进
text.objectives: 使用你的碎玉闪电、滚地翻和幻灭踢或幻灭猛击技能各10次。
text.description: 就算是大宗师，也必须牢记熟能生巧的原则。$B$B为了达到身心合一的境界，你必须继续训练。$B$B我希望能看到你不断实践，$n。多多施展你的碎玉闪电、滚地翻，还有幻灭踢或者幻灭猛击。勤学苦练才能得心应手。

english.title: Further Training
english.objectives: Use your Crackling Jade Lightning, Roll, and Blackout Kick or Blackout Strike abilities 10 times each.
english.description: You may be the Grandmaster, but mastery must be maintained through discipline.$B$BTo achieve perfect harmony, you must continue your training.$B$BI would like to see your form in practice, $n. Go out and use your Crackling Jade Lightning, Roll, and Blackout Kick or Blackout Strike. Through discipline, we find greatness.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用幻灭猛击或幻灭踢

text.title: 奥杜尔的誓言
text.objectives: 请求海姆达尔吹响迦拉尔之角并请求托里姆的协助。
text.description: 我曾经是艾泽拉斯大陆上所有泰坦造物守护者的领袖。我们受泰坦之命守护着这个世界。$B$B在我放弃了首席管理官的职位之后，我也失去了对其他守护者的影响力。即使是我的儿子托里姆，也不一定会听从我的命令。$B$B不过，迦拉尔之角来自我们分崩离析之前的时代。那是个信守古老誓言的时代。$B$B让我们再度吟诵那份誓言吧，托里姆一定会响应召唤而来。

english.title: Ulduar's Oath
english.objectives: Ask Hymdall to sound the Gjallarhorn and request Thorim's assistance.
english.description: I was once leader of all of the titanforged keepers of Azeroth.  We were charged by the Titans themselves to protect the world.$B$BOnce I gave up on the post of Prime Designate, I gave up any measure of influence over the other keepers.  Not even my own son, Thorim, is bound to heed my commands.$B$BThe Gjallarhorn comes from a time before our falling out, however.  A time of an ancient oath of honor.$B$BLet us invoke that oath -- I am certain Thorim will answer the call.

objectiveDetails.description: 与艾瑞莉娅交谈以前往奥杜尔

text.title: 寻找权杖
text.objectives: 前往西瘟疫之地的凯尔达隆，调查暗影议会的仪式。
text.description: 非常强大，不过很难获取。权杖在古尔丹手里。我们必须搞清楚他的计划，并且想办法接近他。$b$b卡里杜斯知道古尔丹有一个大计划。他召集了暗影议会所有的人手帮他举行一个大型仪式。这一大群人正在凯尔达隆和那里的通灵师会谈。$b$b你应该去一趟，搞清他们的计划。

english.title: Finding the Scepter
english.objectives: Go to Caer Darrow in Western Plaguelands and find out about the Shadow Council ritual.
english.description: Very powerful, but difficult to acquire. Scepter is in the hands of Gul'dan. We must find out his plans, get close.$b$bCalydus know Gul'dan planning major operation. He has sent out a call to arms to all Shadow Council to help with big ritual. One such group at Caer Darrow, talking to the necromancers there.$b$bYou should go, find out about plan.

objectiveDetails.description: 从耶戈什手里拿到麦迪文之书

text.title: 公平交易
text.objectives: 取得20张石皮皮革。
text.description: 没错，我确实有不朽啤酒花，但我花了不少时间去收集，我可没法轻易割舍它们。$B$B但我愿意用它们来交换石皮皮革。$B$B如果你找到了这种皮革，就把它们带给我，我们可以做笔交易。

english.title: Making A Trade
english.objectives: Obtain 20 Stonehide Leather.
english.description: Yes I do have Amaranthine Hops, but they took me quite some time to gather. I cannot part with them easily.$B$BHowever, I'd be willing to trade them for Stonehide Leather.$B$BIf you come upon any, bring it to me and we can make a trade.

text.title: 点睛之笔
text.objectives: 使用传送门前往托尔巴拉德，并帮忙寻找达拉然之眼。
text.description: 听起来很简单吧？要和暗影议会搞好关系……暂时的。帮他们进行仪式以获取他们的信任，然后来个惊天大反转！$b$b议会在这里有通往托尔巴拉德的传送装置。去吧，帮暗影议会找到达拉然之眼，取得参加仪式的资格！然后，偷走权杖！$b$b卡里杜斯会尽量帮着朋友的。

english.title: An Eye for a Scepter
english.objectives: Take the portal to Tol Barad and help find the Eye of Dalaran.
english.description: Sounds simple? Make nice with Shadow Council friend must... for now. Help with ritual enough to gain trust, then turn tables!$b$bCouncil made portal device to Tol Barad here. Go, help Shadow Council find Eye of Dalaran, earn spot in big ritual! Then steal Scepter!$b$bCalydus will try to keep eye on friend when possible.

objectiveDetails.description: 使用传送门前往托尔巴拉德

text.title: 扭曲之树
text.objectives: 喝下女巫大锅中的药剂，接受她的咒语。之后，你才能击败她姐姐那无法安息的灵魂。
text.description:
三位姐妹绞树下，
指控罪名全虚假。
年轻妹妹终逃离，
其余颈上绳牢系。
拉文凯斯玷吾誉，
此咒终可洗冤屈。

english.title: Under the Crooked Tree
english.objectives: Drink from the hag's cauldron to accept her curse. Then you will be able to defeat her sister's restless spirit.
english.description:
My three sisters from that tree hung,
The crimes accused there was not one,
The youngest sister did escape,
As the noose looped around their nape,
Old Ravencrest is the one to blame,
This curse for you to lift our shame.

objectiveDetails.description: 喝下锅里的东西并释放艾瑞雅·悲心的灵魂

text.title: 达拉然肯瑞托
text.objectives: 完成3个肯瑞托世界任务。
text.description: 完成3个世界任务来协助达拉然的肯瑞托。
text.completed: 回达拉然找战斗法师西尔瓦。

english.title: The Kirin Tor of Dalaran
english.objectives: Complete 3 Kirin Tor world quests.
english.description: Assist the Kirin Tor of Dalaran by completing 3 world quests.
english.completed: Return to Warmage Silva in Dalaran.

objectiveDetails.description: 完成3个肯瑞托世界任务

text.title: Tracking Down the Scepter
text.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
text.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Scepter of Sargeras. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

english.title: Tracking Down the Scepter
english.objectives: Take the logbook to Calydus in Dreadscar Rift.
english.description: The logbook contains the latest information on the Scepter of Sargeras. It appears to have been written by an extremely agitated, excited, or psychotic imp and is barely legible. Take this to Calydus for translation.

text.title: 遗失的容器
text.objectives: 点击侦察地图，完成“遗失的容器”任务，收集碎裂的容器碎片。
text.description: 如果不解决哈卡，所有法师都有危险。$B$B米尔菲丝·法力风暴制作过一个可以吸取法师精华的容器，它可以束缚法师的魔力。那原本是一件武器，但我们可以把它当成诱饵。$B$B只要我将自己的精华导入容器，它就会变成纯粹的魔法物体。$B$B在被捕时，米尔菲丝把容器打碎了，碎片也落入了敌人手中。$B$B去找到那些碎片，并把它们交给我。我们要一起为哈卡设下一个无法抗拒的陷阱！

english.title: The Missing Vessel
english.objectives: Interact with the Scouting Map and complete "The Missing Vessel" missions to collect Shattered Vessel Fragments.
english.description: So long as Hakkar roams free, no mage will be safe.$B$BMillificent Manastorm created a vessel that siphons the essence of a mage, binding their magic to the object. It was created to be a weapon, but we can use it as bait.$B$BIf I channel my essence into the vessel, it will become an object of pure magic.$B$BUpon capture, Millificent shattered the vessel, allowing it to fall into the hands of our enemies.$B$BFind the pieces and return them to me. Together we can set a trap Hakkar won't be able to resist!

text.title: 突袭守望高塔：逐星者岗哨
屠魔者！
text.objectives: 接受伊利达雷以及伊利丹的仆从的致敬。
text.description: $n，我们在此济济一堂，对你的英明领导、伟大胜利以及牺牲精神表达我们的敬意。

english.title: I Am the Slayer!
english.objectives: Listen as you are honored by the Illidari and the Servants of Illidan.
english.description: $n, we have all gathered here to honor you for your leadership, successes, and sacrifices.
